en: I decided to bring it back the next year under its own site properly, and so we launched the current version of the site in May of 2010.
ja: 翌年　ちゃんと独立したサイトとして復活させようと決めて　2010年5月に今のサイトを立ち上げた

key: By that time the League was a thing, but that's a separate dialogue option.
en: By that time the League was a thing, but that's a separate dialogue option.
ja: そのころにはリーグも動いてたけど　それは別の話題ね

key: The League ended up attracting a lot of people though, so we grew wayyy more than I ever expected to,
en: The League ended up attracting a lot of people though, so we grew wayyy more than I ever expected to,
ja: リーグには　たくさんの人が集まってきて　思っていたよりずうっと大きくなった

key: And then the game attracted even more...
en: And then the game attracted even more...
ja: そしてゲームが　さらに多くの人を呼んで……

key: And here we all are today!
en: And here we all are today!
ja: それで　今日のわたしたちがいる!

key: My life really wouldn't be anywhere near the same without this community,
en: My life really wouldn't be anywhere near the same without this community,
ja: このコミュニティがなかったら　わたしの人生は　まるでちがうものになってた

key: And although I've never been a fan of other big sites and places (too many people?!?!)
en: And although I've never been a fan of other big sites and places (too many people?!?!)
ja: ほかの大きなサイトや場所は　昔から苦手だけど(人が多すぎ?!?!)

key: I'm very grateful to everyone who's stuck around, contributed, just popped into chat briefly, etc...
en: I'm very grateful to everyone who's stuck around, contributed, just popped into chat briefly, etc...
ja: 残ってくれた人　力を貸してくれた人　ちょっとチャットをのぞいただけの人　みんなに　とても感謝してる……

key: And I hope that those of you further away from us will consider dropping by someday!
en: And I hope that those of you further away from us will consider dropping by someday!
ja: 遠くから見ているみんなも　いつか気軽に立ち寄ってくれたらうれしい!

key: Plus, everyone whose support has kept me going through that alternate evolution of Eevee when you give it money,
en: Plus, everyone whose support has kept me going through that alternate evolution of Eevee when you give it money,
ja: それに　イーブイにお金をあげたときの　あの別の進化みたいなかたちで　支えてくれてるみんな

key: Really, like, makes my life awesome, you know?
en: Really, like, makes my life awesome, you know?
ja: 本当に　わたしの人生を　最高にしてくれてるんだよ

key: Thank you so much everyone <3333
en: Thank you so much everyone <3333
ja: みんな　本当にありがとう <3333

key: AME: So, this game was based on the online Reborn League challenge we hosted for several years.
en: AME: So, this game was based on the online Reborn League challenge we hosted for several years.
ja: アメ: このゲームはね　何年か開催していた　オンラインのリボーンリーグ挑戦がもとになってるの

key: But how did that league itself come about?
en: But how did that league itself come about?
ja: じゃあ　そのリーグ自体は　どうやって始まったのか?

key: Originally, it was a challenge to my best friend at the time.
en: Originally, it was a challenge to my best friend at the time.
ja: もともとは　当時の親友への　挑戦状だった

key: We met through the RPG Maker community, and enjoyed playing difficulty hacks like Emerald 386 together.
en: We met through the RPG Maker community, and enjoyed playing difficulty hacks like Emerald 386 together.
ja: RPGツクールのコミュニティで知り合って　エメラルド386みたいな難易度改造をいっしょに遊んでた

key: He and I often said things like, "Wouldn't it be awesome if you could fight Gym Leaders that actually put up as much of a fight as real people?"
en: He and I often said things like, "Wouldn't it be awesome if you could fight Gym Leaders that actually put up as much of a fight as real people?"
ja: よく二人で言ってたの。「生身の人間くらい　本気で戦ってくるジムリーダーがいたら　最高じゃない?」って

key: So when I was 14 or so, I came up with a list of badge names, images, and pun names for each type,
en: So when I was 14 or so, I came up with a list of badge names, images, and pun names for each type,
ja: それで14さいくらいのとき　バッジの名前と絵と　タイプごとのしゃれの利いた名前を　ひと通り考えた

key: And you basically know all of those already. I think I kept them all.
en: And you basically know all of those already. I think I kept them all.
ja: そしてそれは　もうだいたい知ってるはず。全部そのまま使ったと思う

key: I started making that challenge for him around the time I was 15.
en: I started making that challenge for him around the time I was 15.
ja: 15さいのころ　その挑戦を　彼のために作り始めた

key: Terra was the first Leader I worked on, but she was no more than a name back then.
en: Terra was the first Leader I worked on, but she was no more than a name back then.
ja: 最初に手をつけたリーダーはテラ。もっとも　当時はまだ名前だけの存在だった

key: I remember spending a lot of time EV Training Gliscor and Flygon in actual Pearl, and I was going to create a team for each type that way.
en: I remember spending a lot of time EV Training Gliscor and Flygon in actual Pearl, and I was going to create a team for each type that way.
ja: 本物のパールでグライオンとフライゴンの努力値をひたすら振ってたのを覚えてる。ああやってタイプごとにパーティを作るつもりだった

key: ...I didn't get farther than Gliscor and Flygon before my friend and I had a falling out, and we didn't really speak much after that.
en: ...I didn't get farther than Gliscor and Flygon before my friend and I had a falling out, and we didn't really speak much after that.
ja: ……でもグライオンとフライゴンから先に進む前に　友達と仲たがいして　そのあとはほとんど話さなくなった

key: The challenge died, and I also quit making games entirely.
en: The challenge died, and I also quit making games entirely.
ja: 挑戦は立ち消えになって　わたしもゲーム作りを完全にやめた

key: A few years later, I found that image with all the badges and Leader names, and decided to try it again.
en: A few years later, I found that image with all the badges and Leader names, and decided to try it again.
ja: 数年後　バッジとリーダー名を並べたあの画像を見つけて　もう一度やってみようと思った

key: Reborn had already existed as a community by then, and subsequently died (for good, even over the summer)...
en: Reborn had already existed as a community by then, and subsequently died (for good, even over the summer)...
ja: そのころにはリボーンはコミュニティとしてすでにあって　そして死んでいた(夏が来ても　今度こそ完全に)……

key: But I still hung out with most of the people involved in a small little community called Monkey Pro.
en: But I still hung out with most of the people involved in a small little community called Monkey Pro.
ja: でも　あのころの仲間の大半とは　モンキープロっていう小さなコミュニティで　まだつるんでた

key: Maybe they would be interested in the Gym Leader challenge I'd started for my friend instead?
en: Maybe they would be interested in the Gym Leader challenge I'd started for my friend instead?
ja: 友達のために始めたジムリーダー挑戦　あの人たちなら興味を持ってくれるかも?

key: I also knew the Shoddy Battle simulator was a thing by then, so I was able to convince one of Monkey Pro's members, Hyperlisk, to host a private server for us.
en: I also knew the Shoddy Battle simulator was a thing by then, so I was able to convince one of Monkey Pro's members, Hyperlisk, to host a private server for us.
ja: そのころにはショディバトルっていう対戦シミュレータがあると知ってたから　モンキープロのメンバーのハイパーリスクを説得して　専用サーバーを立ててもらった

key: Terra was once again the first Leader.
en: Terra was once again the first Leader.
ja: またしても　最初のリーダーはテラだった

key: My concept for her this time was "a girl who's personality is like an earthquake".
en: My concept for her this time was "a girl who's personality is like an earthquake".
ja: 今度のコンセプトは　「性格が地震みたいな女の子」

key: I made Trainer Cards for each of them, and sprites that I worked on during class, or backstage from theatre rehearsals...
en: I made Trainer Cards for each of them, and sprites that I worked on during class, or backstage from theatre rehearsals...
ja: 一人ひとりのトレーナーカードを作って　ドット絵は授業中とか　演劇の練習の舞台裏とかで描いてた……

key: I roleplayed the Leaders myself, and some of them didn't have much character, but it was fun.
en: I roleplayed the Leaders myself, and some of them didn't have much character, but it was fun.
ja: リーダーは全部わたしが演じてた。中身の薄い子もいたけど　楽しかった

key: So, it became a somewhat daily ritual for me to bark at some friends on MP, asking them if they'd like to do a Leader battle.
en: So, it became a somewhat daily ritual for me to bark at some friends on MP, asking them if they'd like to do a Leader battle.
ja: そのうち　MPの友達に「リーダー戦やらない?」とわめくのが　ほぼ日課になった

key: People seemed to really enjoy this "Monkey Pro League".
en: People seemed to really enjoy this "Monkey Pro League".
ja: この「モンキープロリーグ」は　みんなかなり楽しんでくれたみたい

key: Then I got kicked out of theatre, fell into depression, and stopped hosting it for months lmao
en: Then I got kicked out of theatre, fell into depression, and stopped hosting it for months lmao
ja: そのあと演劇部を追い出されて　落ちこんで　何か月も開催をやめた　ってね

key: In May of 2010, I decided to give it another go.
en: In May of 2010, I decided to give it another go.
ja: 2010年5月　もう一度やってみることにした

key: This time, I found the Pokémon Online simulator, which was way more friendly than Shoddy Battle, and another MP member hosted a server for us.
en: This time, I found the Pokémon Online simulator, which was way more friendly than Shoddy Battle, and another MP member hosted a server for us.
ja: 今度はポケモンオンラインっていうシミュレータを見つけた。ショディよりずっと使いやすくて　別のMPメンバーがサーバーを立ててくれた

key: You would know him as Nyu!
en: You would know him as Nyu!
ja: みんなの知ってる　ニューだよ!

key: I also made the current iteration of the site to go along with it.
en: I also made the current iteration of the site to go along with it.
ja: それに合わせて　今のかたちのサイトも作った

key: This League began like the last, with me asking my friends if they wanted to Do A Fight
en: This League began like the last, with me asking my friends if they wanted to Do A Fight
ja: このリーグも前と同じで　友達に「戦う?」と声をかけるところから始まった

key: ...But what I didn't expect was for random-users to drop in from the greater Pokémon Online space and decide "Hey, this looks interesting!"
en: ...But what I didn't expect was for random-users to drop in from the greater Pokémon Online space and decide "Hey, this looks interesting!"
ja: ……でも予想外だったのは　ポケモンオンラインの広い世界から　見知らぬ人がふらっと来て　「なんかおもしろそう!」と居ついたこと

key: In this way, the league and community grew quite rapidly!
en: In this way, the league and community grew quite rapidly!
ja: こうして　リーグもコミュニティも　どんどん大きくなった!

key: And so, we hosted it nearly every weekday evening for several years.
en: And so, we hosted it nearly every weekday evening for several years.
ja: そして何年ものあいだ　ほぼ毎晩　平日の夜に開催した

key: It quickly got too much for me to handle alone, so eventually I had to ask for help.
en: It quickly got too much for me to handle alone, so eventually I had to ask for help.
ja: すぐに一人では手に負えなくなって　ついに助けを求めることになった

key: We used to do three battles per challenger per night,
en: We used to do three battles per challenger per night,
ja: 最初は挑戦者一人あたり　一晩に三戦

key: And then I had to limit it to just one as we got more and more,
en: And then I had to limit it to just one as we got more and more,
ja: 人が増えるにつれて　一戦だけに制限しなきゃいけなくなって

key: And then sometimes even at one battle per challenger, we'd still be up until two or three AM.
en: And then sometimes even at one battle per challenger, we'd still be up until two or three AM.
ja: それでも一戦ずつで　夜中の二時や三時までかかることもあった

key: Managing that, team registrations and trainer cards really was a full time job already.
en: Managing that, team registrations and trainer cards really was a full time job already.
ja: その運営と　パーティ登録と　トレーナーカードの管理。もうそれだけで立派な本業だった

key: But it was a lot of fun!
en: But it was a lot of fun!
ja: でも　すごく楽しかった!

key: My favorite part was how, when everyone was waiting for their own turn, the challengers would all pile into spectate each match.
en: My favorite part was how, when everyone was waiting for their own turn, the challengers would all pile into spectate each match.
ja: いちばん好きだったのは　自分の番を待つあいだ　挑戦者たちがみんなで観戦になだれこんでくるところ

key: There was a lot of wild cheering for either side, fifteen people to a very small chat log room...
en: There was a lot of wild cheering for either side, fifteen people to a very small chat log room...
ja: どちらにも大声援が飛んで　小さなチャット欄に十五人がひしめいて……

key: And people would chat with and get interested in the Leaders' personal stories.
en: And people would chat with and get interested in the Leaders' personal stories.
ja: みんなリーダーたちと話して　その身の上話に　のめりこんでいった

key: Many of the events in game are a reference to those online stories, such as Amaria losing her memory, and Luna disappearing.
en: Many of the events in game are a reference to those online stories, such as Amaria losing her memory, and Luna disappearing.
ja: ゲーム中の出来事の多くは　そのころの話が元になってる。アマリアが記憶をなくすことも　ルナが姿を消すことも

key: Shortly after sixth gen released, we made the difficult decision to retire the League for good.
en: Shortly after sixth gen released, we made the difficult decision to retire the League for good.
ja: 第六世代が出てまもなく　リーグを完全に終わらせるという　つらい決断をした

key: The bottom line is that I wasn't able to keep up with both running it and developing the game at the same time.
en: The bottom line is that I wasn't able to keep up with both running it and developing the game at the same time.
ja: 要するに　運営とゲーム開発を　両方こなすのが無理だったの

key: There were some other factors, like Pokémon Showdown becoming popular, and I wasn't entirely thrilled with the quality of recent matches and events.
en: There were some other factors, like Pokémon Showdown becoming popular, and I wasn't entirely thrilled with the quality of recent matches and events.
ja: ほかにも理由はあった。ポケモンショウダウンが流行したことや　最近の試合や催しの質に　あまり満足できなかったこととか

key: But even those things were just obstacles because the game was taking my time.
en: But even those things were just obstacles because the game was taking my time.
ja: でも　それも結局は　ゲームに時間を取られていたからこその障害だった

key: I hope everyone who was able to participate in the League has some fun memories from it!
en: I hope everyone who was able to participate in the League has some fun memories from it!
ja: リーグに参加できたみんなが　楽しい思い出を持っていてくれたらうれしい!

key: I know they were some of my favorite times ever <3
en: I know they were some of my favorite times ever <3
ja: わたしにとっては　人生でいちばん好きな時間のひとつだった <3

key: AME: When the League was at its peak, a few different users had the idea of,
en: AME: When the League was at its peak, a few different users had the idea of,
ja: アメ: リーグが最盛期のころ　何人かがこんなことを言い出したの

key: "What if we made a game based on the Reborn League?"
en: "What if we made a game based on the Reborn League?"
ja: 「リボーンリーグをもとにした　ゲームを作ってみたら?」

key: The first few fledgling passes at it from community members disappeared as quickly as they came.
en: The first few fledgling passes at it from community members disappeared as quickly as they came.
ja: コミュニティのメンバーによる最初の試みは　現れたのと同じ速さで消えていった

key: For my part, I didn't pay the wayward attempts much mind.
en: For my part, I didn't pay the wayward attempts much mind.
ja: わたし自身は　その行き当たりばったりの試みを　あまり気にしていなかった

key: I knew that trying to do that for all 18 Leaders would be an enormous undertaking that obviously no one would finish.
en: I knew that trying to do that for all 18 Leaders would be an enormous undertaking that obviously no one would finish.
ja: 18人のリーダー全員ぶんとなると　どう見ても誰も完成させられない大事業だと　分かっていたから

key: Also, I tried romhacking in the distant past.
en: Also, I tried romhacking in the distant past.
ja: それに　ずっと昔にロム改造を試したこともあった

key: I wanted to make, basically, Fire Red 386 since there wasn't a good difficulty + all availability game for Kanto like there was for Hoenn at the time.
en: I wanted to make, basically, Fire Red 386 since there wasn't a good difficulty + all availability game for Kanto like there was for Hoenn at the time.
ja: 要するにファイアレッド386を作りたかったの。当時ホウエンにはあった　高難度かつ全種入手のゲームが　カントーにはなかったから

key: Somehow I broke evolution by changing a Trainers' team.
en: Somehow I broke evolution by changing a Trainers' team.
ja: なぜかトレーナーの手持ちをいじったら　進化が壊れた

key: Decided pretty quickly romhacking wasn't for me.
en: Decided pretty quickly romhacking wasn't for me.
ja: ロム改造は自分に向いてないと　すぐに悟ったよ

key: However, there was an ongoing thread of discussion over the months about "What would Reborn look like if it were a region?"
en: However, there was an ongoing thread of discussion over the months about "What would Reborn look like if it were a region?"
ja: でも　何か月にもわたって　「リボーンが地方だったら　どんな姿になる?」という話は続いてた

key: One time in the PO server's earliest days, I signed off for the night as the sole admin and mod.
en: One time in the PO server's earliest days, I signed off for the night as the sole admin and mod.
ja: POサーバーの初期のある晩　たった一人の管理人であるわたしが　その夜は落ちてしまった

key: I'm not exactly clear what happened-- maybe a spammer or something came on?
en: I'm not exactly clear what happened-- maybe a spammer or something came on?
ja: 何が起きたのかは　はっきりしない――荒らしでも来たのかな?

key: Anyway, I wasn't there to deal with it, and havoc ensued.
en: Anyway, I wasn't there to deal with it, and havoc ensued.
ja: とにかく　対処する人間がいなくて　大混乱になった

key: One of the users on at the time, Will, then made an entire lore about how The City of Reborn Fell Into Chaos Because The Great Leader Ame Wasn't There.
en: One of the users on at the time, Will, then made an entire lore about how The City of Reborn Fell Into Chaos Because The Great Leader Ame Wasn't There.
ja: その場にいたウィルっていう人が　「偉大なる指導者アメが不在だったせいでリボーンの街は混乱に落ちた」という設定を　まるごと作り上げたの

key: He then started drawing +Infinitas, a comic about the leaders of Reborn facing off against the villainous Team Meteor, based on that premise...
en: He then started drawing +Infinitas, a comic about the leaders of Reborn facing off against the villainous Team Meteor, based on that premise...
ja: そしてそれを下敷きに　リボーンのリーダーたちが悪のメテオ団と戦う漫画　+Infinitasを描き始めた……

key: I liked the idea of a ruined city region.
en: I liked the idea of a ruined city region.
ja: 廃虚のような都市の地方　という考えが　わたしは気に入った

key: It felt more fresh compared to the lush, vapid environments of every other region.
en: It felt more fresh compared to the lush, vapid environments of every other region.
ja: ほかの地方の　緑豊かで中身のない風景に比べて　新鮮に感じられたの

key: To be honest, I also just like working with the concept of giant cities?
en: To be honest, I also just like working with the concept of giant cities?
ja: 正直に言うと　巨大都市というお題そのものが　好きなだけかも?

key: I find it likely this won't be my last.
en: I find it likely this won't be my last.
ja: たぶん　これが最後にはならないと思う

key: Anyway, one of those times people were talking about The Region, I started hand-drawing a map for it.
en: Anyway, one of those times people were talking about The Region, I started hand-drawing a map for it.
ja: とにかく　みんなが例の地方の話をしていたとき　わたしは手描きで地図を描き始めた

key: Did it on and off, took me two years to finish.
en: Did it on and off, took me two years to finish.
ja: 描いたり休んだりで　仕上げるのに二年かかった

key: I had a lot of fun, due to old habits, thinking about "What might this be like if it were a game?"
en: I had a lot of fun, due to old habits, thinking about "What might this be like if it were a game?"
ja: 昔からの癖で　「これがゲームだったら　どうなるかな?」と考えるのが　すごく楽しかった

key: But I had no intention to actually make it one.
en: But I had no intention to actually make it one.
ja: でも　実際に作るつもりは　まるでなかった

key: Then, in 2012 a Reborn member by the name of STK Patrick posted once again about making a game based on the online league.
en: Then, in 2012 a Reborn member by the name of STK Patrick posted once again about making a game based on the online league.
ja: そんな2012年　STKパトリックというメンバーが　またしても　オンラインリーグをもとにゲームを作る話を書きこんだ

key: He noted that a game called Pokémon Raptor had a working Pokémon engine.
en: He noted that a game called Pokémon Raptor had a working Pokémon engine.
ja: ポケモンラプターというゲームに　ちゃんと動くポケモンのエンジンがあると教えてくれたの

key: I was like, "huh, weird, how does that work?"
en: I was like, "huh, weird, how does that work?"
ja: わたしは「へえ　変なの　どういう仕組み?」って

key: He was like "oh it uses RPG Maker XP"
en: He was like "oh it uses RPG Maker XP"
ja: 彼は「ああ　RPGツクールXPを使ってるんだ」って

key: I was like "okay hold the goddamn phone rq,
en: I was like "okay hold the goddamn phone rq,
ja: わたしは「ちょっと待って　いったん止まって

key: because i spent the better part of my teenage years tooling around on Rm2k3 and RMXP on the side.
en: because i spent the better part of my teenage years tooling around on Rm2k3 and RMXP on the side.
ja: だってわたし　十代の大半をRm2k3とRMXPいじりに費やしてるんだけど

key: This is suddenly up my alley."
en: This is suddenly up my alley."
ja: それ　いきなり　ど真ん中なんだけど」

key: Pulled a "yo imma let you finish but--" on him (because that was an in-vogue meme at the time)
en: Pulled a "yo imma let you finish but--" on him (because that was an in-vogue meme at the time)
ja: 「話は最後まで聞くけどさ――」ってやつを　彼にかました(当時はやってたネタなの)

key: And made the first episode in two weeks.
en: And made the first episode in two weeks.
ja: そして二週間で　最初のエピソードを作った

key: I'm... not really sure how I managed that in two weeks other than that the episode kinda sucked at the time, and I didn't do anything else.
en: I'm... not really sure how I managed that in two weeks other than that the episode kinda sucked at the time, and I didn't do anything else.
ja: どうして二週間でできたのかは……当時のエピソードがけっこうひどかったのと　ほかに何もしていなかったから　としか言いようがない

key: Anyway, I pretty much just worked on the game during every class until I graduated...
en: Anyway, I pretty much just worked on the game during every class until I graduated...
ja: とにかく　卒業するまで　授業中はほぼずっとゲームを作ってた……

key: And the character assets already existed from the League, and I asked Will to give me some Team Meteor characters (Sirius and Solaris) for villains.
en: And the character assets already existed from the League, and I asked Will to give me some Team Meteor characters (Sirius and Solaris) for villains.
ja: キャラの素材はリーグの時点でそろってたし　悪役用にメテオ団のキャラ(シリウスとソラリス)を　ウィルに作ってもらった

key: The community had some fun roleplaying events VS Team Meteor on the server, and another user, Ice, had contributed the characters of Taka and ZEL.
en: The community had some fun roleplaying events VS Team Meteor on the server, and another user, Ice, had contributed the characters of Taka and ZEL.
ja: サーバーではメテオ団と戦うなりきり企画も盛り上がって　アイスという人がタカとZELを出してくれた

key: Ace came later, and everyone else came from the League itself.
en: Ace came later, and everyone else came from the League itself.
ja: エースは後から来て　ほかのみんなはリーグそのものから来てる

key: When I first started, I figured I'd get bored of it quickly.
en: When I first started, I figured I'd get bored of it quickly.
ja: 始めたころは　すぐに飽きるだろうと思ってた

key: Maybe drop the project after a couple months like most of my past ones.
en: Maybe drop the project after a couple months like most of my past ones.
ja: 過去の作品の大半みたいに　二、三か月で投げ出すんだろうって

key: ...You can see how that went.
en: ...You can see how that went.
ja: ……結果はごらんのとおり

key: Because I thought I'd get bored, I didn't bother to figure out where the game was actually going until Heather first showed up in Malchous.
en: Because I thought I'd get bored, I didn't bother to figure out where the game was actually going until Heather first showed up in Malchous.
ja: 飽きると思ってたから　ヘザーがマルカス森に初めて出てくるまで　この物語がどこへ向かうのか　考えようともしなかった

key: Then I'm like, oh, maybe I should like make a plan for anything.
en: Then I'm like, oh, maybe I should like make a plan for anything.
ja: そこでようやく　あ　そろそろ何か計画を立てた方がいいかも　って

key: I figured out a story based around fitting in all of the existing league characters, and four macguffins to help tie them together.
en: I figured out a story based around fitting in all of the existing league characters, and four macguffins to help tie them together.
ja: 既存のリーグキャラを全員はめこむことを軸に　筋書きを組み立てて　それをつなぐ四つの鍵をこしらえた

key: Originally I expected this to only be an in-community game, but then people started telling their friends about it and joining because of it...
en: Originally I expected this to only be an in-community game, but then people started telling their friends about it and joining because of it...
ja: もとはコミュニティ内だけのゲームのつもりだった。でも　みんなが友達に話して　それで新しい人が入ってきて……

key: Over time I pivoted to make the game more accessible to anyone, even those who hadn't been in the League.
en: Over time I pivoted to make the game more accessible to anyone, even those who hadn't been in the League.
ja: そのうち　リーグを知らない人でも入りやすいゲームへと　方向を変えていった

key: So, I continued as the sole developer, and released episodes every 2-5 months at a steady pace...
en: So, I continued as the sole developer, and released episodes every 2-5 months at a steady pace...
ja: こうして　たった一人の開発者として続けて　2か月から5か月おきに　こつこつエピソードを出していった……

key: And I hit a wall around E14 (ending with Terra, released late 2014).
en: And I hit a wall around E14 (ending with Terra, released late 2014).
ja: そしてE14(テラで終わる　2014年終わりの公開)のあたりで　壁にぶつかった

key: I started wanting to focus on making the game Better as opposed to just More, which increased development time exponentially.
en: I started wanting to focus on making the game Better as opposed to just More, which increased development time exponentially.
ja: ゲームを「もっと多く」ではなく「もっと良く」したいと思い始めて　開発期間がねずみ算式にふくらんだ

key: Suddenly releases took half a year to a year and a half, rather than just a few months each.
en: Suddenly releases took half a year to a year and a half, rather than just a few months each.
ja: 気づけば公開の間隔は　数か月ではなく　半年から一年半に

key: I wasn't ready for that.
en: I wasn't ready for that.
ja: そんな覚悟は　できていなかった

key: I blamed myself for taking too long, and went from doing almost nothing else to -actually- nothing else.
en: I blamed myself for taking too long, and went from doing almost nothing else to -actually- nothing else.
ja: 遅い自分を責めて　ほとんど何もしない生活から　本当に何もしない生活になった

key: I pushed myself very hard to be perfectly productive, always trying to get E15 out faster because,
en: I pushed myself very hard to be perfectly productive, always trying to get E15 out faster because,
ja: 完ぺきに生産的であろうと　自分を追いつめた。E15を少しでも早く出そうとして　だって

key: Like E14 (Terra) to E15 (Ciel) is not a lot of content, why is it taking so long??????
en: Like E14 (Terra) to E15 (Ciel) is not a lot of content, why is it taking so long??????
ja: E14(テラ)からE15(シエル)なんて　中身は多くないのに　なんでこんなに時間がかかるの??????

key: It took around a year in the end with all the other improvements.
en: It took around a year in the end with all the other improvements.
ja: 結局　ほかの改良も合わせて　一年ほどかかった

key: I also began to develop chronic pain in my hands, which I was determined not to let stop me.
en: I also began to develop chronic pain in my hands, which I was determined not to let stop me.
ja: そのころ　手に慢性の痛みが出始めたけど　それで止まるものかと思ってた

key: Eventually I physically couldn't click the mouse, and I had to ease up.
en: Eventually I physically couldn't click the mouse, and I had to ease up.
ja: やがて　物理的にマウスが押せなくなって　手をゆるめるしかなくなった

key: When I stepped back, I realized that the stress of pushing myself to work constantly was what was causing that pain.
en: When I stepped back, I realized that the stress of pushing myself to work constantly was what was causing that pain.
ja: 一歩引いてみて分かった。休みなく働こうと自分を追いつめる　そのストレスが　あの痛みの原因だったの

key: Unlearning that is an ongoing process, and I still feel the pain from time to time.
en: Unlearning that is an ongoing process, and I still feel the pain from time to time.
ja: その癖を捨てる作業は今も途中で　痛みは今でもときどき出る

key: Right now, as I'm saying this, for instance.
en: Right now, as I'm saying this, for instance.
ja: たとえば　こうして話している　今この瞬間にも

key: But at least I have it mostly under control, and I've learned to pace myself better, take breaks, play nice with a team, etc.
en: But at least I have it mostly under control, and I've learned to pace myself better, take breaks, play nice with a team, etc.
ja: それでも　だいたいは制御できてるし　配分を考えることも　休むことも　チームとうまくやることも　覚えた

key: I still have some recurring of psychic damage from the amount it's taken to complete a passion project that I started on a whim...
en: I still have some recurring of psychic damage from the amount it's taken to complete a passion project that I started on a whim...
ja: 思いつきで始めた情熱の産物を　完成させるまでにかかった代償は　今も心にじわじわ効いてくるけど……

key: I wonder how many other games I'll have time to make?
en: I wonder how many other games I'll have time to make?
ja: この先　あといくつゲームを作る時間があるんだろう?

key: But, I'm trying to learn to be proud of the amount of time and energy we spent on this.
en: But, I'm trying to learn to be proud of the amount of time and energy we spent on this.
ja: でも　これに注いだ時間と労力を　誇りに思えるようになろうとしてる

key: Not many games get the full attention and scope they deserve.
en: Not many games get the full attention and scope they deserve.
ja: ふさわしいだけの手間と広がりをもらえるゲームなんて　そう多くない

key: And honestly, of all things? I'm not sure a Pokémon fangame deserved it.
en: And honestly, of all things? I'm not sure a Pokémon fangame deserved it.
ja: 正直　よりによってポケモンのファンゲームが　それに値したかは　あやしいけどね

key: Still, here we are.
en: Still, here we are.
ja: それでも　こうしてここにいる

key: Ten years working on one project is nothing to sneeze at.
en: Ten years working on one project is nothing to sneeze at.
ja: ひとつの企画に十年。ばかにできる話じゃない

key: I hope it shows?
en: I hope it shows?
ja: その分　伝わってるといいな

key: AME: So, here's the story from my perspective.
en: AME: So, here's the story from my perspective.
ja: アメ: じゃあ　わたしの側から見た話をするね

key: I started running the online league by myself, blahblahblah, you can read about all of that in the other dialogue option.
en: I started running the online league by myself, blahblahblah, you can read about all of that in the other dialogue option.
ja: オンラインリーグを一人で始めて　うんぬんかんぬん――その辺は別の話題で読んで

key: Originally, I was just roleplaying the Leader characters.
en: Originally, I was just roleplaying the Leader characters.
ja: もともとは　リーダーたちを　わたしが演じていただけ

key: Logistically, that meant I just signed on a second account and acted like them, nothing fancy.
en: Logistically, that meant I just signed on a second account and acted like them, nothing fancy.
ja: 実際のところ　別のアカウントで入って　それらしくふるまうだけ。大したことはしてない

key: When I was doing this challenge just for friends, there was no confusion about that.
en: When I was doing this challenge just for friends, there was no confusion about that.
ja: 友達だけを相手にしてたころは　誰もそれを勘違いしなかった

key: In fact, one time my IRL friend, Saya, decided to do a league battle during a rehearsal lunch break.
en: In fact, one time my IRL friend, Saya, decided to do a league battle during a rehearsal lunch break.
ja: 実際　現実の友達のサヤが　演劇の練習の昼休みにリーグ戦をやると言い出したことがある

key: I fought as Hardy, who, at the time, played singles stall rather than doubles hyper offense.
en: I fought as Hardy, who, at the time, played singles stall rather than doubles hyper offense.
ja: わたしはハーディとして戦った。当時の彼は　ダブルの超攻撃型じゃなくて　シングルの受け型だったの

key: Hardy's Shuckle vs their Empoleon...
en: Hardy's Shuckle vs their Empoleon...
ja: ハーディのツボツボ　対　サヤのエンペルト……

key: The battle took 200 turns...
en: The battle took 200 turns...
ja: その戦いは　200ターンかかった……

key: ...We got yelled at for being very late.
en: ...We got yelled at for being very late.
ja: ……そして　大遅刻して　こっぴどく怒られた

key: Anyway, the point is, for the original challengers of the League, they knew exactly who was behind the leaders.
en: Anyway, the point is, for the original challengers of the League, they knew exactly who was behind the leaders.
ja: とにかく　言いたいのは　初期の挑戦者たちは　リーダーの中身が誰かを　はっきり分かっていたということ

key: We were just across the table from each other.
en: We were just across the table from each other.
ja: だって　机をはさんで向かい合ってたんだから

key: I never expected there to be any doubt that they were just me all along.
en: I never expected there to be any doubt that they were just me all along.
ja: 全部わたしだということに　疑いの余地があるなんて　思ってもみなかった

key: Then, in the early days of the PO server, a user named Mashew joined at random and became interested in the league and its characters.
en: Then, in the early days of the PO server, a user named Mashew joined at random and became interested in the league and its characters.
ja: ところがPOサーバーの初期に　マシューという人がふらっと入ってきて　リーグとそのキャラたちに興味を持った

key: Only, he didn't realize they weren't real.
en: Only, he didn't realize they weren't real.
ja: ただ　彼は　それが実在しないと気づいていなかった

key: There was no question of it, he just accepted that they were.
en: There was no question of it, he just accepted that they were.
ja: 疑いもせず　実在するものとして　受け入れていたの

key: This surprised me.
en: This surprised me.
ja: これには　おどろいた

key: He seemed to be having a lot of fun and getting personally invested in their stories, so I didn't correct him.
en: He seemed to be having a lot of fun and getting personally invested in their stories, so I didn't correct him.
ja: 彼はとても楽しそうで　その身の上話にのめりこんでいたから　訂正しなかった

key: After all, it was way more fun to add some character, some drama, and play out a bit of conflict with them.
en: After all, it was way more fun to add some character, some drama, and play out a bit of conflict with them.
ja: だって　人格を足して　劇を足して　ちょっとした衝突を演じる方が　ずっと楽しかったから

key: When others started joining after him, they seemed to believe it all too.
en: When others started joining after him, they seemed to believe it all too.
ja: 彼のあとから来た人たちも　みんなそれを信じているようだった

key: One example was Savage, who you might recall from the story in Lapis. That was a real thing that really happened in the League for some reason.
en: One example was Savage, who you might recall from the story in Lapis. That was a real thing that really happened in the League for some reason.
ja: たとえばサヴェッジ。ラピス区の話で覚えているかも。あれは　なぜか　リーグで実際に起きた出来事なの

key: Even the people who originally knew that I was just roleplaying implicitly began to play along.
en: Even the people who originally knew that I was just roleplaying implicitly began to play along.
ja: 最初から演技だと知っていた人たちまで　なんとなく話を合わせ始めた

key: They seemed to get very into it.
en: They seemed to get very into it.
ja: みんな　かなり本気で　のめりこんでいるようだった

key: I wondered if everyone, including Saya, had just forgotten that it was me.
en: I wondered if everyone, including Saya, had just forgotten that it was me.
ja: サヤも含めて　みんな　中身がわたしだと忘れてしまったんだろうかと思った

key: Months passed like this, and it was hard to keep up with all the challengers.
en: Months passed like this, and it was hard to keep up with all the challengers.
ja: そうして何か月も過ぎて　挑戦者をさばききるのが　つらくなっていった

key: I ran 17 different monotypes, 5 nights a week, alone.
en: I ran 17 different monotypes, 5 nights a week, alone.
ja: 17種類の単タイプを　週に五晩　たった一人で回してた

key: On average, I think there were 20-30 challengers a night.
en: On average, I think there were 20-30 challengers a night.
ja: 一晩あたり　平均で20人から30人の挑戦者

key: Hundreds over time.
en: Hundreds over time.
ja: 積み重なれば　何百人にもなる

key: It was... difficult.
en: It was... difficult.
ja: あれは……きつかった

key: I invented the "sorry Luna disappeared arc" one night as an excuse to not have to play her when I wasn't up to it.
en: I invented the "sorry Luna disappeared arc" one night as an excuse to not have to play her when I wasn't up to it.
ja: 「ルナが失そうしました」という筋書きは　ある晩　彼女を演じる気力がないときの言い訳として　でっち上げたもの

key: Other nights when I was just super stressed out and not feeling it, I pushed on anyway.
en: Other nights when I was just super stressed out and not feeling it, I pushed on anyway.
ja: ほかの晩は　どんなに参っていても　気が乗らなくても　無理やり続けた

key: Playing Terra and trying to capture her hyperness online, while crying about something or other IRL...
en: Playing Terra and trying to capture her hyperness online, while crying about something or other IRL...
ja: テラを演じて　あのはじけっぷりを画面越しに出そうとしながら　現実では何かのことで泣いていたり……

key: That was just the worst.
en: That was just the worst.
ja: あれは　本当に最悪だった

key: Saya happened to show up at my house on one of those nights.
en: Saya happened to show up at my house on one of those nights.
ja: そんな晩のひとつに　たまたまサヤが家に来た

key: I found out, she didn't forget it was me playing it, she was just going along with everyone else.
en: I found out, she didn't forget it was me playing it, she was just going along with everyone else.
ja: そこで分かったの。彼女はわたしだと忘れていたんじゃなくて　みんなに話を合わせていただけだって

key: And everyone seemed to have a lot of fun accepting the different characters at surface level.
en: And everyone seemed to have a lot of fun accepting the different characters at surface level.
ja: そして　みんな　キャラたちを額面どおりに受け入れることを　心から楽しんでいるようだった

key: It felt nice to not be entirely alone in keeping the secret.
en: It felt nice to not be entirely alone in keeping the secret.
ja: 秘密を抱えているのが　完全な独りぼっちではないと分かって　救われた

key: In Febuary of 2011, I realized that hosting the League by myself was absolutely unsustainable.
en: In Febuary of 2011, I realized that hosting the League by myself was absolutely unsustainable.
ja: 2011年2月　一人でリーグを回すのは　どう考えても続かないと悟った

key: The volume of challengers was too high.
en: The volume of challengers was too high.
ja: 挑戦者の数が　多すぎたの

key: There was just too much for one person to handle.
en: There was just too much for one person to handle.
ja: 一人で背負うには　あまりにも多すぎた

key: I confided in our co-admin, Ikaru, who joined us in the fall of the year prior, after the Leaders' had already been accepted as a force of nature.
en: I confided in our co-admin, Ikaru, who joined us in the fall of the year prior, after the Leaders' had already been accepted as a force of nature.
ja: そこで共同管理人のイカルに打ち明けた。彼は前の年の秋に来た人で　そのころにはもうリーダーたちは　当たり前の存在として受け入れられていた

key: He was very invested in Titania, and finding out that the character who was so motivated by the notion of living up to truth, was herself a lie, hurt him.
en: He was very invested in Titania, and finding out that the character who was so motivated by the notion of living up to truth, was herself a lie, hurt him.
ja: 彼はティタニアに強く思い入れていた。真実に恥じずに生きることを信条にしていたその人物が　当人こそ偽りだったと知って　彼は傷ついた

key: I'm very grateful for his forgiveness, and that he stuck around to support the league and game despite that.
en: I'm very grateful for his forgiveness, and that he stuck around to support the league and game despite that.
ja: それでも許してくれて　リーグとゲームを支え続けてくれたことに　心から感謝してる

key: Ikaru and Saya became my first co-hosts of the league, and joined me in hosting and roleplaying the leaders.
en: Ikaru and Saya became my first co-hosts of the league, and joined me in hosting and roleplaying the leaders.
ja: イカルとサヤが　リーグ初の共同運営になって　いっしょに運営とリーダーの演技をしてくれた

key: Even splitting them to a third between us, we barely kept up with the challenger volume.
en: Even splitting them to a third between us, we barely kept up with the challenger volume.
ja: 三人で分担しても　挑戦者の数には　やっとついていける程度

key: Also, it was stressful for them to have to keep up with every night too.
en: Also, it was stressful for them to have to keep up with every night too.
ja: それに　毎晩付き合うのは　二人にとっても負担だった

key: We swapped out League Hosts over the next few years, being joined by Mashew, Ash, Hark, and several others,
en: We swapped out League Hosts over the next few years, being joined by Mashew, Ash, Hark, and several others,
ja: その後の数年で運営は入れ替わっていって　マシュー　アッシュ　ハーク　ほか何人かが加わってくれた

key: All of whom I'm very grateful to for helping manage the disaster traffic I'd amassed.
en: All of whom I'm very grateful to for helping manage the disaster traffic I'd amassed.
ja: わたしが呼びこんでしまった　あの災害級の人の波をさばくのを手伝ってくれた全員に　深く感謝してる

key: In general, it was never one player to one specific Leader though.
en: In general, it was never one player to one specific Leader though.
ja: とはいえ　基本的に　一人が特定のリーダー一人を受け持つ　という形ではなかった

key: I could barely keep the three or four of us in place each night, let alone a full roster of 17-18.
en: I could barely keep the three or four of us in place each night, let alone a full roster of 17-18.
ja: 毎晩三人か四人そろえるのがやっとで　17人18人の顔ぶれをそろえるなんて　とても無理

key: There were two exceptions, being that for much of Season 2, I only played Amaria,
en: There were two exceptions, being that for much of Season 2, I only played Amaria,
ja: 例外は二つ。シーズン2の大半で　わたしはアマリアしか演じなかったこと

key: And for a while we had one line leader by the name of Tenshi, who played Lin.
en: And for a while we had one line leader by the name of Tenshi, who played Lin.
ja: そしてしばらくのあいだ　テンシという人が　リンを専任で演じていたこと

key: I was never terribly enthused with his capacity for roleplaying, but he was an excellent battler who swept through the League without batting an eye.
en: I was never terribly enthused with his capacity for roleplaying, but he was an excellent battler who swept through the League without batting an eye.
ja: 彼の演技力には　あまり感心しなかったけど　対戦の腕は一流で　顔色ひとつ変えずにリーグを制圧していった

key: However, he eventually decided to leave the community,
en: However, he eventually decided to leave the community,
ja: でも　彼はやがて　コミュニティを去ることにした

key: And he did so by posting a sudden resignation announcement in which he basically said,
en: And he did so by posting a sudden resignation announcement in which he basically said,
ja: しかも　突然の脱退宣言を書きこんで　こう言い残したの

key: "The Leaders are all fake and being played by us, and I'm sick of it, bye"
en: "The Leaders are all fake and being played by us, and I'm sick of it, bye"
ja: 「リーダーはみんな作り物で　オレたちが演じてる。もううんざりだ　さよなら」

key: I thought, okay, that's it, jig's up, go home.
en: I thought, okay, that's it, jig's up, go home.
ja: これで終わり　ばれた　解散だ　と思った

key: Going to be a lot less interesting entertaining my crowd of hundreds when they know it's just us in different hats.
en: Going to be a lot less interesting entertaining my crowd of hundreds when they know it's just us in different hats.
ja: 何百人もの観客が　中身は帽子を変えただけの自分たちだと知ったら　もうそんなに楽しくないだろうって

key: I was surprised by what happened next.
en: I was surprised by what happened next.
ja: でも　次に起きたことには　おどろかされた

key: Obviously there were the handful of people who knew, and the handful of people who Thought So but didn't Know-know...
en: Obviously there were the handful of people who knew, and the handful of people who Thought So but didn't Know-know...
ja: もちろん　知っている人が何人かいて　そうだろうと思ってはいたけど確信はない人も何人かいた……

key: But the general tone of the community was,
en: But the general tone of the community was,
ja: でも　コミュニティ全体の空気は　こうだった

key: It's more fun to accept them as real, so let's just let the new folk keep believing that so they can enjoy it too.
en: It's more fun to accept them as real, so let's just let the new folk keep believing that so they can enjoy it too.
ja: 実在するものとして受け入れる方が楽しい。だから新しい人にも　そのまま信じさせて　いっしょに楽しんでもらおう　って

key: The game began to be a thing at some point after that, and the League stopped being a thing at some point later,
en: The game began to be a thing at some point after that, and the League stopped being a thing at some point later,
ja: そのあとしばらくしてゲームが動き出し　さらにあとでリーグが終わった

key: But this was always still meant to be a community game, so it seemed like everyone implicitly accepted the same thing.
en: But this was always still meant to be a community game, so it seemed like everyone implicitly accepted the same thing.
ja: でもこれはずっとコミュニティのゲームのつもりだったから　みんな暗黙のうちに　同じことを受け入れていたみたい

key: More fun to let the new players think it was all real.
en: More fun to let the new players think it was all real.
ja: 新しい人には　全部本当だと思わせておく方が楽しい　と

key: I decided I'd keep it up until the game finished, but I really expected that to be, like, six years ago or so as opposed to only just now.
en: I decided I'd keep it up until the game finished, but I really expected that to be, like, six years ago or so as opposed to only just now.
ja: ゲームが完成するまでは続けようと決めた。もっとも　その完成は　今ではなく　六年くらい前だと本気で思ってたけどね

key: I've been tired of that all forever, but sunken cost is one hell of a drug.
en: I've been tired of that all forever, but sunken cost is one hell of a drug.
ja: ずっと前からうんざりしてた。でも　つぎこんだものへの未練は　おそろしい薬なの

key: Recently, there's been a lot of people who are morally concerned about it too--
en: Recently, there's been a lot of people who are morally concerned about it too--
ja: 最近は　これを道義的に気にする人も増えてきた――

key: About whether or not it was okay for us to show things like Corey and Kiki, given their respective fates (which were story points in the online league too)
en: About whether or not it was okay for us to show things like Corey and Kiki, given their respective fates (which were story points in the online league too)
ja: コーリーやキキのような描写が　それぞれの結末を思えば　許されることだったのか(あれもオンラインリーグでの筋書きだった)

key: And whether we got the express consent of the Leaders to be featured here...
en: And whether we got the express consent of the Leaders to be featured here...
ja: そして　リーダーたちの明確な同意を得て　ここに登場させたのか……

key: ...And while those are fair concerns, they don't really apply.
en: ...And while those are fair concerns, they don't really apply.
ja: ……もっともな心配ではあるけど　どれも当てはまらない

key: They were all just fictional characters all along.
en: They were all just fictional characters all along.
ja: 彼らは　最初から　ただの架空の人物だったのだから

key: To some this will be disappointing; to others, a relief.
en: To some this will be disappointing; to others, a relief.
ja: ある人にはがっかりする話で　ある人には　ほっとする話だと思う

key: For myself, it's the latter.
en: For myself, it's the latter.
ja: わたしにとっては　後者

key: I'm grateful to have this out in the open again so I can talk more freely about it.
en: I'm grateful to have this out in the open again so I can talk more freely about it.
ja: またこうして表に出して　もっと自由に話せるようになったことが　ありがたい

key: I hope that everyone will forgive me for keeping up the facade for more than a decade.
en: I hope that everyone will forgive me for keeping up the facade for more than a decade.
ja: 十年以上　見せかけを続けたことを　みんなが許してくれたらと思う

key: I understand if not.
en: I understand if not.
ja: 許せなくても　それは分かる

key: Maybe let the new players have their fun still?
en: Maybe let the new players have their fun still?
ja: それでも　新しい人には　楽しませてあげてくれる?

key: Maybe not.
en: Maybe not.
ja: だめかな

key: It's in your hands now.
en: It's in your hands now.
ja: もう　あなたたち次第だよ

key: AME: So like I said in the other dialogue options, I started this game alone...
en: AME: So like I said in the other dialogue options, I started this game alone...
ja: アメ: ほかの話題でも言ったとおり　このゲームは一人で始めたの……

key: Really never was great at the whole working with others thing?
en: Really never was great at the whole working with others thing?
ja: そもそも　人と組んで働くのが　昔から得意じゃなくてね

key: I was like, weirdly afraid if I let someone else access the game's files, they'd just delete everything and run screeching into the night like some kind of gremlin.
en: I was like, weirdly afraid if I let someone else access the game's files, they'd just delete everything and run screeching into the night like some kind of gremlin.
ja: 誰かにゲームのファイルを触らせたら　全部消してから　小鬼みたいに叫びながら夜へ走り去るんじゃないかって　妙におびえてた

key: Obviously, that's ridiculous and most people just want to help.
en: Obviously, that's ridiculous and most people just want to help.
ja: もちろん　ばかげた話で　たいていの人は　ただ力になりたいだけ

key: I first started working with a team directly when The Amount Of Things That Needed To Be Done escalated in 2013 after the E13 (Charlotte) release.
en: I first started working with a team directly when The Amount Of Things That Needed To Be Done escalated in 2013 after the E13 (Charlotte) release.
ja: 本格的にチームで動き始めたのは　E13(シャルロット)公開後の2013年　やるべきことの量がふくれ上がったときから

key: Realistically, my standards just rose, but I needed help, so I started working with two good friends, Autumn and Blind Guardian (or Dan).
en: Realistically, my standards just rose, but I needed help, so I started working with two good friends, Autumn and Blind Guardian (or Dan).
ja: 現実には　自分の基準が上がっただけ。でも助けが必要で　親しい友人二人　オータムとブラインドガーディアン(通称ダン)と組み始めた

key: You can thank Autumn for a lot of the animations in the game, especially the over the top ones like many of the Z-Moves!
en: You can thank Autumn for a lot of the animations in the game, especially the over the top ones like many of the Z-Moves!
ja: ゲーム中のアニメーションの多くは　オータムのおかげ。とくにZワザみたいな　やりすぎなやつはね!

key: Dan helped shore up the bleeding scripts, and first encouraged me to try implementing the Field Effect system. He also made it so fields changed visually!
en: Dan helped shore up the bleeding scripts, and first encouraged me to try implementing the Field Effect system. He also made it so fields changed visually!
ja: ダンは血を流していたスクリプトを支えてくれて　フィールド効果の仕組みを試すよう　最初にすすめてくれた人。フィールドが見た目でも変わるようにしたのも彼!

key: But at first, they just helped with testing.
en: But at first, they just helped with testing.
ja: でも最初は　二人ともテストを手伝ってくれていただけ

key: We packed into a call, Autumn would play through the game with some ridiculous team probably involving a Castform,
en: We packed into a call, Autumn would play through the game with some ridiculous team probably involving a Castform,
ja: 通話につめこまれて　オータムはたぶんポワルンの入ったとんでもないパーティで遊び進めて

key: Dan would fix script errors, and I would do whatever else it was that needed doing and also probably stress out a little bit.
en: Dan would fix script errors, and I would do whatever else it was that needed doing and also probably stress out a little bit.
ja: ダンがスクリプトの不具合を直して　わたしは残りの必要な作業を全部やって　ついでに少し参ってた

key: It was a lot of fun!
en: It was a lot of fun!
ja: すごく楽しかった!

key: I was sad when that groove came to an end, but I still needed help.
en: I was sad when that groove came to an end, but I still needed help.
ja: あの流れが終わったのはさびしかったけど　助けはまだ必要だった

key: The early versions of Essentials were incomplete, and subsequent generations made that gap worse.
en: The early versions of Essentials were incomplete, and subsequent generations made that gap worse.
ja: 初期のエッセンシャルズは未完成で　世代が進むたびに　その差は広がっていった

key: Despite running a website, I was still a fledging programmer, and I couldn't fix it all myself.
en: Despite running a website, I was still a fledging programmer, and I couldn't fix it all myself.
ja: サイトを運営してはいても　わたしはまだ駆け出しの書き手で　全部は直せなかった

key: I got some help from someone I met in a game called Guhorden!
en: I got some help from someone I met in a game called Guhorden!
ja: そこで　グホーデンというゲームで知り合った人に　手伝ってもらったの!

key: I feel like of everyone who's helped out on development, I know the least about him...
en: I feel like of everyone who's helped out on development, I know the least about him...
ja: 開発を手伝ってくれた人の中で　彼のことがいちばん分からない気がする……

key: But he offered his services where they were much needed, and I appreciated it a lot.
en: But he offered his services where they were much needed, and I appreciated it a lot.
ja: でも　いちばん必要なところに手を貸してくれて　本当にありがたかった

key: The next to offer was Kurotsune, near the end of E14 when they were very drunk.
en: The next to offer was Kurotsune, near the end of E14 when they were very drunk.
ja: 次に申し出てくれたのはクロツネ。E14の終わりごろ　かなり酔っぱらった状態で

key: I had never talked to this person, and I was still pretty distrustful of Why Would This Rando Want To Help Me?
en: I had never talked to this person, and I was still pretty distrustful of Why Would This Rando Want To Help Me?
ja: 話したこともない相手で　「見ず知らずのこの人が　なんでわたしを助けたがるの?」と　まだかなり疑ってた

key: Which in retrospect was completely silly.
en: Which in retrospect was completely silly.
ja: 今思えば　まったくばかげた話

key: Kuro became an invaluable mentor to me both in terms of good programming habits (sorry about the indentation!!!) and organizing a team.
en: Kuro became an invaluable mentor to me both in terms of good programming habits (sorry about the indentation!!!) and organizing a team.
ja: クロは　良い書き方の習慣(字下げのことはごめん!!!)でも　チームのまとめ方でも　かけがえのない師になってくれた

key: They undertook the initiative to get a few more hands in to help finish the rest of the new-gen additions to the battle system.
en: They undertook the initiative to get a few more hands in to help finish the rest of the new-gen additions to the battle system.
ja: 戦闘まわりの新世代要素を仕上げるために　自分から何人か人手を集めてくれたの

key: Notably from that, we picked up Mike and Marcello!
en: Notably from that, we picked up Mike and Marcello!
ja: そのおかげで　マイクとマルチェロが加わった!

key: I felt bad because the process of development seemed to age Mike a half-decade at least,
en: I felt bad because the process of development seemed to age Mike a half-decade at least,
ja: 開発のせいで　マイクは少なくとも五年ぶん老けたように見えて　申し訳なかった

key: And, like, same.
en: And, like, same.
ja: まあ　わたしも同じだけど

key: But it seems he's back at it with his own work now so maybe that'll be a project worth checking out, ne?
en: But it seems he's back at it with his own work now so maybe that'll be a project worth checking out, ne?
ja: でも今は自分の作品で復帰したみたいだから　のぞいてみる価値はあるかもね

key: And Marcello went from being someone who I knew was helping out with the game but had never spoken to, to being one of my best friends. So that's neat!
en: And Marcello went from being someone who I knew was helping out with the game but had never spoken to, to being one of my best friends. So that's neat!
ja: マルチェロは　手伝ってくれてるのは知ってるけど話したことはない人　から　いちばんの親友の一人になった。すてきでしょ!

key: You can thank him for online existing in its current form!
en: You can thank him for online existing in its current form!
ja: 今のかたちで通信対戦が動いてるのは　彼のおかげ!

key: I followed suit, getting together a team to help out with all the missing animations around that time.
en: I followed suit, getting together a team to help out with all the missing animations around that time.
ja: わたしもそれにならって　そのころ　足りないアニメーションを埋めるための人を集めた

key: Smeargle and MDE were the main two I picked up from that!
en: Smeargle and MDE were the main two I picked up from that!
ja: そこで来てくれた中心の二人が　スメアグルとMDE!

key: I'm pretty sure the M in MDE stood for "machine" because man, he cranked them out.
en: I'm pretty sure the M in MDE stood for "machine" because man, he cranked them out.
ja: MDEのMは「機械」の意味だと思ってる。とにかく　すごい勢いで量産してくれたから

key: I think he still holds the title for having made the most animations in the game.
en: I think he still holds the title for having made the most animations in the game.
ja: ゲーム内で最も多くのアニメーションを作った記録は　今も彼が持ってるはず

key: He was very reliable and patient while I asked him for revisions eight times over!
en: He was very reliable and patient while I asked him for revisions eight times over!
ja: 八回も直しをお願いしても　とても頼りになって　辛抱強かった!

key: Meanwhile our resident Smeargletail has done quite a lot on his own too, and tends to hit them out of the park with a lot of care and energy!
en: Meanwhile our resident Smeargletail has done quite a lot on his own too, and tends to hit them out of the park with a lot of care and energy!
ja: 一方、当スタジオ専属のスメアギルテイルも一人で大活躍していて、いつも丁寧かつ情熱的に仕事を仕上げてくれています!

key: He also made all the slick Legendary overworld animations you might see in postgame.
en: He also made all the slick Legendary overworld animations you might see in postgame.
ja: クリア後で見かけるような、なめらかな伝説ポケモンのフィールドアニメーションも彼が手がけてくれました。

key: We picked up one more animator down the line after MDE moved on, Vulpes!
en: We picked up one more animator down the line after MDE moved on, Vulpes!
ja: MDEが抜けた後、もう一人アニメーターが加わりました、ヴルペスです!

key: She seems to be the shy type, but she came with experience, and pretty much every animation she's done has been a banger out the gate.
en: She seems to be the shy type, but she came with experience, and pretty much every animation she's done has been a banger out the gate.
ja: 人見知りなタイプのようですが、経験は豊富で、手がけたアニメーションはほぼ全て最初から大当たりでした。

key: Others who've helped along the way include Azery and Lia, who we brought on for general bug-fixing.
en: Others who've helped along the way include Azery and Lia, who we brought on for general bug-fixing.
ja: その他、道中で手伝ってくれた人にはアゼリーとリアがいて、主にバグ修正で活躍してくれました。

key: There was a lot of it...
en: There was a lot of it...
ja: バグは山ほどありましたが……

key: Kanaya and another friend of mine, I'd asked to help out with small tasks like filling in cliffs around the entire desert...
en: Kanaya and another friend of mine, I'd asked to help out with small tasks like filling in cliffs around the entire desert...
ja: カナヤと、もう一人の友達には、砂漠全体の崖を埋めるみたいな細かい作業を頼んだんだけど……

key: Seriously, it took two of them two weeks of working on it reliably to get all of that done.
en: Seriously, it took two of them two weeks of working on it reliably to get all of that done.
ja: マジで、二人がかりで二週間、みっちり作業してやっと終わったくらいだから。

key: Not to mention the other areas they helped with...
en: Not to mention the other areas they helped with...
ja: 他にも色々手伝ってもらったエリアがあって……

key: Much appreciation to them for trudging through all of that despite me kind of giving them the short end of the stick.
en: Much appreciation to them for trudging through all of that despite me kind of giving them the short end of the stick.
ja: ちょっと貧乏くじを引かせちゃったのに、最後までやり遂げてくれた二人には本当に感謝してる。

key: Ikaru's another person who's helped out with filling in my ridiculous maps, along with just general handling of bug reports.
en: Ikaru's another person who's helped out with filling in my ridiculous maps, along with just general handling of bug reports.
ja: イカルも、あたしのめちゃくちゃなマップを埋める作業を手伝ってくれた一人で、バグ報告の全般的な対応もしてくれた。

key: He's also usually the first person I test with, watching his every playthrough and judging his actions!
en: He's also usually the first person I test with, watching his every playthrough and judging his actions!
ja: 大抵一番最初にテストプレイしてもらう相手でもあって、プレイの一挙一動を見ながら判定してもらってる!

key: ...And getting trolled when he decides to spam Itemfinder everywhere until I behave.
en: ...And getting trolled when he decides to spam Itemfinder everywhere until I behave.
ja: ……それで、あたしがちゃんと行動するまでアイテムサーチを連打しまくって、からかわれたりもする。

key: Jan's just kind of here these days, but originally we had a trade where I helped him out with learning to sprite better in return for him tackling a few sprites for Reborn.
en: Jan's just kind of here these days, but originally we had a trade where I helped him out with learning to sprite better in return for him tackling a few sprites for Reborn.
ja: ジャンは最近はただそこにいる感じだけど、元々はドット絵の描き方を教える代わりに、リボーン用のドット絵をいくつか手がけてもらうっていう取引だったんだ。

key: Cass joined us late in E18.
en: Cass joined us late in E18.
ja: キャスはエピソード18の終わり頃に加わった。

key: Originally she was going to be an animator!
en: Originally she was going to be an animator!
ja: 元々はアニメーター志望だったの!

key: She did Leafage and no other animations.
en: She did Leafage and no other animations.
ja: リーフエイジ以外のアニメーションは手がけなかったけどね。

key: But she more than made up for it in ways I already basically gushed about in another section, so I'll spare her here.
en: But she more than made up for it in ways I already basically gushed about in another section, so I'll spare her here.
ja: でもそれ以上の働きは、別のセクションでもう散々語っちゃったから、ここでは省くね。

key: She did suggest we take on a certain Toothpastefairy, or Perry!
en: She did suggest we take on a certain Toothpastefairy, or Perry!
ja: トゥースペーストフェアリー、あのペリーを引き入れようって提案してくれたのもキャスだった!

key: He happened to be working on some mods anyway so we picked him up to help out and he's just been fantastic for the whole tail end of the ride.
en: He happened to be working on some mods anyway so we picked him up to help out and he's just been fantastic for the whole tail end of the ride.
ja: ちょうど何かのMODを作ってたところだったから手伝いに引き入れて、以来ずっと素晴らしい活躍を見せてくれてる。

key: I'm very grateful for him helping us out with programming reliably, and also being totally down to enable whatever bullshit Cass or I get up to.
en: I'm very grateful for him helping us out with programming reliably, and also being totally down to enable whatever bullshit Cass or I get up to.
ja: 安定してプログラミングを手伝ってくれるのも、キャスとあたしがやらかすどんなバカ騒ぎにも快く付き合ってくれるのも、本当にありがたい。

key: He's done a lot of quality-of-life improvements for y'all especially, such as that quick TM view in the bag!
en: He's done a lot of quality-of-life improvements for y'all especially, such as that quick TM view in the bag!
ja: 特にみんなにとってはQOL改善をたくさんやってくれたよね、バッグの中でTMをぱっと確認できる機能とか!

key: Other late-joining stars include The Legendary Crim.
en: Other late-joining stars include The Legendary Crim.
ja: 他に途中から加わってくれたスターには、レジェンダリー・クリムがいる。

key: You might know of them from their work on literally every other fangame in existence.
en: You might know of them from their work on literally every other fangame in existence.
ja: 他のありとあらゆるファンゲームでの仕事を見て知ってる人もいるかもね。

key: It's been a huge help to have a second spriter and mapper on the team.
en: It's been a huge help to have a second spriter and mapper on the team.
ja: チームにもう一人ドット絵とマップ作りができる人がいてくれたのは、本当に大きな助けだった。

key: Even though they were originally just learning both when I asked them to help with Starlight, they learn fast and caught up quick.
en: Even though they were originally just learning both when I asked them to help with Starlight, they learn fast and caught up quick.
ja: スターライトの手伝いを頼んだ時は元々どっちも勉強中だったのに、覚えが早くてすぐ追いついちゃった。

key: There's no way we could've made some of the postgame content as gorgeous as it has been without them.
en: There's no way we could've made some of the postgame content as gorgeous as it has been without them.
ja: クリムなしじゃ、クリア後コンテンツをここまで見事に仕上げることは絶対できなかったと思う。

key: Last but not least, we also acquired an Azzie!
en: Last but not least, we also acquired an Azzie!
ja: 最後になったけど、アジーも仲間に加わってくれた!

key: Fans might know her from her Tourmaline Travels story, and if not, they might be interested in reading it!
en: Fans might know her from her Tourmaline Travels story, and if not, they might be interested in reading it!
ja: ファンの中には「トルマリン・トラベルズ」の作者として知ってる人もいるかもね、知らなかった人はぜひ読んでみて!

key: She's helped out with a lot of the sundry postgame dialogue, especially in the Nightclub.
en: She's helped out with a lot of the sundry postgame dialogue, especially in the Nightclub.
ja: クリア後の色んな会話文、特にナイトクラブ関連をたくさん手伝ってくれた。

key: If I had to do it all myself I probably would've gone insane and run into the hills screaming...
en: If I had to do it all myself I probably would've gone insane and run into the hills screaming...
ja: 全部一人でやってたら、たぶん頭がおかしくなって叫びながら山に走って行ってたと思う……

key: ...Is that everyone?
en: ...Is that everyone?
ja: ……これで全員かな?

key: I think so...
en: I think so...
ja: だと思う……

key: Gosh, I've written too much already. Let's be done.
en: Gosh, I've written too much already. Let's be done.
ja: うわ、もう書きすぎだね。この辺にしとこう。

key: But please appreciate everyone who's helped us make it to this point, ne?
en: But please appreciate everyone who's helped us make it to this point, ne?
ja: でも、ここまで来られたのは手伝ってくれたみんなのおかげだってこと、忘れないでね?

key: AME: So, no more Pokémon games.
en: AME: So, no more Pokémon games.
ja: アメ: というわけで、もうポケモンゲームは作らない。

key: Sorry, not sorry.
en: Sorry, not sorry.
ja: ごめんね、でも悪くは思ってない。

key: I am Tired and Done.
en: I am Tired and Done.
ja: もう疲れたし、やり切ったの。

key: Also, there's the whole copyright thing.
en: Also, there's the whole copyright thing.
ja: それに、著作権の問題もあるしね。

key: Nintendo, please, we can all just walk away from this peacefully, I don't want anything more to do with it, I swear...
en: Nintendo, please, we can all just walk away from this peacefully, I don't want anything more to do with it, I swear...
ja: 任天堂さん、お願いだから、みんなでこのまま穏便に離れましょう、これ以上関わるつもりは一切ないから、本当に……

key: I know a lot of people will probably be disappointed by it, but like...
en: I know a lot of people will probably be disappointed by it, but like...
ja: がっかりする人も多いと思うけど、まあ……

key: Y'all gotta remember, even though I've been here for a decade and change, my start is not in Pokémon games.
en: Y'all gotta remember, even though I've been here for a decade and change, my start is not in Pokémon games.
ja: 十何年もここにいたけど、もともとポケモンゲームから始まったわけじゃないってこと、忘れないでほしいな。

key: I've wanted to make a tactical RPG since I was like 12.
en: I've wanted to make a tactical RPG since I was like 12.
ja: 12歳くらいの頃からずっとタクティカルRPGを作りたいと思ってたの。

key: Finally gonna go do that now.
en: Finally gonna go do that now.
ja: やっとそれに取りかかれるってわけ。

key: It's called Starlight Divide, and-- obligatory plug-- we have a demo out already!
en: It's called Starlight Divide, and-- obligatory plug-- we have a demo out already!
ja: タイトルは「スターライト・ディバイド」、それで――お約束の宣伝だけど――もうデモ版も出してるの!

key: Wait, I can just take you to the website!
en: Wait, I can just take you to the website!
ja: 待って、公式サイトに案内できるよ!

key: Wanna give it a look?
en: Wanna give it a look?
ja: 見てみたい?

key: AME: Hell yeah, okay, here you go.
en: AME: Hell yeah, okay, here you go.
ja: アメ: よっしゃ、オーケー、はいどうぞ。

key: thank you ily
en: thank you ily
ja: ありがとう、大好き

key: AME: okay that's understandable maybe another time
en: AME: okay that's understandable maybe another time
ja: アメ: オーケー、それも分かる、じゃあまた今度ね

key: Regardless, for those of you who already tried the demo (or even who will go on to try it)-- Thank you so much.
en: Regardless, for those of you who already tried the demo (or even who will go on to try it)-- Thank you so much.
ja: とにかく、もうデモを試してくれた人も(これから試してくれる人も)――本当にありがとう。

key: It means a lot to me that you're willing to give it a chance!
en: It means a lot to me that you're willing to give it a chance!
ja: チャンスをくれるって気持ち、すごくうれしいの!

key: There's still a lot of work to do on that too, but I'm eagerly looking forward to the opportunity to do so.
en: There's still a lot of work to do on that too, but I'm eagerly looking forward to the opportunity to do so.
ja: あれもまだやることが山積みだけど、それに取り組めるのが今から楽しみで仕方ない。

key: There's a lot of side projects and other games I want to make too, but...
en: There's a lot of side projects and other games I want to make too, but...
ja: 他にも作りたいサイドプロジェクトやゲームがいっぱいあるんだけど……

key: I guess we'll just have to see how things go?
en: I guess we'll just have to see how things go?
ja: まあ、どうなるかは様子見ってことで?

key: My curse is that I come up with ideas way quicker than I can ever dream of developing them.
en: My curse is that I come up with ideas way quicker than I can ever dream of developing them.
ja: あたしの呪いは、実現できる速度よりずっと速くアイデアが湧いてくることなんだよね。

key: Alas.
en: Alas.
ja: ああ、無情……

key: I hope you'll stick around to see what comes from our next endeavors!
en: I hope you'll stick around to see what comes from our next endeavors!
ja: 次に取り組むものが何になるか、楽しみにしててくれるとうれしいな!

key: AME: This might've been unclear, but to be clear this section is just sort of advice/lessons I've learned in the realm of game development.
en: AME: This might've been unclear, but to be clear this section is just sort of advice/lessons I've learned in the realm of game development.
ja: アメ: 分かりにくかったかもしれないけど、はっきり言うとこのセクションはゲーム開発の中で学んだアドバイスとか教訓みたいなものなの。

key: There's a handful of things I wish I'd done differently, and so I hope others can learn from my mistakes.
en: There's a handful of things I wish I'd done differently, and so I hope others can learn from my mistakes.
ja: もっと違うやり方をすればよかったって思うことがいくつかあるから、あたしの失敗から誰かが学んでくれたらうれしい。

key: If you're not interested, just hold X or whatever.
en: If you're not interested, just hold X or whatever.
ja: 興味なければXボタンでも何でも押しっぱなしにしてスキップしちゃって。

key: Let's start with something positive.
en: Let's start with something positive.
ja: じゃあ、前向きな話から始めようか。

key: #1: Jack of all trades, master of none...
en: #1: Jack of all trades, master of none...
ja: その1: 何でも屋は何一つ極められない……

key: The lesser-known phrase continues "But better than being a master of one."
en: The lesser-known phrase continues "But better than being a master of one."
ja: あまり知られてない続きの言葉があってね、「でも一つのことしか極められないよりはマシ」って続くの。

key: Ultimately, I think that is true.
en: Ultimately, I think that is true.
ja: 結局のところ、それは真実だと思う。

key: Especially as an indie dev starting out, it's important to be willing to handle all parts of the project yourself.
en: Especially as an indie dev starting out, it's important to be willing to handle all parts of the project yourself.
ja: 特にインディー開発を始めたばかりの頃は、プロジェクトのあらゆる部分を自分自身でこなせる意欲を持つことが大事だから。

key: I pride myself on being able to do it all-- music, writing, programming (eventually...), spriting, mapping, animation, sfx, etc...
en: I pride myself on being able to do it all-- music, writing, programming (eventually...), spriting, mapping, animation, sfx, etc...
ja: 音楽、文章、プログラミング(最終的には……)、ドット絵、マップ作り、アニメーション、効果音、何でもできることは自分の誇りだと思ってる……

key: The flexibility to do all of that has been a great asset in terms of having confidence in knowing that I could finish this game no matter what.
en: The flexibility to do all of that has been a great asset in terms of having confidence in knowing that I could finish this game no matter what.
ja: 何でもできる柔軟さは、何があってもこのゲームを完成させられるっていう自信を持つ上で、大きな財産になった。

key: If you're just starting out, it'll also go a long way to helping you work with team members in a way that works for them, which itself helps build trust.
en: If you're just starting out, it'll also go a long way to helping you work with team members in a way that works for them, which itself helps build trust.
ja: これから始める人にとっても、チームメンバーとうまく協力できるようになる助けになるし、それ自体が信頼を築くことにもつながるから。

key: ...So that's great,
en: ...So that's great,
ja: ……だから、いいことづくめなんだけど、

key: However,
en: However,
ja: でもね、

key: I think I've caused myself a lot of problems by relying on that too much.
en: I think I've caused myself a lot of problems by relying on that too much.
ja: それに頼りすぎたせいで、自分自身に色んな問題を招いちゃったとも思ってる。

key: Good to have the option, but it's equally important to be open to accepting help and letting others take the wheel.
en: Good to have the option, but it's equally important to be open to accepting help and letting others take the wheel.
ja: 選択肢として持っておくのはいいことだけど、同じくらい、助けを受け入れて他の人に任せる度量を持つことも大事なの。

key: Having explored so many different avenues of development, I quite clearly see what I need to do and practice in order to improve at each of them,
en: Having explored so many different avenues of development, I quite clearly see what I need to do and practice in order to improve at each of them,
ja: 開発のいろんな分野に手を出してきたから、それぞれをどう練習して上達すればいいかは、はっきり見えてる。

key: But because I am doing so many things at once, I will not be able to pursue those paths to the ends of quality I'd like.
en: But because I am doing so many things at once, I will not be able to pursue those paths to the ends of quality I'd like.
ja: でも同時にあまりに多くのことをやりすぎてるせいで、目指してるレベルまでその道を追求しきれないの。

key: Frustrating.
en: Frustrating.
ja: もどかしいよね。

key: It also means I'm prone to taking on too much work myself and overwhelming myself, where I see other teams function better when the lead just
en: It also means I'm prone to taking on too much work myself and overwhelming myself, where I see other teams function better when the lead just
ja: それに、自分で仕事を抱え込みすぎて潰れそうになりがちってことでもある、他のチームはリーダーが

key: Doesn't Worry About It because it's #NotTheirDepartment.
en: Doesn't Worry About It because it's #NotTheirDepartment.
ja: 「それは自分の管轄じゃないから」で気にしないでいい方がうまく機能してるのを見るとね。

key: Pros and cons, I guess.
en: Pros and cons, I guess.
ja: 一長一短ってことなのかな。

key: I wish I'd navigated that a bit better and learned to lean on others more.
en: I wish I'd navigated that a bit better and learned to lean on others more.
ja: もう少しうまく立ち回って、もっと人に頼ることを覚えられたら良かったと思う。

key: Speaking of working with others, we only started using git in the last year of development.
en: Speaking of working with others, we only started using git in the last year of development.
ja: 人と一緒に仕事するって話で言えば、gitを使い始めたのは開発の最後の一年になってからだった。

key: #2: Get git.
en: #2: Get git.
ja: その2: gitを使うべし。

key: No one told me about it before, and if they had, we couldn't work it meaningfully without exported scripts.
en: No one told me about it before, and if they had, we couldn't work it meaningfully without exported scripts.
ja: 誰も前もって教えてくれなかったし、教えてもらってたとしても、スクリプトをエクスポートしないと意味のある使い方ができなかったと思う。

key: But if you're on a team, I can't stress how critical it will be to let them access the project directly.
en: But if you're on a team, I can't stress how critical it will be to let them access the project directly.
ja: でもチームでやってるなら、プロジェクトに直接アクセスできる環境を用意することの重要さは、いくら強調してもし足りないよ。

key: Save yourself.
en: Save yourself.
ja: 自分を助けてあげて。

key: It's intimidating to learn at first, but so worth it.
en: It's intimidating to learn at first, but so worth it.
ja: 最初は覚えるのが怖いけど、それだけの価値は絶対ある。

key: Frankly, that goes for programming itself.
en: Frankly, that goes for programming itself.
ja: 正直、プログラミング自体についても同じことが言える。

key: I didn't touch the scripts in Reborn for years and then I was like 'oh this is just rpg maker eventing lmao'
en: I didn't touch the scripts in Reborn for years and then I was like 'oh this is just rpg maker eventing lmao'
ja: リボーンのスクリプトには何年も触らずにいたのに、ある時「あ、これただのRPGツクールのイベントコマンドじゃん」って気付いたの。

key: Eventing also intimidating?
en: Eventing also intimidating?
ja: イベントコマンドも怖い?

key: Again, if 11-year-old me can do it, so can you.
en: Again, if 11-year-old me can do it, so can you.
ja: 重ねて言うけど、11歳の頃のあたしにできたなら、あなたにもできるよ。

key: Okay, what else?
en: Okay, what else?
ja: さて、他には何かあったかな?

key: #3: Mind your scope.
en: #3: Mind your scope.
ja: その3: スコープに気をつけて。

key: Pretty sure every single indie dev advice article will tell you this too, but I sure didn't listen, so I'm repeating it.
en: Pretty sure every single indie dev advice article will tell you this too, but I sure didn't listen, so I'm repeating it.
ja: どのインディー開発アドバイス記事にも必ず書いてあることだと思うけど、あたしは全然聞かなかったから、あえてもう一度言うね。

key: Don't make a giant sprawling epic with 18 badges and every legendary in postgame for your first major project.
en: Don't make a giant sprawling epic with 18 badges and every legendary in postgame for your first major project.
ja: 初めての本格的なプロジェクトで、18個のバッジとクリア後に全伝説ポケモン、みたいな壮大で長大なものを作らないこと。

key: ...It was my second major project, so I'm vindicated.
en: ...It was my second major project, so I'm vindicated.
ja: ……これはあたしの2作目のプロジェクトだったから、まあセーフってことで。

key: ...But probably just don't do it, like seriously, small goals are best, I p r o m i s e.
en: ...But probably just don't do it, like seriously, small goals are best, I p r o m i s e.
ja: ……でもたぶん、やめといた方がいいよ、マジで、小さい目標が一番いい、ほ ん と に。

key: It's very easy to underestimate how long everything will take if you're doing it well.
en: It's very easy to underestimate how long everything will take if you're doing it well.
ja: ちゃんとやろうとすると、全体でどれだけ時間がかかるか、過小評価しがちなの。

key: Never doing a game this long again, i s2g.
en: Never doing a game this long again, i s2g.
ja: もう二度とこんな長いゲームは作らない、マジで誓う。

key: probably.
en: probably.
ja: たぶんね。

key: #4: Listen to your heart and body.
en: #4: Listen to your heart and body.
ja: その4: 自分の心と体の声を聞くこと。

key: Okay, I phrased that a little too new-age-spiritually, but, like...
en: Okay, I phrased that a little too new-age-spiritually, but, like...
ja: ちょっとスピリチュアルすぎる言い方になっちゃったけど、要は……

key: Now that I'm on the other side of a ten year long project, I'm a lot Better at everything,
en: Now that I'm on the other side of a ten year long project, I'm a lot Better at everything,
ja: 十年がかりのプロジェクトを乗り越えた今、色んな面ですごく成長できたと思うけど、

key: And yet there are still things I feel like I could learn from my younger self.
en: And yet there are still things I feel like I could learn from my younger self.
ja: それでも、昔の自分から学べることがまだあるなって感じる。

key: One of those things is to let myself rest when I don't feel like working, rather than forcing myself.
en: One of those things is to let myself rest when I don't feel like working, rather than forcing myself.
ja: その一つが、無理に自分を働かせるんじゃなくて、やる気が出ない時は休ませてあげるってこと。

key: I talked a bit about the consequences of this in another dialogue option...
en: I talked a bit about the consequences of this in another dialogue option...
ja: これの影響については別の選択肢でも少し話したんだけど……

key: But I very much grew up admiring people with an unhealthy work ethic...
en: But I very much grew up admiring people with an unhealthy work ethic...
ja: あたしは正直、不健全な労働倫理を持った人たちに憧れて育っちゃったの……

key: The kind of people who like work until they literally pass out or get sick--
en: The kind of people who like work until they literally pass out or get sick--
ja: 文字通り気絶するか病気になるまで働き続けるタイプの人たちにね――

key: I felt like by not living up to the same standard, or by taking breaks, I was being lazy.
en: I felt like by not living up to the same standard, or by taking breaks, I was being lazy.
ja: 同じ水準でやらなかったり、休憩を取ったりすることが、なんだかサボりみたいに感じてたんだ。

key: No, that's stupid.
en: No, that's stupid.
ja: いや、そんなの馬鹿げてる。

key: There's something to be said for the programming addage of "work smarter, not harder,"
en: There's something to be said for the programming addage of "work smarter, not harder,"
ja: プログラミング界わいの格言「頑張るより、賢く働け」にも一理あるとは思うけど、

key: But more importantly...
en: But more importantly...
ja: でもそれよりもっと大事なのは……

key: Many people are hard on themselves for "being lazy" or "procrastinating" but we are humans who need rest.
en: Many people are hard on themselves for "being lazy" or "procrastinating" but we are humans who need rest.
ja: たくさんの人が「サボってる」とか「先延ばしにしてる」って自分を責めがちだけど、あたしたちは休息が必要な人間なんだよ。

key: Listening to yourself when you don't want to work, or when you need to relax, and choosing to trust yourself,
en: Listening to yourself when you don't want to work, or when you need to relax, and choosing to trust yourself,
ja: 働きたくない時、休みたい時の自分の声を聞いて、自分自身を信じてあげること、

key: That's a necessary habit if you want to be in it for the long term.
en: That's a necessary habit if you want to be in it for the long term.
ja: 長く続けていくなら、それは絶対必要な習慣だよ。

key: Seriously, I don't want anyone to go through what I have.
en: Seriously, I don't want anyone to go through what I have.
ja: 本当に、あたしみたいな経験を誰にもしてほしくないの。

key: #5, last one: Have fun.
en: #5, last one: Have fun.
ja: その5、最後: 楽しむこと。

key: Listen, I know this sounds hokey, but I -promise- this is tangible real advice.
en: Listen, I know this sounds hokey, but I -promise- this is tangible real advice.
ja: 聞いて、これ、うさんくさく聞こえるのは分かってるんだけど、これは絶対、地に足のついた本当のアドバイスだから。

key: I just said that working harder and forcing yourself is bad, right?
en: I just said that working harder and forcing yourself is bad, right?
ja: さっき、頑張りすぎたり無理したりするのは良くないって言ったよね?

key: So what's the trick to get good at something if you're not feeling it?
en: So what's the trick to get good at something if you're not feeling it?
ja: じゃあ、気分が乗らない時に何かを上達させるコツって何だと思う?

key: It's still to do it a lot, but the hack there is to -want- to do it a lot.
en: It's still to do it a lot, but the hack there is to -want- to do it a lot.
ja: 結局は「たくさんやる」ことなんだけど、そのコツは「たくさんやりたい」って思えるようにすることなの。

key: If you're having fun, you're going to want to do it a lot, and you'll naturally get good at it.
en: If you're having fun, you're going to want to do it a lot, and you'll naturally get good at it.
ja: 楽しんでいれば、自然とたくさんやりたくなるし、自然と上達していくものだから。

key: See?
en: See?
ja: でしょ?

key: And especially with long-haul development projects, like...
en: And especially with long-haul development projects, like...
ja: 特に長期間かかる開発プロジェクトだと……

key: You either find a way to make it fun for yourself, or it's miserable and drags out forever.
en: You either find a way to make it fun for yourself, or it's miserable and drags out forever.
ja: 自分なりに楽しくする方法を見つけるか、そうじゃなければずっと辛くて終わらない苦行になるかのどっちかなの。

key: I really can't stress this one enough.
en: I really can't stress this one enough.
ja: これはいくら強調してもし足りないくらい大事なことだよ。

key: Okay, go out there and make some vidya, y'all.
en: Okay, go out there and make some vidya, y'all.
ja: さあ、みんなも外に出て、ゲームを作ってみてね。

key: AME: Oh, so you've chosen violence.
en: AME: Oh, so you've chosen violence.
ja: アメ: おっと、暴力を選んだわけね。

key: All right, here we go.
en: All right, here we go.
ja: よし、いくよ。

key: Good show! It's no wonder you made it this far!
en: Good show! It's no wonder you made it this far!
ja: いい試合だった! ここまで来られたのも当然だね!

key: AME: Impressive work!
en: AME: Impressive work!
ja: アメ: 見事な実力だね!

key: But then, you've made it this far, so who could be surprised?
en: But then, you've made it this far, so who could be surprised?
ja: まあ、ここまで来たんだから、驚くまでもないか。

key: Here, let's throw in a BP for that.
en: Here, let's throw in a BP for that.
ja: じゃあ、BPを一つあげちゃう。

key: That puts you at \v[593] BP.
en: That puts you at \v[593] BP.
ja: これで所持BPは\v[593]になったよ。

key: AME: That's okay.
en: AME: That's okay.
ja: アメ: 大丈夫だよ。

key: I think I put this in game somewhere, but as I always told the challengers in the online league, you learn more from losses than wins.
en: I think I put this in game somewhere, but as I always told the challengers in the online league, you learn more from losses than wins.
ja: ゲーム内のどこかにも書いた気がするけど、オンラインリーグの挑戦者たちにいつも言ってたことがあるの、勝ちより負けから学ぶことの方が多いって。

key: This is simply an extra learning opportunity just for you!
en: This is simply an extra learning opportunity just for you!
ja: これは、あなただけのための特別な学びのチャンスってわけ!

key: Let me heal up your team real quick.
en: Let me heal up your team real quick.
ja: さくっとチームを回復させてあげるね。

key: AME: All better!
en: AME: All better!
ja: アメ: 元通り!

key: By the way, quick shout-out to the Crim for making my transition sprite.
en: By the way, quick shout-out to the Crim for making my transition sprite.
ja: そうそう、あたしの遷移スプライトを作ってくれたクリムに感謝を伝えなきゃ。

key: I didn't want to, because I was like 'boo hoo spriting myself is so egotistical lmao whiiineeee' so they covered for me.
en: I didn't want to, because I was like 'boo hoo spriting myself is so egotistical lmao whiiineeee' so they covered for me.
ja: 自分でやろうとしたら「うう、自分をスプライトにするなんてナルシストっぽくてやだよぉ」ってなっちゃったから、代わりにやってもらったの。

key: Also thanks to Cass for making my dev team,
en: Also thanks to Cass for making my dev team,
ja: それと、あたしのデブチームを作ってくれたキャスにも感謝を、

key: And, well, actually, everyone's dev teams,
en: And, well, actually, everyone's dev teams,
ja: っていうか、実は他のみんなのデブチームも、

key: And while we're at it, pretty much the majority of the post-game teams too???
en: And while we're at it, pretty much the majority of the post-game teams too???
ja: ついでに言えば、クリア後チームの大半も???

key: Girl's crazy.
en: Girl's crazy.
ja: もう、あの子ヤバいくらいすごいの。

key: Love her.
en: Love her.
ja: 大好き。

key: Okay, carry on.
en: Okay, carry on.
ja: さて、続けようか。

key: AME: Oh, sure, we can go back to her.
en: AME: Oh, sure, we can go back to her.
ja: アメ: ええ、彼女の話に戻ってもいいよ。

key: But first I'm gonna use the opportunity to talk shit about her.
en: But first I'm gonna use the opportunity to talk shit about her.
ja: でもその前に、まずは彼女の悪口を言うチャンスをもらうね。

key: And by 'talk shit' I mean tell everyone she's great.
en: And by 'talk shit' I mean tell everyone she's great.
