ja: 「悪口」って言っても、要はみんなに彼女がどれだけすごいか伝えるってことだけど。

key: Cass joined us around the release of E18, ended up moving in with me, and has generally just done a lot of like, holding me together.
en: Cass joined us around the release of E18, ended up moving in with me, and has generally just done a lot of like, holding me together.
ja: キャスはエピソード18のリリース頃に加わって、結局あたしと同居するようになって、基本的にずっとあたしを支え続けてくれてる。

key: So you have her to thank for me being able to complete the entire postgame without going literally crazy.
en: So you have her to thank for me being able to complete the entire postgame without going literally crazy.
ja: だから、あたしが本当に発狂せずにクリア後コンテンツを完成させられたのは、彼女のおかげなの。

key: In addition to that, she also got MKXP support going for us back before it was a common thing, which meant less lag and Mac and Linux versions,
en: In addition to that, she also got MKXP support going for us back before it was a common thing, which meant less lag and Mac and Linux versions,

en: This stuff has also been rewritten a few times even though I kept calling it finished.

en: Doesn't help that my diet consists of 1 meal and 2 pops a day, and almost no exercise which leaves me sleeping a lot.

en: Actually, that patience was really needed when I was having a mental breakdown in 2018, when I was juggling way too many things at once.

en: It was mostly real life related stuff that ended up leading to a few months of doing egg icons which were low effort but, kept me from being complacent.

key: Needless to say I'm very grateful for the chances Ame has given me to try to branch out in terms of creativity, and letting me take breaks for self care.
en: Needless to say I'm very grateful for the chances Ame has given me to try to branch out in terms of creativity, and letting me take breaks for self care.
ja: 言うまでもなく、アメが色んな創作の幅を広げるチャンスをくれたことや、休んでいいって言ってくれたことには本当に感謝してる。

key: Hopefully in the future there will be even more branching out, like trying my hand at music composing.
en: Hopefully in the future there will be even more branching out, like trying my hand at music composing.
ja: これからもっと色々挑戦できたらいいな、作曲とかにも手を出してみたい。

key: I'll probably stick around for future projects, or until Ame kicks me out.

en: VULPES: So, I guess I should introduce myself properly.

en: Hi, I'm Vulpes!
ja: どうも、ヴルペスです!

key: I've been existing in Reborn's general vicinity since 2015, and I joined the team in early 2018.
en: I've been existing in Reborn's general vicinity since 2015, and I joined the team in early 2018.
ja: 2015年からリボーンの周辺をうろうろしてて、2018年の初め頃にチームに加わったの。

key: I'm not really a people person though, so I've mostly just lurked.
en: I'm not really a people person though, so I've mostly just lurked.

key: I've also studied game design!
en: I've also studied game design!
ja: ゲームデザインも勉強したことあるよ!

key: I barely remember most of the course, but that was my first experience animating.
en: I barely remember most of the course, but that was my first experience animating.
ja: 講義の内容はほとんど覚えてないけど、それがあたしにとって初めてのアニメーション経験だったの。

key: And I loved that part more than anything else we covered, so here I am, animating!
en: And I loved that part more than anything else we covered, so here I am, animating!
ja: そこで習った中で一番好きになったのがそれだったから、こうしてアニメーションを作ってるってわけ!

key: But word of advice?
en: But word of advice?
ja: でも一つアドバイスがあるとしたら?

key: Just look up a syllabus and teach yourself, it's easier and cheaper.
en: Just look up a syllabus and teach yourself, it's easier and cheaper.
ja: シラバスだけ探して、あとは独学した方がいいよ、その方が楽だし安上がりだから。

key: The only reason to even look at a course is to see what goes into game production.
en: The only reason to even look at a course is to see what goes into game production.
ja: 講座を受ける唯一の意味があるとしたら、ゲーム制作に何が必要かを知ることくらいかな。

key: Anyway.
en: Anyway.
ja: とにかく。

key: Getting involved in Reborn has taught me a lot, and it's been really fun too!
en: Getting involved in Reborn has taught me a lot, and it's been really fun too!
ja: リボーンに関わったことで、色々学べたし、本当に楽しかった!

key: And here's hoping any future projects are even more fun!
en: And here's hoping any future projects are even more fun!
ja: これからのプロジェクトがもっと楽しいものになるといいな!

key: So I started helping out with Reborn in 2018.
en: So I started helping out with Reborn in 2018.
ja: リボーンを手伝い始めたのは2018年だったの。

key: I was checking a forum thread and Ame mentioned she was looking for another animator.
en: I was checking a forum thread and Ame mentioned she was looking for another animator.
ja: フォーラムのスレッドを見てたら、アメがもう一人アニメーターを探してるって書いてたんだよね。

key: I really wanted to help with the game, since, well...
en: I really wanted to help with the game, since, well...
ja: 本当にこのゲームを手伝いたいと思った、だって……

key: Reborn is probably the only reason I'm still interested in Pokémon in general.
en: Reborn is probably the only reason I'm still interested in Pokémon in general.
ja: リボーンがなかったら、今もポケモン自体に興味を持ち続けてたかどうか分からないくらいだから。

key: I'd been a fan since I was five, maybe earlier, so Pokémon was a pretty big part of my life.
en: I'd been a fan since I was five, maybe earlier, so Pokémon was a pretty big part of my life.
ja: 5歳、もしかしたらそれより前からずっとファンで、ポケモンはあたしの人生のかなり大きな部分を占めてた。

key: But I started losing interest between BW2 and XY, and drifted away from the franchise by ORAS.
en: But I started losing interest between BW2 and XY, and drifted away from the franchise by ORAS.
ja: でもBW2からXYの間くらいで興味を失っていって、ORASの頃にはもうシリーズから離れてたの。

key: I don't know exactly why, but Reborn brought that interest back.
en: I don't know exactly why, but Reborn brought that interest back.
ja: 正確な理由は分からないけど、リボーンがその興味を取り戻してくれた。

key: And I get extremely sentimental over everything, so having such a big part of my life revived like that...
en: And I get extremely sentimental over everything, so having such a big part of my life revived like that...
ja: あたしって何にでもすぐ感傷的になるタイプだから、人生のそんな大きな部分がそんな風によみがえるのって……

key: It meant a lot.
en: It meant a lot.
ja: すごく大きな意味があったの。

key: Anyway, as I was saying, I really wanted to help out because of that.
en: Anyway, as I was saying, I really wanted to help out because of that.
ja: とにかく、さっき言った通り、だからこそ本当に手伝いたいと思ったんだ。

key: But I was also convinced I would be a burden on the team.
en: But I was also convinced I would be a burden on the team.
ja: でも同時に、自分がチームのお荷物になるんじゃないかとも思い込んでた。

key: I almost talked myself out of applying altogether.
en: I almost talked myself out of applying altogether.
ja: 応募自体をやめようかとまで思ったくらい。

key: But I'm very glad I didn't.
en: But I'm very glad I didn't.
ja: でもやめなくて本当に良かった。

key: That choice is probably in the top three decisions I've ever made in my life.
en: That choice is probably in the top three decisions I've ever made in my life.
ja: あの選択は、たぶん人生で下した決断の中でもトップ3に入るくらい良かったと思う。

key: Even so, it took a bit of getting used to.
en: Even so, it took a bit of getting used to.
ja: それでも、慣れるまでには少し時間がかかった。

key: All my animation experience at the time was in 3D, and the technical stuff didn't carry over.
en: All my animation experience at the time was in 3D, and the technical stuff didn't carry over.
ja: 当時のアニメーション経験は全部3Dだったから、技術的な部分がそのまま活かせなかったの。

key: It wound up with me thinking stuff like "Oh, a spiral will be easy to make!",
en: It wound up with me thinking stuff like "Oh, a spiral will be easy to make!",

key: (I mostly just mentioned it because it's my favorite animation I've made and you should watch it.)
en: (I mostly just mentioned it because it's my favorite animation I've made and you should watch it.)
ja: (あれが自分で作った中で一番のお気に入りだから、ぜひ見てほしくてちょっと言っちゃった。)

key: Actually, you know what?
en: Actually, you know what?
ja: そういえば、あのさ?

key: Give me one... second...
en: Give me one... second...
ja: ちょっと待ってて……

key: There!
en: There!
ja: はい!

key: I have a team on hand now with some of the animations I made!
en: I have a team on hand now with some of the animations I made!
ja: 今、あたしが作ったアニメーションを持ってるチームを一つ用意したよ!

key: Can't have all of them because I made a fair number of Z-Moves,
en: Can't have all of them because I made a fair number of Z-Moves,
ja: Z技をかなりたくさん作ったから全部は入れられなかったけど、

key: But this is all I did for the game for like four years, I want to show it off.
en: But this is all I did for the game for like four years, I want to show it off.
ja: これがこのゲームのために四年間くらいやってきた仕事のすべてだから、見せびらかしたくて。

key: But I've been working on other stuff recently too.
en: But I've been working on other stuff recently too.
ja: でも最近は他のことにも取り組んでるの。

key: I also started helping with the code once we hit testing for the final episode!
en: I also started helping with the code once we hit testing for the final episode!
ja: 最終エピソードのテスト段階に入ってからは、コードの手伝いもし始めたんだ!

key: I had a little experience before that, but it was in a language that went out of use before I was born.
en: I had a little experience before that, but it was in a language that went out of use before I was born.
ja: それ以前にも少し経験はあったけど、自分が生まれる前に使われなくなった言語でね。

key: So not exactly helpful.
en: So not exactly helpful.
ja: だからあんまり役に立たなかった。

key: But then the animation editor started not letting you change things properly.
en: But then the animation editor started not letting you change things properly.
ja: でもある時アニメーションエディタがちゃんと編集できなくなっちゃって。

key: So I checked the code because why not, right?
en: So I checked the code because why not, right?
ja: だから、まあいっかってコードを確認してみたの。

key: And I saw a thing and said "hey is this breaking it?",
en: And I saw a thing and said "hey is this breaking it?",
ja: そしたら何か見つけて「これが原因じゃない?」って言ったら、

key: And Cass and Perry said "yeah that's it also you wanna help with the code",
en: And Cass and Perry said "yeah that's it also you wanna help with the code",
ja: キャスとペリーが「そうそれだ、ついでにコードの手伝いもしない?」って言ってきて、

key: And I said "sure sorry if I suck at first" and that was that.
en: And I said "sure sorry if I suck at first" and that was that.
ja: あたしが「うん、最初は下手でもごめんね」って答えて、それで決まったの。

key: And to this day I'm still messing up basic syntax.
en: And to this day I'm still messing up basic syntax.
ja: そして今でも基本的な構文でよくミスってる。

key: I'm being dramatic, it's been two months at most, of course I'm not brilliant yet.
en: I'm being dramatic, it's been two months at most, of course I'm not brilliant yet.
ja: 大げさに言っちゃったけど、まだせいぜい二ヶ月くらいだから、そりゃまだ上手くなくても仕方ないよね。

key: But I'm fine with that, baby steps and all.
en: But I'm fine with that, baby steps and all.
ja: でもそれでいいと思ってる、一歩ずつだから。

key: And hey, you're using the password that was the first bit of code I implemented!
en: And hey, you're using the password that was the first bit of code I implemented!
ja: あ、それと、あなたが使ってるパスワード、あたしが最初に実装したコードの一部なんだよ!

key: So I can't suck that bad!
en: So I can't suck that bad!
ja: だからそんなにひどくはないはず!

key: ... Well, the first bit of code players will see, at least.
en: ... Well, the first bit of code players will see, at least.
ja: ……まあ、少なくともプレイヤーが目にする最初のコードって意味では、だけど。

key: I made some changes to the animation editor first, but you probably won't see that.
en: I made some changes to the animation editor first, but you probably won't see that.
ja: その前にアニメーションエディタにいくつか手を加えたけど、そっちはたぶん見えないと思う。

key: VULPES: "But Vulpes," I hear you ask.
en: VULPES: "But Vulpes," I hear you ask.
ja: ヴルペス: 「でもヴルペス」って聞こえてきそうだね。

key: "Why do you have this option when you said you weren't a people person?"
en: "Why do you have this option when you said you weren't a people person?"
ja: 「人付き合い得意じゃないって言ってたのに、なんでこの選択肢があるの?」って。

key: Assuming you read the first option, that is.
en: Assuming you read the first option, that is.
ja: 最初の選択肢を読んでたらの話だけど。

key: The answer is I just want an excuse to get a bunch of stuff off my chest.
en: The answer is I just want an excuse to get a bunch of stuff off my chest.
ja: 答えは、単に胸の内を吐き出す口実がほしかっただけ。

key: And everyone here helped me deal with it, so there.
en: And everyone here helped me deal with it, so there.
ja: ここにいるみんなが、それを乗り越える手伝いをしてくれたから、まあそういうことで。

key: This is going to get kind of heavy, so here's a chance to back out if you're not up for it.
en: This is going to get kind of heavy, so here's a chance to back out if you're not up for it.
ja: ちょっと重い話になるから、無理そうなら今のうちに引き返してもいいよ。

key: So, it might seem obvious from my other answers,
en: So, it might seem obvious from my other answers,
ja: さっきまでの答えでも何となく伝わってたと思うけど、

key: But I had pretty bad anxiety since even before I joined the team.
en: But I had pretty bad anxiety since even before I joined the team.
ja: チームに入るより前から、あたしはかなりひどい不安障害を抱えてたの。

key: Probably with some moderate depression mixed in for flavor.
en: Probably with some moderate depression mixed in for flavor.
ja: たぶん、そこそこの鬱っぽい症状も混ざってたと思う。

key: I think it's been about five years, but thinking back I showed symptoms much earlier.
en: I think it's been about five years, but thinking back I showed symptoms much earlier.
ja: 五年くらい前からだと思うけど、振り返ってみるともっと前から兆候はあったな。

key: It wasn't exactly conductive to having a functional life.
en: It wasn't exactly conductive to having a functional life.
ja: まともに機能する生活を送るには、あんまり向いてない状態だった。

key: For most of the time I've been on the team, Reborn's been the only real anchor I've had to functionality.
en: For most of the time I've been on the team, Reborn's been the only real anchor I've had to functionality.
ja: チームにいた時間のほとんどで、リボーンだけがあたしにとって、機能的でいられる唯一の拠り所だった。

key: Without the others, I'd have been a lot worse off.
en: Without the others, I'd have been a lot worse off.
ja: みんながいなかったら、もっとひどい状態になってたと思う。

key: And even now, when I'm starting to get better, they're helping me a lot just by being there.
en: And even now, when I'm starting to get better, they're helping me a lot just by being there.
ja: 今、少し良くなってきてる時でも、みんなはただそこにいてくれるだけで、すごく助けになってくれてる。

key: With most people, I always felt pressured in some way.
en: With most people, I always felt pressured in some way.
ja: 大抵の人といると、何かしらプレッシャーを感じてた。

key: Either by how I "should" act around them, or from the expectations they had.
en: Either by how I "should" act around them, or from the expectations they had.
ja: 自分がどう振る舞う「べき」かとか、相手からの期待とか。

key: It'd be a lie to say I never felt like that around the others...
en: It'd be a lie to say I never felt like that around the others...
ja: チームのみんなといる時、そう感じなかったことがないって言ったらうそになるけど……

key: But it was a lot less often than with other people.
en: But it was a lot less often than with other people.
ja: 他の人といる時よりは、ずっとその頻度は少なかった。

key: And even when I did feel like that, after the first couple of months I could deal with it easier.
en: And even when I did feel like that, after the first couple of months I could deal with it easier.
ja: それにそう感じた時でも、最初の数ヶ月を過ぎたら、対処するのがずっと楽になった。

key: I wasn't able to actually talk very often, but at the same time I didn't feel guilty or "wrong" for that.
en: I wasn't able to actually talk very often, but at the same time I didn't feel guilty or "wrong" for that.
ja: 実際にはあんまり頻繁に話せたわけじゃなかったけど、同時にそれで罪悪感を感じたり「これじゃだめだ」って思ったりもしなかった。

key: When the whole world tells you "socialise this, network that", even when it's impossible...
en: When the whole world tells you "socialise this, network that", even when it's impossible...
ja: 世界中が「もっと社交しろ」「もっと人脈を広げろ」って言ってくる中で、それが無理な人間にとっては……

key: Having a space to exist with others, without having to worry about that stuff, was a big comfort.
en: Having a space to exist with others, without having to worry about that stuff, was a big comfort.
ja: そういうことを気にせずに、みんなと一緒にいられる場所があるっていうのは、すごく大きな救いだった。

key: And it's taken a while, plus some other help, but I'm not as bad now.
en: And it's taken a while, plus some other help, but I'm not as bad now.
ja: 時間はかかったし、他の助けもあったけど、今はそこまでひどくない。

key: I'm able to talk to them without constantly panicking and overthinking.
en: I'm able to talk to them without constantly panicking and overthinking.
ja: ずっとパニックになったり考えすぎたりせずに、みんなと話せるようになった。

key: Even if I'd started recovering without them around, I wouldn't be making nearly as much progress.
en: Even if I'd started recovering without them around, I wouldn't be making nearly as much progress.
ja: たとえみんながいなくても回復し始めてたかもしれないけど、今ほどの進歩は絶対できてなかったと思う。

key: Instead of having two or three people I'm comfortable existing around, I have about twelve.
en: Instead of having two or three people I'm comfortable existing around, I have about twelve.
ja: 快適だと思える相手が二、三人だったのが、今では十二人くらいになった。

key: There's only so many things you'll have in common with one person.
en: There's only so many things you'll have in common with one person.
ja: 一人の相手と共有できる部分には限りがあるものだから。

key: But with different people, there's going to be different commonalities.
en: But with different people, there's going to be different commonalities.
ja: でも人が違えば、共通点も違ってくる。

key: And it makes it that much easier to talk to them.
en: And it makes it that much easier to talk to them.
ja: それが、話しやすさをぐっと増やしてくれるの。

key: And maybe after that, eventually, you'll feel comfortable calling them friends.
en: And maybe after that, eventually, you'll feel comfortable calling them friends.
ja: そしてそのうち、きっと彼らを友達って呼んでも大丈夫だって思えてくる。

key: And for everyone else on the team?
en: And for everyone else on the team?
ja: チームの他のみんなに対しては?

key: I think I've finally reached that point.
en: I think I've finally reached that point.
ja: やっと、そう思える段階に来られた気がする。

key: So really, I owe the others my emotional health and sanity.
en: So really, I owe the others my emotional health and sanity.
ja: だから本当に、あたしの心の健康と正気は、みんなのおかげなの。

key: And also my existence outside of being the local cryptid.
en: And also my existence outside of being the local cryptid.
ja: それに、地元の都市伝説みたいな存在じゃなく生きてこられたのもね。

key: Still plan on being that IRL though.
en: Still plan on being that IRL though.
ja: 現実ではまだそういうポジションを狙ってるつもりだけど。

key: Give me a dog or cat over humans any day.
en: Give me a dog or cat over humans any day.
ja: 人間より犬や猫の方がずっといい、いつだってそう。

key: And hey, if any of this resonates with you?
en: And hey, if any of this resonates with you?
ja: それと、もしこの話に共感できるところがあったなら?

key: Know that you're probably underestimating yourself as a person.
en: Know that you're probably underestimating yourself as a person.
ja: たぶんあなたは、自分自身を過小評価してるってことだと思う。

key: More people care about you than you think,
en: More people care about you than you think,
ja: 思ってるよりずっと多くの人が、あなたのことを気にかけてる、

key: And you're much less of a burden than you think.
en: And you're much less of a burden than you think.
ja: そしてあなたは、自分で思ってるよりずっとお荷物なんかじゃない。

key: I got caught up in those thoughts a lot too.
en: I got caught up in those thoughts a lot too.
ja: あたしもそういう考えに、何度もとらわれてきたから。

key: But your brain is lying.
en: But your brain is lying.
ja: でも、その脳の声はうそをついてる。

key: Even if you can't believe me right now, keep it in mind.
en: Even if you can't believe me right now, keep it in mind.
ja: 今すぐには信じられなくても、心のどこかに留めておいてほしい。

key: And I hope some day you will be able to.
en: And I hope some day you will be able to.
ja: そしていつか、それを信じられる日が来ますように。

key: VULPES: Sure.
en: VULPES: Sure.
ja: ヴルペス: いいよ。

key: Take care of yourself.
en: Take care of yourself.
ja: 自分を大事にしてね。

key: Okay, anything else you wanted?
en: Okay, anything else you wanted?
ja: さて、他に何かあった?

key: Anything else you want to talk about?
en: Anything else you want to talk about?
ja: 他に話したいことある?

key: VULPES: Okay, see you!
en: VULPES: Okay, see you!
ja: ヴルペス: それじゃ、またね!

key: CRIM: ...Oh, hi!
en: CRIM: ...Oh, hi!
ja: クリム: ……あ、どうも!

key: ...Gosh, I never know what to say here.
en: ...Gosh, I never know what to say here.
ja: ……うーん、ここで何を言えばいいのか、いつも分からなくなる。

key: Uh, I guess I can just start with-- welcome to the dev room!
en: Uh, I guess I can just start with-- welcome to the dev room!
ja: えっと、とりあえずこれから始めようかな――開発ルームへようこそ!

key: It's still kind of a trip for me to see myself in this room,
en: It's still kind of a trip for me to see myself in this room,
ja: 人生の半分近く、プレイしたり関わったりしてきたゲームの中で、自分自身がこの部屋にいるのって、

key: For a game that I've been playing and/or involved in for nearly half my life?
en: For a game that I've been playing and/or involved in for nearly half my life?
ja: 今でもちょっと不思議な感じがする?

key: But I'm immensely grateful regardless!
en: But I'm immensely grateful regardless!
ja: でもとにかく、ものすごく感謝してる!

key: I could gush a whole lot more,
en: I could gush a whole lot more,
ja: もっとたくさん語りたいことはあるんだけど、

key: But I'll save that for when I'm actually prompted to!
en: But I'll save that for when I'm actually prompted to!
ja: それは実際に聞かれた時のためにとっておくね!

key: Apologies in advance, I tend to talk a lot!
en: Apologies in advance, I tend to talk a lot!
ja: 先に謝っておくけど、あたし、結構しゃべりすぎる傾向があるから!

key: ...Anyways, hi! I'm Crim!
en: ...Anyways, hi! I'm Crim!
ja: ……とにかく、どうも! クリムです!

key: It's lovely to meet you!
en: It's lovely to meet you!
ja: 会えてうれしいよ!

key: CRIM: Hi, welcome back again! I hope you've been enjoying the rest of the dev room!
en: CRIM: Hi, welcome back again! I hope you've been enjoying the rest of the dev room!
ja: クリム: どうも、また来てくれたんだね! 開発ルームの残りも楽しんでもらえてるといいな!

key: And your adventure too, of course!
en: And your adventure too, of course!
ja: もちろん、あなたの冒険もね!

key: Did you want to talk some more?
en: Did you want to talk some more?
ja: もう少し話したい?

key: ...Or are you back for a battle?
en: ...Or are you back for a battle?
ja: ……それともバトルしに戻ってきた?

key: What can I do for you?
en: What can I do for you?
ja: 何をしてあげようか?

key: CRIM: Oh, you want to stay and chat a bit?
en: CRIM: Oh, you want to stay and chat a bit?
ja: クリム: あ、もう少し話していきたいんだ?

key: Just as a heads-up, I never know what to say to these unless specifically prompted.
en: Just as a heads-up, I never know what to say to these unless specifically prompted.
ja: 先に言っておくけど、こういうの、話を振られない限り何を言えばいいか全然分からないタイプなんだよね。

key: But I will talk your ear off if invited to!
en: But I will talk your ear off if invited to!
ja: でも誘われたらしゃべりすぎるくらいしゃべっちゃうけど!

key: What's up? \ch[62,-1,Reborn,Game Involvement, Myself,Nevermind!]
en: What's up? \ch[62,-1,Reborn,Game Involvement, Myself,Nevermind!]
ja: 何について話す? \ch[62,-1,リボーン,ゲームでの活動,自分のこと,やっぱりいいや!]

key: CRIM: Oh, you want to talk about Reborn?
en: CRIM: Oh, you want to talk about Reborn?
ja: クリム: あ、リボーンについて話したいんだ?

key: Okay! Buckle up.
en: Okay! Buckle up.
ja: オーケー! 覚悟してね。

key: I ended up joining the team in early December of 2020, when I'd asked Ame,
en: I ended up joining the team in early December of 2020, when I'd asked Ame,
ja: 2020年の12月頭くらいにチームに加わったの、アメに聞いたのがきっかけで、

key: "Hey, so since we released Starlight, you want help with Reborn?"
en: "Hey, so since we released Starlight, you want help with Reborn?"
ja: 「ねえ、スターライトもリリースしたことだし、リボーンの手伝いしない?」って。

key: And she was like, "Sure! Come aboard."
en: And she was like, "Sure! Come aboard."
ja: そしたら「もちろん! 来て来て」って言ってくれて。

key: I was over the moon. I already had a lot of love for the game-- I've got a massive soft spot for intricate storytelling.
en: I was over the moon. I already had a lot of love for the game-- I've got a massive soft spot for intricate storytelling.
ja: もう舞い上がっちゃった。もともとこのゲームがすごく好きだったの――緻密な物語ってものにめちゃくちゃ弱いタイプだから。

key: The characters, the story, the maps, the music, the world, all of it was just a pure serotonin rush.
en: The characters, the story, the maps, the music, the world, all of it was just a pure serotonin rush.
ja: キャラクターも、物語も、マップも、音楽も、世界観も、全部が純粋な多幸感の塊だった。

key: Quick commercial break: You should check out Starlight Divide, too! No bias, promise.
en: Quick commercial break: You should check out Starlight Divide, too! No bias, promise.
ja: ちょっと宣伝タイム: スターライト・ディバイドもチェックしてみてね! ひいき目なしで本当に。

key: There's a lot of love poured into that game already, and it's only a demo so far!
en: There's a lot of love poured into that game already, and it's only a demo so far!
ja: もう今の段階でたくさんの愛情が注ぎ込まれてるし、まだデモ版なんだから!

key: But to go back to your regularly scheduled emoposting,
en: But to go back to your regularly scheduled emoposting,
ja: さて、いつもの感傷的な語りに戻るけど、

key: I was pretty starstruck about getting to work on a game I'd been playing for like, seven or eight years.
en: I was pretty starstruck about getting to work on a game I'd been playing for like, seven or eight years.
ja: 七、八年くらいプレイしてきたゲームに実際関わるようになったのは、正直かなり浮足立った。

key: Honestly, I still kind of am!
en: Honestly, I still kind of am!
ja: 正直、今でも多少そうかも!

key: And as a bonus, it came with a bunch of cool people!
en: And as a bonus, it came with a bunch of cool people!
ja: それにおまけで、素敵な人たちにもたくさん出会えた!

key: Some of my closest friends are sitting right here in this room with me, or are people I've met through this game, and I'll always be forever grateful for that.
en: Some of my closest friends are sitting right here in this room with me, or are people I've met through this game, and I'll always be forever grateful for that.
ja: 一番仲のいい友達の何人かは、今この部屋に一緒にいたり、このゲームを通して出会った人だったりして、それには一生感謝し続けると思う。

key: Both the community and its people, well...
en: Both the community and its people, well...
ja: コミュニティも、そこにいる人たちも、みんな……

key: With the risk of sounding cheesy as heck, Reborn's probably-- definitely-- changed my life.
en: With the risk of sounding cheesy as heck, Reborn's probably-- definitely-- changed my life.
ja: ちょっとクサいこと言うようだけど、リボーンはたぶん――間違いなく――あたしの人生を変えたと思う。

key: I was in a bit of a rough place before I'd first joined Starlight, and, well, both it and Reborn really helped me with that.
en: I was in a bit of a rough place before I'd first joined Starlight, and, well, both it and Reborn really helped me with that.
ja: スターライトに参加する前、ちょっとしんどい時期にいて、スターライトもリボーンも、その両方が本当にあたしを助けてくれた。

key: I really needed a change of scenery-- and Reborn gave me an outlet where that could happen.
en: I really needed a change of scenery-- and Reborn gave me an outlet where that could happen.
ja: 本当に環境を変える必要があって――リボーンはそれができる出口をくれたの。

key: I think some people kind of see me as "Oh, you're that person who's working on something dev-related constantly?"
en: I think some people kind of see me as "Oh, you're that person who's working on something dev-related constantly?"
ja: 「ああ、いつも何か開発関連のことやってる人でしょ?」みたいに見られてる気がすることもある。

key: Or, "Wait, how many fangames do you work on now?"
en: Or, "Wait, how many fangames do you work on now?"
ja: あるいは「え、今何個ファンゲームに関わってるの?」とか。

key: Or, "Hey, you've been on Aseprite for 4 days straight, do you need some help?"
en: Or, "Hey, you've been on Aseprite for 4 days straight, do you need some help?"
ja: 「ねえ、もう4日連続でAsepriteに向かってるけど、大丈夫?」とか。

key: And like, true!
en: And like, true!
ja: まあ、その通りなんだけど!

key: But it really just brings me the most massive amount of pure joy to work on.
en: But it really just brings me the most massive amount of pure joy to work on.
ja: でも本当に、これに取り組んでるだけで純粋な喜びをたくさんもらえるの。

key: And here we are, at the end of it all,
en: And here we are, at the end of it all,
ja: そしてこうして、全部の終わりにたどり着いたわけだけど、

key: Call me emotional, but I've definitely cried a few times while writing this whole bit.
en: Call me emotional, but I've definitely cried a few times while writing this whole bit.
ja: 感傷的だって言われてもいいけど、これを書きながら何度か泣いちゃったのは事実。

key: I love this community, this game, and my friends dearly, and I'm grateful that they've stuck with me through it all.
en: I love this community, this game, and my friends dearly, and I'm grateful that they've stuck with me through it all.
ja: このコミュニティも、このゲームも、友達みんなも心から大好きだし、みんながずっと付き合ってくれたことに感謝してる。

key: If I might be a little self-indulgent and quote my favorite Reborn character,
en: If I might be a little self-indulgent and quote my favorite Reborn character,
ja: ちょっと自分に浸っちゃうけど、大好きなリボーンのキャラの台詞を引用させてもらうと、

key: "What a happy ending I've fallen into."
en: "What a happy ending I've fallen into."
ja: 「なんて幸せな結末に転がり込んだんだろう」

key: CRIM: ...Whew, that was a lot. Sorry about that! Thanks for sticking around and listening, though.
en: CRIM: ...Whew, that was a lot. Sorry about that!  Thanks for sticking around and listening, though.
ja: クリム: ……ふう、長かったね。ごめんね! でも最後まで聞いてくれてありがとう。

key: I hope you enjoy the game as much as I do~
en: I hope you enjoy the game as much as I do~
ja: あたしと同じくらいこのゲームを楽しんでもらえたらうれしいな~

key: Is there anything else you'd like to talk about?
en: Is there anything else you'd like to talk about?
ja: 他に何か話したいことある?

key: CRIM: Oh, you're curious about what I do for the game? Sure thing!
en: CRIM: Oh, you're curious about what I do for the game? Sure thing!
ja: クリム: あ、このゲームで自分が何をしてるか気になるんだ? もちろん!

key: So if you've been reading these in order, I mentioned before that I was originally pulled onto Reborn after Starlight's demo.
en: So if you've been reading these in order, I mentioned before that I was originally pulled onto Reborn after Starlight's demo.
ja: 順番に読んでくれてるなら、前にも言ったけど、スターライトのデモ版の後にリボーンに引き入れられたんだよね。

key: I was originally just a wee smol spriter on Starlight-- I just did the character overworld sprites.
en: I was originally just a wee smol spriter on Starlight-- I just did the character overworld sprites.
ja: 元々スターライトではちっちゃなドット絵担当で――キャラクターのフィールドスプライトだけやってたの。

key: When approaching Ame about Reborn, I was like, "Well, hey, I can offer support for spritework!"
en: When approaching Ame about Reborn, I was like, "Well, hey, I can offer support for spritework!"
ja: アメにリボーンの話を持ちかけた時は、「あ、じゃあドット絵で協力できるよ!」って言ったんだ。

key: "Oh, by the way, I'm also really interested in learning how to map."
en: "Oh, by the way, I'm also really interested in learning how to map."
ja: 「あ、それとマップ作りも学んでみたいと思ってて」って。

key: And it kind of just... spiraled from there.
en: And it kind of just... spiraled from there.
ja: そしたら……そこからどんどん膨らんでいったって感じ。

key: Honestly, at this point I'm struggling to remember what happened in what order--
en: Honestly, at this point I'm struggling to remember what happened in what order--
ja: 正直、今となっては何がどの順番で起きたか思い出せないくらい――

key: One of my first projects was when Ame asked me and Sam (that Smeargle over there!) about character backsprites for Mix 'n Match.
en: One of my first projects was when Ame asked me and Sam (that Smeargle over there!) about character backsprites for Mix 'n Match.
ja: 最初のプロジェクトの一つは、アメがあたしとサム(あそこにいるスメアギルだよ!)に、ミックス&マッチのキャラクター背面スプライトについて頼んできた時のこと。

key: I got overexcited, and I think I ended up smashing out over twenty backsprites in like, less than a week.
en: I got overexcited, and I think I ended up smashing out over twenty backsprites in like, less than a week.
ja: すごく興奮しちゃって、結局一週間もかからずに20枚以上の背面スプライトを作り上げたと思う。

key: I had a lot of fun coming up with poses that I thought would be fitting for each character! I also redid quite a few old backsprites as well.
en: I had a lot of fun coming up with poses that I thought would be fitting for each character! I also redid quite a few old backsprites as well.
ja: それぞれのキャラにぴったりだと思えるポーズを考えるの、すごく楽しかった! 古い背面スプライトもいくつか作り直したの。

key: By this point, minus those that already existed in E18,
en: By this point, minus those that already existed in E18,
ja: 今のところ、エピソード18の時点で既にあったものを除けば、

key: I think I've made most of the backsprites for the different characters?
en: I think I've made most of the backsprites for the different characters?
ja: 色んなキャラの背面スプライトの大半は、あたしが作ったと思う?

key: Spritework has been a pretty big part of my job here, mainly because it's what I'm comfiest with, but I dove into a lot of different categories!
en: Spritework has been a pretty big part of my job here, mainly because it's what I'm comfiest with, but I dove into a lot of different categories!
ja: ドット絵はここでの仕事のかなり大きな部分を占めてる、一番慣れてる分野だからってのが大きいけど、色んなカテゴリーにも手を出したよ!

key: For this next section, I'll only mention certain things if you've completed their quest, as to not spoil anyone for something you might not have seen yet!
en: For this next section, I'll only mention certain things if you've completed their quest, as to not spoil anyone for something you might not have seen yet!
ja: 次のセクションでは、あなたがそのクエストを完了してる場合にだけ触れるようにするね、まだ見てないものをネタバレしたくないから!

key: So come back later and say hi!
en: So come back later and say hi!
ja: だからまた後で見に来て、挨拶してね!

key: So for Celebi, to start with--
en: So for Celebi, to start with--
ja: まずセレビィから始めると――

key: Taube, Elena, and Shelly, along with the different maps in Celebi, were really my first big solo project.
en: Taube, Elena, and Shelly, along with the different maps in Celebi, were really my first big solo project.
ja: タウベ、エレナ、シェリー、それとセレビィ関連の色んなマップは、本当に初めての一人での大きなプロジェクトだった。

key: I conceptualized, designed, and sprited all three of them, and I'm really proud of how they've turned out!
en: I conceptualized, designed, and sprited all three of them, and I'm really proud of how they've turned out!
ja: この三人は全員、構想から設計、ドット絵まで全部あたしが手がけたの、仕上がりにはすごく誇りを持ってる!

key: For Darkrai, PULSE Hypno and Camerupt were also mine in both design and sprites, along with the quest's maps!
en: For Darkrai, PULSE Hypno and Camerupt were also mine in both design and sprites, along with the quest's maps!
ja: ダークライだと、パルス催眠術師とバクーダも、デザインとドット絵の両方があたしのもの、クエストのマップもね!

key: I know those two have been PULSE fights that people have been dying for, so...
en: I know those two have been PULSE fights that people have been dying for, so...
ja: あの二体はみんなが待ち望んでたパルス戦だって知ってるから……

key: I hope they've lived up to expectation!
en: I hope they've lived up to expectation!
ja: 期待に応えられてたらいいな!

key: ...So, standing here at the end of it all...
en: ...So, standing here at the end of it all...
ja: ……こうして、全部の終わりに立ってみると……

key: There's a lot of different things for the different quests I've done, and I'd probably be here for several years if I tried to list it all.
en: There's a lot of different things for the different quests I've done, and I'd probably be here for several years if I tried to list it all.
ja: 手がけた色んなクエストにはそれぞれ色んな要素があって、全部リストアップしようとしたら何年もかかっちゃうと思う。

key: Neoteric Isle, Zina's design and sprites, PULSE Arceus and Mime's overworlds, too!
en: Neoteric Isle, Zina's design and sprites, PULSE Arceus and Mime's overworlds, too!
ja: ネオテリック島、ジーナのデザインとドット絵、パルスアルセウスとパルスソルロックのフィールドキャラも!

key: I remapped Apophyll Cave and Route 3's cave network!
en: I remapped Apophyll Cave and Route 3's cave network!
ja: アポフィルどうくつと3番道路の洞窟網はマップを作り直したよ!

key: And all of the Pokémon Centers you see throughout the game!
en: And all of the Pokémon Centers you see throughout the game!
ja: それにゲーム中で見かけるポケモンセンター、全部!

key: Oh, the Shaymin and Tao trio quests were also mine! Those two I'm particularly proud of, and I hope people enjoyed them as well!
en: Oh, the Shaymin and Tao trio quests were also mine!  Those two I'm particularly proud of, and I hope people enjoyed them as well!
ja: あ、シェイミと三邪神のクエストもあたしがやったよ! この二つは特に誇りに思ってて、みんなにも楽しんでもらえてたらいいな!

key: Anna's Dreamsick sprites are also a favorite-- they were sketched and done from scratch, and I'm really proud of them!
en: Anna's Dreamsick sprites are also a favorite-- they were sketched and done from scratch, and I'm really proud of them!
ja: アンナの「夢病み」スプライトもお気に入り――ゼロからスケッチして仕上げたの、すごく誇りに思ってる!

key: I hope they made for a fun and climactic final battle!
en: I hope they made for a fun and climactic final battle!
ja: 楽しくて盛り上がるラストバトルになってたらいいな!

key: Thanks for sticking through all the way to the end!
en: Thanks for sticking through all the way to the end!
ja: 最後までついてきてくれてありがとう!

key: CRIM: ...Okay, we're back from the conditionals?
en: CRIM: ...Okay, we're back from the conditionals?
ja: クリム: ……オーケー、条件分岐から戻ってきたね?

key: Basically, I've been all over the map.
en: Basically, I've been all over the map.
ja: 基本的に、あたしは色んなところに手を出してきた。

key: I redid a huge chunk of Pokémon battler sprites-- mainly Gen 6 and 7-- and cleaned up a lot of NPC battle sprites-- a few main characters, too!
en: I redid a huge chunk of Pokémon battler sprites-- mainly Gen 6 and 7-- and cleaned up a lot of NPC battle sprites-- a few main characters, too!
ja: ポケモンのバトラースプライトの大部分を作り直して――主に第6世代と第7世代だけど――たくさんのNPCバトルスプライトも整理し直した――主要キャラも何人かね!

key: I did a few move animations, including a Z-Move-- Psychic Fangs was my first ever animation!
en: I did a few move animations, including a Z-Move-- Psychic Fangs was my first ever animation!
ja: 技のアニメーションも少し作ったよ、Z技も一つ含めて――サイコファングがあたしにとって初めてのアニメーションだった!

key: Jumped into writing dialogue near the end, too-- I helped with writing a little for the Nightclub and the Elite Four, as well as other random bits of dialogue here and there.
en: Jumped into writing dialogue near the end, too-- I helped with writing a little for the Nightclub and the Elite Four, as well as other random bits of dialogue here and there.
ja: 終盤にはセリフ書きにも足を突っ込んで――ナイトクラブと四天王のセリフを少し手伝ったし、他にもあちこちの細かい会話文も書いたの。

key: A bit of teambuilding, eventing, and puzzle design too!
en: A bit of teambuilding, eventing, and puzzle design too!
ja: チーム構築の一部やイベント制作、パズルデザインも少しやったよ!

key: You could say I'm probably somewhat of a jack of all trades?
en: You could say I'm probably somewhat of a jack of all trades?
ja: 要するに、あたしって何でも屋ってやつなのかも?

key: Or an ace in the hole!
en: Or an ace in the hole!
ja: または、隠し玉ってやつ!

key: Hehe.
en: Hehe.
ja: うふふ。

key: Or at least I like to consider myself one!
en: Or at least I like to consider myself one!
ja: 少なくとも、自分ではそう思うようにしてる!

key: Speaking of--
en: Speaking of--
ja: それで言えば――

key: If you've been around me for approximately ten seconds in the past year, you'll know that I am physically incapable of shutting up about Ace.
en: If you've been around me for approximately ten seconds in the past year, you'll know that I am physically incapable of shutting up about Ace.
ja: この一年、10秒でもあたしのそばにいたことがある人なら分かると思うけど、あたしはエースについて黙っていることが物理的に不可能なの。

key: They're one of the things ingame that mean the most to me, and I love them a lot.
en: They're one of the things ingame that mean the most to me, and I love them a lot.
ja: ゲーム内であたしにとって一番大切なものの一つで、本当に大好きなキャラなの。

key: If you're reading this from a save that's pre-E19 and haven't seen them, then....... oops!!
en: If you're reading this from a save that's pre-E19 and haven't seen them, then....... oops!!
ja: もしこれをE19より前のセーブから読んでて、まだエースに会ってないなら……おっと!!

key: And you should go replay the game!!!
en: And you should go replay the game!!!
ja: もう一回ゲームをプレイし直してね!!!

key: Same as with a few other characters, I designed and then sprited them, and I'm dearly proud of them.
en: Same as with a few other characters, I designed and then sprited them, and I'm dearly proud of them.
ja: 他の何人かのキャラと同じで、デザインからドット絵まであたしが手がけて、本当に誇りに思ってる。

key: I've probably said this about twenty times in this category alone, but I hope that others enjoy their presence ingame as much as I do!
en: I've probably said this about twenty times in this category alone, but I hope that others enjoy their presence ingame as much as I do!
ja: このカテゴリーだけでもう20回くらい言ってる気がするけど、みんなにもあたしと同じくらい、ゲーム内でのエースの存在を楽しんでもらえたらうれしいな!

key: CRIM: ...Okay! Uh.
en: CRIM: ...Okay! Uh.
ja: クリム: ……オーケー! えっと。

key: That was a lot!
en: That was a lot!
ja: いっぱいしゃべっちゃった!

key: Honestly, it's a bit comical writing it all out like this, but it actually really means a lot to me that I've been able to do so many different things.
en: Honestly, it's a bit comical writing it all out like this, but it actually really means a lot to me that I've been able to do so many different things.
ja: 正直、こうやって全部書き出すとちょっと滑稽な感じもするけど、こんなに色んなことに挑戦させてもらえたのは、本当に自分にとって大きな意味があるの。

key: I count myself really lucky to be able to try so many new things.
en: I count myself really lucky to be able to try so many new things.
ja: こんなにたくさんの新しいことに挑戦できて、自分は本当に運が良かったと思う。

key: I'm hugely grateful to Ame not just for trusting me with handing me all these different things to do, but also just the opportunity to do them at all.
en: I'm hugely grateful to Ame not just for trusting me with handing me all these different things to do, but also just the opportunity to do them at all.
ja: アメには本当に感謝してる、こんなに色んなことを任せて信頼してくれたことだけじゃなくて、そもそもそのチャンスをくれたこと自体に。

key: She and Cass have been a huge support in both personal life and dev, have helped me try things out of my comfort zone-- and been patient with me if I screwed up said things, too!
en: She and Cass have been a huge support in both personal life and dev, have helped me try things out of my comfort zone-- and been patient with me if I screwed up said things, too!
ja: アメとキャスは、私生活でも開発でもすごく支えになってくれて、居心地のいい範囲から一歩外に出ることを手伝ってくれた――しくじった時も辛抱強く付き合ってくれた!

key: I think that about covers it for things I've done for the game!
en: I think that about covers it for things I've done for the game!
ja: このゲームのためにやったことについては、これで大体話せたと思う!

key: But like, if you want an exhaustive list of everything...
en: But like, if you want an exhaustive list of everything...
ja: でも、もし「全部」の完全なリストが欲しいなら……

key: Hit me up sometime!
en: Hit me up sometime!
ja: いつでも声かけてね!

key: CRIM: Okay, I know I just said that I don't know what to say to these, but like...
en: CRIM: Okay, I know I just said that I don't know what to say to these, but like...
ja: クリム: オーケー、さっき、こういうのに何を言えばいいか分からないって言ったばかりだけど……

key: I really don't know how to talk about myself.
en: I really don't know how to talk about myself.
ja: 自分自身について語るのが「本当に」分からないの。

key: Let me at least introduce myself properly.
en: Let me at least introduce myself properly.
ja: せめて、ちゃんと自己紹介させて。

key: Uh... hi!
en: Uh... hi!
ja: えっと……どうも!

key: I'm Crim!
en: I'm Crim!
ja: クリムです!

key: As of the time of writing this, I'm in my last quarter of college, and I'm in my early twenties.
en: As of the time of writing this, I'm in my last quarter of college, and I'm in my early twenties.
ja: これを書いてる時点で、大学最後の学期にいて、20代前半なの。

key: If you've seen me around the server, you might know me better as, let's see--
en: If you've seen me around the server, you might know me better as, let's see--
ja: サーバーであたしを見かけたことがあるなら、こう呼ばれてる方がピンと来るかも――

key: "That person who speaks in 50% cat emotes."
en: "That person who speaks in 50% cat emotes."
ja: 「猫の絵文字を5割の割合で使う人」

key: Or uses way too many exclamation points!
en: Or uses way too many exclamation points!
ja: もしくは「感嘆符を使いすぎる人」!

key: I'm a Communications major, with a minor in Theater.
en: I'm a Communications major, with a minor in Theater.
ja: 専攻はコミュニケーション学で、副専攻は演劇。

key: I've been around the community since... early 2019?
en: I've been around the community since... early 2019?
ja: このコミュニティにいるのは……2019年の初め頃から?

key: Even then, I only really became active when joining Starlight dev in mid 2020.
en: Even then, I only really became active when joining Starlight dev in mid 2020.
ja: それでも本当にアクティブになったのは、2020年半ばにスターライトの開発に加わってから。

key: Before that though, I'd still been playing Reborn! I started in E6! So about... 2013? 2014?
en: Before that though, I'd still been playing Reborn! I started in E6! So about... 2013? 2014?
ja: でもそれ以前から、リボーンはずっとプレイしてたよ! エピソード6から始めたの! だから……2013年? 2014年くらい?

key: I regret that I hadn't been able to find the community-- not just the game-- sooner than I did,
en: I regret that I hadn't been able to find the community-- not just the game-- sooner than I did,
ja: ゲームだけじゃなくて、コミュニティにもっと早く出会えなかったのが心残りではあるけど、

key: But better late than never, you know?
en: But better late than never, you know?
ja: 遅くても、来ないよりはマシってやつだよね?

key: I've got a whole category dedicated to Reborn, so assuming you're reading these in order, you've already read about my experience with it!
en: I've got a whole category dedicated to Reborn, so assuming you're reading these in order, you've already read about my experience with it!
ja: リボーンに関するカテゴリーがまるまる一つあるから、順番に読んでくれてるなら、もうあたしの体験談は読んでくれてるはず!

key: But as for what it really means to me personally?
en: But as for what it really means to me personally?
ja: でも、個人的に本当にどんな意味を持つかってこと?

key: I'm going to take a leaf out of Vulpes' book, and just roll out the yellow caution tape really quick.
en: I'm going to take a leaf out of Vulpes' book, and just roll out the yellow caution tape really quick.
ja: ヴルペスの真似をして、さっと注意喚起のテープを張っておくね。

key: It's currently 4:34 AM, so I'm a little more emotional than normal-- which is saying something.
en: It's currently 4:34 AM, so I'm a little more emotional than normal-- which is saying something.
ja: 今は午前4時34分だから、いつもよりちょっと感傷的になってると思う――それがどれだけかは察してほしい。

key: So if you're not up for it, please take the opportunity to back out if you'd like!
en: So if you're not up for it, please take the opportunity to back out if you'd like!
ja: だから、心構えができてないなら、ここで引き返してもいいからね!

key: CRIM: Alrighty.
en: CRIM: Alrighty.
ja: クリム: よし。

key: So this is probably evident either from the rest of my dialogue-- or if you've spent more than a few minutes around me,
en: So this is probably evident either from the rest of my dialogue-- or if you've spent more than a few minutes around me,
ja: これはあたしの他の話からも、もしくは数分でもあたしと一緒に過ごしたことがあれば、たぶん明らかだと思うけど、

key: But I've had a pretty severe case of anxiety-- for a long time now.
en: But I've had a pretty severe case of anxiety-- for a long time now.
ja: あたしはかなりひどい不安障害を、もうずっと長いこと抱えてる。

key: I hold myself as a person and my work to a really high standard, and tend to overthink and spiral over this to an extreme.
en: I hold myself as a person and my work to a really high standard, and tend to overthink and spiral over this to an extreme.
ja: 自分自身にも自分の仕事にもすごく高い基準を課してて、それについて考えすぎて極端に思考が渦を巻いてしまう傾向があるの。

key: This was especially prevalent when working on Reborn-- I'd freeze up at the thought of even starting something, out of fear I'd mess it up.
en: This was especially prevalent when working on Reborn-- I'd freeze up at the thought of even starting something, out of fear I'd mess it up.
ja: これはリボーンの仕事をしてる時、特に顕著だった――何かを始めることを考えただけで固まっちゃうくらい、失敗するんじゃないかって怖かったの。

key: Or couldn't live up to some arbitrary expectation that I'd set for myself.
en: Or couldn't live up to some arbitrary expectation that I'd set for myself.
ja: もしくは、自分で勝手に設定した、根拠のない期待に応えられないんじゃないかって。

key: It was the sort of thinking that was like...
en: It was the sort of thinking that was like...
ja: こんな考え方だった……

key: "This is really going to be in Reborn? This is the big leagues now, it has to be good."
en: "This is really going to be in Reborn? This is the big leagues now, it has to be good."
ja: 「これ本当にリボーンに入るの? もう本格的な舞台なんだから、絶対良いものじゃなきゃ」

key: So I'd get extremely hung up on the tiniest of details and paralyze myself over them.
en: So I'd get extremely hung up on the tiniest of details and paralyze myself over them.
ja: だから、ほんのささいな細部にもすごくこだわって、そのことで自分を身動きできなくしてた。

key: It was the same with interaction-- I struggled with feeling as if I couldn't meet a standard of simply existing in a space without feeling as if I was intruding or in the way.
en: It was the same with interaction-- I struggled with feeling as if I couldn't meet a standard of simply existing in a space without feeling as if I was intruding or in the way.
ja: 人との関わりでも同じだった――邪魔になってるとか押しかけてるとか感じずに、ただその場に存在するっていう基準すら満たせないんじゃないかって苦しんでた。

key: I tend to worry about others over myself often, and want to make sure people are comfortable and happy, so...
en: I tend to worry about others over myself often, and want to make sure people are comfortable and happy, so...
ja: 自分より他人のことを心配しがちで、みんなが快適で幸せでいられるようにしたいと思うから……

key: It was kind of a constant presence in my head.
en: It was kind of a constant presence in my head.
ja: 頭の中に、それがずっと居座ってた感じ。

key: Honestly, I'd be lying to myself if I said it wasn't a problem I'm still fighting with.
en: Honestly, I'd be lying to myself if I said it wasn't a problem I'm still fighting with.
ja: 正直、今もまだそれと戦ってる問題じゃないって言ったらうそになる。

key: But Reborn itself, especially the dev server and the friends within it-- has really helped me.
en: But Reborn itself, especially the dev server and the friends within it-- has really helped me.
ja: でもリボーン自体、特に開発サーバーとその中の友達には、本当に助けられてきた。

key: It was a comfort to have a space where I could just be, without getting caught up in intrusive thoughts.
en: It was a comfort to have a space where I could just be, without getting caught up in intrusive thoughts.
ja: 侵入的な考えに巻き込まれずに、ただ「いる」だけでいい場所があるのは、すごく心の支えになった。

key: Baby steps, but we're getting there.
en: Baby steps, but we're getting there.
ja: 一歩ずつだけど、ちゃんと前に進んでる。

key: I certainly wouldn't be making the same progress as I am without them.
en: I certainly wouldn't be making the same progress as I am without them.
ja: みんながいなかったら、絶対今ほどの進歩はできてなかったと思う。

key: A friend sent me a song once-- one of its lyrics goes like this:
en: A friend sent me a song once-- one of its lyrics goes like this:
ja: 友達が一度歌を送ってくれたことがあって――その歌詞の一節がこんな感じなの:

key: "Life is not the things that we do, it's who we're doing them with."
en: "Life is not the things that we do, it's who we're doing them with."
ja: 「人生は、何をするかじゃなくて、誰とそれをするかだ」

key: And... yeah.
en: And... yeah.
ja: ……そう、そうなの。

key: Like, Reborn's been an unforgettable experience to work on-- wouldn't trade it for the world.
en: Like, Reborn's been an unforgettable experience to work on-- wouldn't trade it for the world.
ja: リボーンに関わったのは、忘れられない経験だった――何と引き換えにしても手放したくないくらい。

key: But everyone on the team has really made that journey all the more special.
en: But everyone on the team has really made that journey all the more special.
ja: でもチームのみんなが、その旅路をもっと特別なものにしてくれた。

key: Ame, for inviting me on this journey,
en: Ame, for inviting me on this journey,
ja: アメには、この旅に招いてくれたことを、

key: And everyone else in this room with me, and even those who aren't--
en: And everyone else in this room with me, and even those who aren't--
ja: そしてこの部屋にいる他のみんな、それにここにはいない人たちにも――

key: It really wouldn't have been the same without them,
en: It really wouldn't have been the same without them,
ja: みんながいなかったら、絶対同じにはならなかった、

key: And I'm proud to call all of them dear friends.
en: And I'm proud to call all of them dear friends.
ja: みんなを大切な友達だって呼べることを、誇りに思ってる。

key: CRIM: And well, if any of this happens to be relatable to anyone reading?
en: CRIM: And well, if any of this happens to be relatable to anyone reading?
ja: クリム: それで、もしこれを読んでる誰かに、少しでも共感できるところがあったら?

key: Know that you're not alone, and you deserve to give yourself a little more credit.
en: Know that you're not alone, and you deserve to give yourself a little more credit.
ja: 自分は一人じゃないって、そして自分をもっと認めてあげていいんだって、知っておいてね。

key: People care for you and love you more than you think.
en: People care for you and love you more than you think.
ja: あなたが思ってるよりずっと多くの人が、あなたのことを気にかけて、大切に思ってる。

key: If you're struggling with doing the things that you want to do-- it's okay to give yourself time.
en: If you're struggling with doing the things that you want to do-- it's okay to give yourself time.
ja: やりたいことをやるのに苦労してるなら――自分に時間をあげていいんだよ。

key: Surround yourself with people that see you as the joy you are to be around,
en: Surround yourself with people that see you as the joy you are to be around,
ja: あなたと一緒にいることを純粋に喜びだと感じてくれる人たちに、自分を囲んであげて、

key: And treat you with the same kindness and love as you deserve.
en: And treat you with the same kindness and love as you deserve.
ja: あなたが値するのと同じ優しさと愛情で、あなたを扱ってくれる人たちに。

key: Of course, it's not something that comes overnight.
en: Of course, it's not something that comes overnight.
ja: もちろん、一晩で手に入るものじゃないけど。

key: I know I get caught up in those kinds of thoughts too.
en: I know I get caught up in those kinds of thoughts too.
ja: あたしもそういう考えにとらわれることがあるって分かってる。

key: But I hope that someday-- if that day isn't today-- you'll be able to see just how brightly you shine.
en: But I hope that someday-- if that day isn't today-- you'll be able to see just how brightly you shine.
ja: でもいつか――それが今日じゃなくても――あなたがどれだけ輝いているか、自分の目で見られる日が来ますように。

key: ...Would you like to talk about anything else?
en: ...Would you like to talk about anything else?
ja: ……他に何か話したいことある?

key: CRIM: Of course.
en: CRIM: Of course.
ja: クリム: もちろん。

key: Please take care of yourself!
en: Please take care of yourself!
ja: 自分を大事にしてね!

key: I hope you have a lovely day~
en: I hope you have a lovely day~
ja: 素敵な一日を過ごせますように~

key: Or night, whenever you're reading this!
en: Or night, whenever you're reading this!
ja: それとも夜かな、これを読んでるのがいつでも!

key: CRIM: Oh? You're approaching me?
en: CRIM: Oh? You're approaching me?
ja: クリム: あら? 挑んでくるんだ?

key: Okay, but I'm more prepared this time!
en: Okay, but I'm more prepared this time!
ja: オーケー、でも今回はもっと準備してきたから!

key: I'll have you know, I'm still kind of awful at this game!
en: I'll have you know, I'm still kind of awful at this game!
ja: 言っておくけど、あたし、今でもこのゲーム下手だから!

key: That has not changed!
en: That has not changed!
ja: そこは変わってない!

key: ...But you know how I can fix that?
en: ...But you know how I can fix that?
ja: ……でもそれをどう克服するか知ってる?

key: With a big heckin' sword!
en: With a big heckin' sword!
ja: でっかい剣でどうにかする!

key: Let's go!!
en: Let's go!!
ja: いくよ!!

key: Aww, shoot. I'll be sure to ace it next time~
en: Aww, shoot. I'll be sure to ace it next time~
ja: あーあ、しくじった。次はきっと決めてみせるから~

key: CRIM: Okay, sorry, um, heck--
en: CRIM: Okay, sorry, um, heck--
ja: クリム: オーケー、ごめん、その、しまった――

key: That wasn't in the cards--?
en: That wasn't in the cards--?
ja: こんなはずじゃなかったんだけど――?

key: I'm proud of you though, great job!
en: I'm proud of you though, great job!
ja: でもあなたのこと誇りに思うよ、よくやった!

key: Here, I'll fix up your team and you can have some BP.
en: Here, I'll fix up your team and you can have some BP.
ja: はい、パーティー直しておくから、BPをどうぞ。

key: ...And, hey, as a gift from me to you!
en: ...And, hey, as a gift from me to you!
ja: ……それと、ねえ、あたしからのプレゼント!

key: Just this once!
en: Just this once!
ja: 今回だけね!

key: Here's a few extra BP!
en: Here's a few extra BP!
ja: 追加でBPをどうぞ!

key: As a treat.
en: As a treat.
ja: ご褒美ってことで。

key: You've come this far, and honestly, you deserve it!
en: You've come this far, and honestly, you deserve it!
ja: ここまで来たんだし、正直、その資格あるよ!

key: That brings you to... \v[593] BP now!
en: That brings you to... \v[593] BP now!
ja: これで所持BPは……\v[593]になった!

key: CRIM: ...Oh. I wasn't expecting to actually win there.
en: CRIM: ...Oh. I wasn't expecting to actually win there.
ja: クリム: ……あ。実際に勝つとは思ってなかった。

key: That's okay though, you did great!
en: That's okay though, you did great!
ja: でも大丈夫、よくやったよ!

key: Let me fix up your team.
en: Let me fix up your team.
ja: パーティー直しておくね。

key: You've definitely got it next time!
en: You've definitely got it next time!
ja: 次は絶対決められるよ!

key: Oh, and by the way?
en: Oh, and by the way?
ja: あ、そうそう?

key: I hope that my Vulpix got you!
en: I hope that my Vulpix got you!
ja: あたしのロコンがちゃんと当ててくれてたらいいな!

key: CRIM: Okay!
en: CRIM: Okay!
ja: クリム: オーケー!

key: Fair warning, I'm kind of awful at this game!
en: Fair warning, I'm kind of awful at this game!
ja: 先に言っておくけど、あたし、このゲーム結構下手だから!

key: But when you're allowed to give a team of just your favorite Pokémon a little... help?
en: But when you're allowed to give a team of just your favorite Pokémon a little... help?
ja: でも大好きなポケモンだけのチームにちょっと……力を借りていいなら?

key: Even I can stand a chance!
en: Even I can stand a chance!
ja: あたしでもチャンスあるかも!

key: ...Hopefully.
en: ...Hopefully.
ja: ……たぶんね。

key: Bring it!
en: Bring it!
ja: さあ、来て!

key: CRIM: Alrighty, no problem!
en: CRIM: Alrighty, no problem!
ja: クリム: よし、大丈夫!

key: I hope you enjoy the rest of the dev room~
en: I hope you enjoy the rest of the dev room~
ja: 開発ルームの残りも楽しんでね~

key: And the rest of the game, too!
en: And the rest of the game, too!
ja: それにゲームの残りもね!

key: I'm glad that you were able to make it this far.
en: I'm glad that you were able to make it this far.
ja: ここまで来られたこと、うれしく思うよ。

key: All the way to the end!
en: All the way to the end!
ja: 最後まで、ずっとね!

key: I hope you've been able to make as many fond memories from this game as I've been able to.
en: I hope you've been able to make as many fond memories from this game as I've been able to.
ja: あたしがこのゲームからもらったのと同じくらい、たくさんの素敵な思い出を作れてたらいいな。

key: Some days, they're all we have.
en: Some days, they're all we have.
ja: 日によっては、それがすべてになることもあるから。

key: You've still got some great things ahead of you!
en: You've still got some great things ahead of you!
ja: これからもまだまだ素敵なことが待ってるよ!

key: I hope you have-- or are able to make-- as many fond memories from this game as I do.
en: I hope you have-- or are able to make-- as many fond memories from this game as I do.
ja: あたしと同じくらい、このゲームからたくさんの素敵な思い出を作れてる――もしくはこれから作れると――いいな。

key: AUTUMN: Oh, hi there! Welcome to the Dev Room! This is uhh.. I guess where we all just kinda relax and chill?
en: AUTUMN: Oh, hi there! Welcome to the Dev Room! This is uhh.. I guess where we all just kinda relax and chill?
ja: オータム: あ、どうも! 開発ルームへようこそ! ここは、ええと……みんなでのんびりくつろぐ場所、かな?

key: It's rough out there in this great wide region, though I suppose we have you to thank for fixing that up a bit, huh?
en: It's rough out there in this great wide region, though I suppose we have you to thank for fixing that up a bit, huh?
ja: この広大な地方の外は結構大変だけど、それを少しは良くしてくれたこと、あなたに感謝すべきなんだよね?

key: So! What can I do for you?
en: So! What can I do for you?
ja: さて! 何をしてあげようか?

key: A battle? All right, I'll have you know I competed in a tournament against everyone in this room!
en: A battle? All right, I'll have you know I competed in a tournament against everyone in this room!
ja: バトル? よし、言っておくけど、この部屋にいる全員相手にトーナメントに出場したことあるんだよ!

key: I placed...
en: I placed...
ja: 結果は……

key: Dead last.
en: Dead last.
ja: ぶっちぎりの最下位。

key: So I grabbed a cool sword!
en: So I grabbed a cool sword!
ja: だからかっこいい剣を手に入れたわけ!

key: Maybe another time, then?
en: Maybe another time, then?
ja: じゃあ、また今度かな?

key: AUTUMN: Okay fine! Here, I was saving these for another Explosion TM from Sinnoh that I've heard lowers the opposing Pokémon's defense...
en: AUTUMN: Okay fine! Here, I was saving these for another Explosion TM from Sinnoh that I've heard lowers the opposing Pokémon's defense...
ja: オータム: オーケー分かった! はい、これはシンオウ産の、爆発技の相手の防御を下げるっていうTMのために取っておいたものなんだけど……

key: But, I guess you can have them.
en: But, I guess you can have them.
ja: まあ、あげちゃう。

key: That'll put you at \v[593] BP.
en: That'll put you at \v[593] BP.
ja: これで所持BPは\v[593]になったよ。

key: AUTUMN: Oof, I didn't expect I'd actually win, haha....
en: AUTUMN: Oof, I didn't expect I'd actually win, haha....
ja: オータム: うっ、実際に勝つとは思ってなかった、はは……

key: Honestly I'm not the greatest at battling. Just pretty good at finding funny ways to cheese the game.
en: Honestly I'm not the greatest at battling. Just pretty good at finding funny ways to cheese the game.
ja: 正直バトルはそんなに得意じゃないの。ただ、ゲームを面白い方法で攻略するのが得意なだけで。

key: We're actually about to have a tournament in this room to see who's actually the best! I just hope I don't come last...
en: We're actually about to have a tournament in this room to see who's actually the best! I just hope I don't come last...
ja: 実はこの部屋で、誰が本当に一番強いか決めるトーナメントをやろうとしてるんだ! 最下位にならないといいけど……

key: Hopefully this will be good practice! Don't hold back!!
en: Hopefully this will be good practice! Don't hold back!!
ja: これがいい練習になるといいな! 手加減しないでね!!

key: I have a strict rule to never talk about myself unless prompted, and while I understand that you clicked the chat button...
en: I have a strict rule to never talk about myself unless prompted, and while I understand that you clicked the chat button...
ja: 自分から話を振らない限り、自分のことは話さないっていう固いルールがあるんだけど、あなたがチャットボタンを押したのは分かってるから……

key: You're just gonna have to be more specific!
en: You're just gonna have to be more specific!
ja: もうちょっと具体的に聞いてもらわないと!

key: Um, please? \ch[62,-1,Who are you?,What do you do?,What does Reborn mean to you?,Nevermind.]
en: Um, please? \ch[62,-1,Who are you?,What do you do?,What does Reborn mean to you?,Nevermind.]
ja: さあ、どうぞ? \ch[62,-1,あなたは誰?,何をしてるの?,リボーンはあなたにとってどんな意味?,やっぱりいいや。]

key: AUTUMN: Well, as you may have already read, my name is Autumn!
en: AUTUMN: Well, as you may have already read, my name is Autumn!
ja: オータム: まあ、もう読んでくれてるかもしれないけど、名前はオータムです!

key: Though, if you're an older member of the community, you might know me better as Inuki.
en: Though, if you're an older member of the community, you might know me better as Inuki.
ja: でももしコミュニティの古参なら、イヌキって名前の方がピンと来るかも。

key: Yeah, that Inuki. Of Porygon2 bridge fame. Alas, that was a few genders and plenty of life lived ago.
en: Yeah, that Inuki. Of Porygon2 bridge fame. Alas, that was a few genders and plenty of life lived ago.
ja: そう、あのイヌキ。ポリゴン2の橋で有名な。ああ、あれはいくつかの性別と、たくさんの人生経験を経た昔の話だけど。

key: Outside of that... Who am I? Heck if I know, but here! I'll give you 5 fun facts instead of a proper answer!
en: Outside of that... Who am I? Heck if I know, but here! I'll give you 5 fun facts instead of a proper answer!
ja: それ以外だと……自分は何者かって? 正直自分でもよく分かんないけど、はい! ちゃんとした答えの代わりに面白い事実を5つあげるね!

key: Fact 1: You see that dude sitting a tile away from me? His positioning isn't a coincidence!
en: Fact 1: You see that dude sitting a tile away from me? His positioning isn't a coincidence!
ja: 事実その1: あたしから一マス離れたところに座ってるあの人、見える? あの位置取りは偶然じゃないよ!

key: He's been my best friend for literally more than half of my life! (I'm 27 btw.)
en: He's been my best friend for literally more than half of my life! (I'm 27 btw.)
ja: 文字通り、人生の半分以上、あの人が親友なの!(ちなみにあたしは27歳。)

key: The butterfly effect is silly to think about. Stepping on a butterfly just makes you rude, it's highly improbable anything will come of it.
en: The butterfly effect is silly to think about. Stepping on a butterfly just makes you rude, it's highly improbable anything will come of it.
ja: バタフライ効果って考え出すと馬鹿らしいよね。チョウを踏んづけたって、ただ失礼なだけで、何かが起きる確率なんてほぼゼロだし。

key: But meeting him? That's the event that really kicked off every other event in my life.
en: But meeting him? That's the event that really kicked off every other event in my life.
ja: でもあの人と出会ったこと? それがあたしの人生の他の全部のきっかけになった出来事なの。

key: Answering who I am is literally impossible without mentioning his involvement.
en: Answering who I am is literally impossible without mentioning his involvement.
ja: あの人が関わったことに触れずに、あたしが何者かなんて答えるの、文字通り不可能。

key: I love you, fam. Thanks for all your help in paving the road I walk.
en: I love you, fam. Thanks for all your help in paving the road I walk.
ja: 愛してるよ、相棒。あたしが歩いてる道を切り開いてくれて、色々ありがとう。

key: Fact 2: Mega Diancie is my favorite Pokémon!
en: Fact 2: Mega Diancie is my favorite Pokémon!
ja: 事実その2: メガディアンシーが一番好きなポケモン!

key: Fact 3: Once, while programming something involving field effects way back when...
en: Fact 3: Once, while programming something involving field effects way back when...
ja: 事実その3: 昔、フィールド効果関連の何かをプログラミングしてた時のこと……

key: Like, a few episodes after they came out.
en: Like, a few episodes after they came out.
ja: フィールド効果が実装されてから数エピソード後くらいの話だけど。

key: I forgot that case statements existed and instead created a nested if statement that contained no less than 30 "end"s.
en: I forgot that case statements existed and instead created a nested if statement that contained no less than 30 "end"s.
ja: case文の存在をすっかり忘れてて、代わりに30個以上の「end」を含むネストしたif文を作っちゃったの。

key: All lined up at the end of it.
en: All lined up at the end of it.
ja: 全部の最後にずらっと並んでてね。

key: Fact 3.5: I was a computer science major.
en: Fact 3.5: I was a computer science major.
ja: 事実その3.5: あたし、コンピューターサイエンス専攻だったの。

key: "Was."
en: "Was."
ja: 「だった」ね。

key: Fact 4: My appearance here is based on my Dungeons and Dragons character: Deneb!
en: Fact 4: My appearance here is based on my Dungeons and Dragons character: Deneb!
ja: 事実その4: ここでのあたしの見た目は、自分のダンジョンズ&ドラゴンズのキャラ、デネブがモデルなの!

key: She's currently an Archfey warlock who gained the favor of a bunch of fae butterflies, eventually revealed to be her father's old swarm!
en: She's currently an Archfey warlock who gained the favor of a bunch of fae butterflies, eventually revealed to be her father's old swarm!
ja: 今は、たくさんの妖精のチョウの好意を得たアークフェイ・ウォーロックで、最終的にそのチョウたちが、彼女の父親の昔の群れだったって判明するの!

key: He was kind of a jerk and maybe so are they? Being a jerk seems to be a trait of that side of the family, though.
en: He was kind of a jerk and maybe so are they? Being a jerk seems to be a trait of that side of the family, though.
ja: その父親、結構嫌なやつだったんだけど、チョウたちもそうなのかな? 嫌なやつってのがあの家系の特徴っぽいけど。

key: ....Anyway.....
en: ....Anyway.....
ja: ……とにかく……

key: The tiny child on the couch closer to the back is the DM of that campaign actually!
en: The tiny child on the couch closer to the back is the DM of that campaign actually!
ja: 奥の方のソファに座ってる小さい子が、実はそのキャンペーンのDMなんだよね!

key: I've used it a lot to get comfortable with referring to myself with different pronouns over the years.
en: I've used it a lot to get comfortable with referring to myself with different pronouns over the years.
ja: 長年、違う代名詞で自分を呼ぶことに慣れるために、あのキャラをずいぶん使ってきたんだ。

key: But more importantly it's a really good story! It's been a blast to cooperatively write it with them every session!
en: But more importantly it's a really good story! It's been a blast to cooperatively write it with them every session!
ja: でもそれ以上に、本当に良い物語なの! 毎セッション、みんなで一緒に書き上げていくのが最高に楽しかった!

key: Fact 5: I find it very likely that I have a fairly severe case of the ADHD.
en: Fact 5: I find it very likely that I have a fairly severe case of the ADHD.
ja: 事実その5: 自分はかなり深刻なADHDを抱えてる可能性が高いと思う。

key: This isn't anything particularly groundbreaking, and by the time the game releases this question will have been answered.
en: This isn't anything particularly groundbreaking, and by the time the game releases this question will have been answered.
ja: これは別に画期的なことでも何でもなくて、このゲームがリリースされる頃には、この質問にはもう答えが出てると思う。

key: We'll see if I remember to come back and fix this, or if it stays like this forever.
en: We'll see if I remember to come back and fix this, or if it stays like this forever.
ja: 戻ってきてこれを直すのを覚えてるか、それとも永遠にこのままか、様子見だね。

key: Phew, okay! Is there anything else you wanted to ask?
en: Phew, okay! Is there anything else you wanted to ask?
ja: ふう、オーケー! 他に何か聞きたいことある?

key: All right, a different prompt!
en: All right, a different prompt!
ja: 了解、別の話題ね!

key: Gotcha, please enjoy the rest of the dev room!
en: Gotcha, please enjoy the rest of the dev room!
ja: 分かった、開発ルームの残りも楽しんでね!

key: Precious little, compared to everyone else in this room...
en: Precious little, compared to everyone else in this room...
ja: この部屋の他のみんなに比べたら、ほんのわずかだけど……

key: The more interesting answer is that I'm one of the move animators. I make the funny pictures move when you click buttons in battle.
en: The more interesting answer is that I'm one of the move animators. I make the funny pictures move when you click buttons in battle.
ja: もっと面白い答えとしては、あたしは技のアニメーターの一人ってこと。バトルでボタンを押した時に動く、あの面白い絵を動かす担当なの。

key: I word it like this because I do not create the funny pictures that do the moving. I have no real artistic ability whatsoever.
en: I word it like this because I do not create the funny pictures that do the moving. I have no real artistic ability whatsoever.
ja: こう言うのは、あたし自身は動かす対象の面白い絵を「作って」はいないから。芸術的な才能なんて本当に何もないの。

key: I don't have the ability to visualize images in my head. I can't see what something will look like without doing it.
en: I don't have the ability to visualize images in my head. I can't see what something will look like without doing it.
ja: 頭の中でイメージを思い浮かべる能力もないの。実際にやってみないと、それがどう見えるか分からないタイプ。

key: I have very strong opinions on how I want the moves I animate to feel.
en: I have very strong opinions on how I want the moves I animate to feel.
ja: でも、自分がアニメーションを作る技にどんな「感じ」を持たせたいか、すごく強いこだわりがある。

key: Unfortunately this makes me remarkably unproductive when I can't put that feeling to paper, so to speak.
en: Unfortunately this makes me remarkably unproductive when I can't put that feeling to paper, so to speak.
ja: 残念ながら、その感覚を実際の形にできない時、あたしはものすごく非生産的になっちゃうの。

key: That mixed with my terrible work ethic definitely led me to be the least productive member by far.
en: That mixed with my terrible work ethic definitely led me to be the least productive member by far.
ja: それに加えて、あたしのひどい労働倫理も相まって、間違いなく一番生産性の低いメンバーになったと思う。

key: When I do finally make something though, I try to put my whole heart into it! I hope that shows, especially during Full Power Z-Moves!
en: When I do finally make something though, I try to put my whole heart into it! I hope that shows, especially during Full Power Z-Moves!
ja: でもやっと何か作れた時は、心を込めて作るようにしてる! それが伝わってたらいいな、特にフルパワーZワザの時とか!

key: Anyway, is there anything else you wanted to ask?
en: Anyway, is there anything else you wanted to ask?
ja: とにかく、他に何か聞きたいことある?

key: So if you're reading these in order, you may notice that I seemed pretty bummed about my relative lack of contribution.
en: So if you're reading these in order, you may notice that I seemed pretty bummed about my relative lack of contribution.
ja: 順番に読んでくれてるなら、あたしが自分の相対的な貢献の少なさについて結構気にしてるって、気付いたかもしれない。

key: Perhaps that's just a natural reaction, a way anybody like me might feel.
en: Perhaps that's just a natural reaction, a way anybody like me might feel.
ja: それはたぶん、あたしみたいな人間なら誰でも感じる自然な反応なんだと思う。

key: But I feel that way because I absolutely love this game, and, at least my memories of the community.
en: But I feel that way because I absolutely love this game, and, at least my memories of the community.
ja: でもそう感じてしまうのは、このゲームが本当に大好きで、少なくともコミュニティの思い出が大好きだからなの。

key: So back in the day, right? My best friend and I were scrolling through Pokémon Online servers, trying to find an enjoyable place.
en: So back in the day, right? My best friend and I were scrolling through Pokémon Online servers, trying to find an enjoyable place.
ja: だから、昔の話をすると? 親友とあたしで、ポケモンオンラインのサーバーをスクロールしながら、居心地のいい場所を探してたの。

key: As you may be aware of, not all communities are welcoming to everyone.
en: As you may be aware of, not all communities are welcoming to everyone.
ja: 知ってるかもしれないけど、全部のコミュニティが誰にでも優しいってわけじゃないよね。

key: It just so happens that my favorite anime is called "Katekyo Hitman Reborn!"
en: It just so happens that my favorite anime is called "Katekyo Hitman Reborn!"
ja: たまたま、あたしの一番好きなアニメが「家庭教師ヒットマンREBORN!」ってやつでね。

key: So when I came across a server with Reborn in its name, monkey brain went click.
en: So when I came across a server with Reborn in its name, monkey brain went click.
ja: だから名前に「Reborn」が入ってるサーバーを見つけた時、脳みそが勝手にクリックしちゃったの。

key: What a marvelous coincidence that turned out to be.
en: What a marvelous coincidence that turned out to be.
ja: 振り返ってみると、なんて素晴らしい偶然だったんだろうって思う。

key: A few years pass, Ame starts making a cool game, I play it as you do. I don't really think anything of it.
en: A few years pass, Ame starts making a cool game, I play it as you do. I don't really think anything of it.
ja: 数年経って、アメがかっこいいゲームを作り始めて、あたしも普通にプレイしたの。特に深くは考えてなかった。

key: The details are blurry, but my first act as a "Dev" was filling in the pages of the Field Effect Library.
en: The details are blurry, but my first act as a "Dev" was filling in the pages of the Field Effect Library.
ja: 細かい記憶は曖昧だけど、「開発陣」としての最初の仕事は、フィールド効果ライブラリのページ埋めだった。

key: Basically cooking up 100 pots of copypasta and draping the noodles into digital books.
en: Basically cooking up 100 pots of copypasta and draping the noodles into digital books.
ja: 要は、コピペを100個くらい大量生産して、デジタルの本にひたすら流し込んでいく作業。

key: It was a good time, I enjoyed feeling helpful! Eventually I simply became a general purpose assistant.
en: It was a good time, I enjoyed feeling helpful! Eventually I simply became a general purpose assistant.
ja: いい時間だったよ、役に立ってる感じがうれしかった! そのうち、あたしは何でも屋のアシスタントになっていった。

key: Were there a thing to do that wasn't particularly complicated, I would be the one to do it!
en: Were there a thing to do that wasn't particularly complicated, I would be the one to do it!
ja: 特に複雑じゃないけどやらなきゃいけないことがあれば、大体あたしがやる係だった!

key: Like making a bunch of cliffs, remaking Route 2 three times, calculating how much soup could fit in a mountain.
en: Like making a bunch of cliffs, remaking Route 2 three times, calculating how much soup could fit in a mountain.
ja: 崖をいっぱい作ったり、2番道路を三回も作り直したり、山にどれだけスープが入るか計算したり。

key: Ame, Dan, and I were in a Skype call regularly. It was a really good time!
en: Ame, Dan, and I were in a Skype call regularly. It was a really good time!
ja: アメとダンとあたしは定期的にSkype通話をしてた。本当に楽しい時間だったな!

key: Eventually the animation:tm: project started cause the animations that came with essentials were, how you say... weirdchamp.
en: Eventually the animation:tm: project started cause the animations that came with essentials were, how you say... weirdchamp.
ja: そのうちアニメーション:tm:プロジェクトが始まったの、essentialsに元々ついてたアニメーションが、その、なんていうか……微妙だったから。

key: I remember Ame had already made a few that were really sick but then her hand decided to be a bit dramatic.
en: I remember Ame had already made a few that were really sick but then her hand decided to be a bit dramatic.
ja: アメがもういくつかすごく格好いいのを作ってたのを覚えてるけど、そのうち手が疲れちゃって。

key: So she showed me how to do it!
en: So she showed me how to do it!
ja: だからアメがやり方を教えてくれたの!

key: So I started doing it!
en: So I started doing it!
ja: それであたしもやり始めた!

key: And now here I am! Incredibly grateful for the opportunity that Ame has given me to work on her game.
en: And now here I am! Incredibly grateful for the opportunity that Ame has given me to work on her game.
ja: それで今、ここにいるってわけ! アメが自分のゲームに関わらせてくれたチャンスに、本当に感謝してる。

key: And incredibly grateful for the home her community has been for the past........
en: And incredibly grateful for the home her community has been for the past........
ja: それに、彼女のコミュニティがこの……

key: Very long time.
en: Very long time.
ja: すごく長い時間、居場所になってくれたことにも感謝してる。

key: I hope it's a significantly longer time to come.
en: I hope it's a significantly longer time to come.
ja: これからもっとずっと長く続くといいな。

key: AUTUMN: Oh, okay! Enjoy the rest of the dev room, then!
en: AUTUMN: Oh, okay! Enjoy the rest of the dev room, then!
ja: オータム: あ、オーケー! じゃあ開発ルームの残りも楽しんでね!

key: AUTUMN: Oh,\| right,\| yeah,\| sure,\| of course.\| Hey, before you go, what's your favorite Pokémon?
en: AUTUMN: Oh,\| right,\| yeah,\| sure,\| of course.\| Hey, before you go, what's your favorite Pokémon?
ja: オータム: あ、\|そうだ、\|うん、\|いいよ、\|もちろん。\|ねえ、行く前に、一番好きなポケモンは何?

key: No idea what you put in that text box.\|
en: No idea what you put in that text box.\|
ja: そのテキストボックスに何を入れたのか分かんないけど。\|

key: But it's removed from the game now.\|
en: But it's removed from the game now.\|
ja: もうゲームからは削除済みだから。\|

key: I hope being rude was worth it.
en: I hope being rude was worth it.
ja: 失礼な態度に見合う価値があったといいけど。

key: JAN: Hi! Hello! Bet you didn't think you'd see me down here?
en: JAN: Hi! Hello! Bet you didn't think you'd see me down here?
ja: ジャン: やあ! こんにちは! まさかここでボクに会うとは思ってなかったでしょ?

key: I mean, yeah, technically this isn't really my world.
en: I mean, yeah, technically this isn't really my world.
ja: っていうか、まあ、厳密にはここはボクの世界じゃないんだけどね。

key: Well, technically I've been to this world first...
en: Well, technically I've been to this world first...
ja: いや、厳密にはこの世界に最初に来たのはボクの方だったような……

key: Um... Forget about all of that!
en: Um... Forget about all of that!
ja: うーん……そんなことは全部忘れて!

key: JAN: So, what do you need?
en: JAN: So, what do you need?
ja: ジャン: それで、何が必要?

key: JAN: Oh... Yeah, we do that in this world don't we?
en: JAN: Oh... Yeah, we do that in this world don't we?
ja: ジャン: あ……そうだよね、この世界だとそうするんだよね?

key: Battling? Um, admittedly I'm not the best at that. I'm still an intern, after all!
en: Battling? Um, admittedly I'm not the best at that. I'm still an intern, after all!
ja: バトル? うーん、正直あんまり得意じゃないんだ。まだインターン生だからね、仕方ないよ!

key: But I'll do my best!
en: But I'll do my best!
ja: でもベストは尽くすよ!

key: JAN: Fuck.
en: JAN: Fuck.
ja: ジャン: くそ。

key: Okay, okay... You win fair and square.
en: Okay, okay... You win fair and square.
ja: オーケー、オーケー……正々堂々、あなたの勝ちだよ。

key: I'll have my revenge on you yet. Maybe not in this world, but...
en: I'll have my revenge on you yet. Maybe not in this world, but...
ja: いつかふくしゅうしてやるからね。この世界じゃないかもしれないけど……

key: Somewhere, someplace, the cycle of suffering will never end.
en: Somewhere, someplace, the cycle of suffering will never end.
ja: どこか、どこかの場所で、苦しみの循環は決して終わらない。

key: We'll play forever and ever and ever and ever until we get the ending we're satisfied with.
en: We'll play forever and ever and ever and ever until we get the ending we're satisfied with.
ja: 満足いく結末になるまで、ボクらは永遠に、何度でも戦い続けるんだ。

key: Karma's a bitch.
en: Karma's a bitch.
ja: 因果応報ってやつだね。

key: JAN: All right, enough of that. You have \v[593] BP now.
en: JAN: All right, enough of that. You have \v[593] BP now.
ja: ジャン: よし、これくらいにしとこう。所持BPは\v[593]になったよ。

key: JAN: This is just the lemonade stand all over again...
en: JAN: This is just the lemonade stand all over again...
ja: ジャン: これじゃまるでレモネードスタンドの再来だ……

key: JAN: You wanna chat? Sure! What do you wanna chat about?
en: JAN: You wanna chat? Sure! What do you wanna chat about?
ja: ジャン: おしゃべりしたい? いいよ! 何について話す?

key: JAN: Yeah. That's my lore.
en: JAN: Yeah. That's my lore.
ja: ジャン: うん。それがボクの背景設定。

key: Right now I'm a senior at Axis High University.
en: Right now I'm a senior at Axis High University.
ja: 今はアクシス・ハイ大学の最上級生なんだ。

key: I'm required to take up an internship job before I can graduate.
en: I'm required to take up an internship job before I can graduate.
ja: 卒業前にインターンシップに就くことが義務付けられててね。

key: But between you and me... None of that really matters anyway.
en: But between you and me... None of that really matters anyway.
ja: でも、ここだけの話……そんなの本当はどうでもいいんだけど。

key: It's a way to "tie up loose ends" and justify my existence in this world.
en: It's a way to "tie up loose ends" and justify my existence in this world.
ja: これは「けじめをつける」ため、この世界での自分の存在を正当化するための手段なんだ。

key: That's one of the rules, right? If there's no justification for my existence then I'll just disappear into little bitty pixels.
en: That's one of the rules, right? If there's no justification for my existence then I'll just disappear into little bitty pixels.
ja: それがルールの一つでしょ? 存在に正当な理由がなければ、ただの小さなピクセルの粒に消えちゃうんだから。

key: You look confused? I think I have that effect on people a lot...
en: You look confused? I think I have that effect on people a lot...
ja: 戸惑ってる顔してる? みんなにそういう顔されがちなんだよね……

key: Well, don't try to think about it too much, yes?
en: Well, don't try to think about it too much, yes?
ja: まあ、あんまり深く考えないでね、いい?

key: JAN: Ooh, you were listening!
en: JAN: Ooh, you were listening!
ja: ジャン: おっ、ちゃんと聞いてくれてたんだ!

key: Okay, so that's half truth. I am from this world!
en: Okay, so that's half truth. I am from this world!
ja: オーケー、じゃあ半分は本当のことを言うと。ボクはこの世界の出身なんだ!

key: In fact, it's where I was born. Conceptually.
en: In fact, it's where I was born. Conceptually.
ja: っていうか、ここがボクの生まれた場所。概念的にはね。

key: But eventually, after some time I was able to leave using the process of "blooming".
en: But eventually, after some time I was able to leave using the process of "blooming".
ja: でも最終的に、しばらくしてから「ブルーミング」っていう過程を使ってここを離れられたんだ。

key: I bloomed! After that I left and created my own world.
en: I bloomed! After that I left and created my own world.
ja: 咲いたんだよ! それからここを離れて、自分の世界を作った。

key: Technically...
en: Technically...
ja: 厳密には……

key: It wasn't all me. I have friends who came with me and stuff.
en: It wasn't all me. I have friends who came with me and stuff.
ja: 全部自分一人でやったわけじゃないけどね。一緒についてきてくれた友達とかもいるし。

key: Hey, what's that look for? You act as if I'm talking nonsense...
en: Hey, what's that look for? You act as if I'm talking nonsense...
ja: ねえ、その顔なに? まるでボクがでたらめ言ってるみたいな……

key: All of this makes sense, trust me. I wouldn't lie to you.
en: All of this makes sense, trust me. I wouldn't lie to you.
ja: これ全部ちゃんと筋が通ってるんだよ、信じて。うそなんてつかないから。

key: JAN: Admittedly, I stole this option from Cass because I think a lot of what she says applies to me too.
en: JAN: Admittedly, I stole this option from Cass because I think a lot of what she says applies to me too.
ja: ジャン: 正直に言うと、この選択肢はキャスから盗んだんだ、彼女が言ってることの多くはボクにも当てはまると思うから。

key: But I think it's sort of an understatement to say that Reborn has changed my life.
en: But I think it's sort of an understatement to say that Reborn has changed my life.
ja: でも、リボーンがボクの人生を変えたっていうのは、控えめすぎる表現だと思う。

key: I was sort of aimless and without purpose before I found Reborn.
en: I was sort of aimless and without purpose before I found Reborn.
ja: リボーンに出会う前は、目的もなく、なんとなくさまよってた感じだったんだ。

key: Then I saw how much work Ame put into this world and I decided I wanted to try and apply myself similarly.
en: Then I saw how much work Ame put into this world and I decided I wanted to try and apply myself similarly.
ja: それでアメがこの世界にどれだけの労力を注いだかを見て、自分も同じくらい打ち込んでみたいと思ったんだ。

key: That's how I was able to "bloom" and create the world of Rejuvenation.
en: That's how I was able to "bloom" and create the world of Rejuvenation.
ja: そうやって「開花」できて、リジュブネーションの世界を作ったんだよ。

key: That bloom wasn't exactly pretty... A lot of my early attempts were met with some backlash and stuff like that.
en: That bloom wasn't exactly pretty... A lot of my early attempts were met with some backlash and stuff like that.
ja: その開花、あんまりきれいなものじゃなかったんだけどね……初期の試みの多くは反発を食らったりしたし。

key: It was my first time creating a new world, jeez...
en: It was my first time creating a new world, jeez...
ja: 新しい世界を作るのなんて初めてだったんだよ、まったく……

key: I had no idea creating an entirely new line of existence would be so much work.
