en: I had no idea creating an entirely new line of existence would be so much work.
ja: まったく新しい存在の系統を作るのがこんなに大変だとは思わなかった。

key: It took a lot of time, but I think I got the hang of things now.
en: It took a lot of time, but I think I got the hang of things now.
ja: すごく時間がかかったけど、今はコツをつかめてきたと思う。

key: I guess you could say I owe everything to Ame and Reborn.
en: I guess you could say I owe everything to Ame and Reborn.
ja: 要するに、アメとリボーンには何もかも借りがあるってわけ。

key: My internship is ending...
en: My internship is ending...
ja: ボクのインターンシップも終わりに近づいてる……

key: JAN: That answer changes a lot. At first it was Dusclops, then it was Chandelure...
en: JAN: That answer changes a lot. At first it was Dusclops, then it was Chandelure...
ja: ジャン: その答え、結構変わるんだよね。最初はサマヨール、それからシャンデラで……

key: Right now as of uh... January 23rd 2022 at 10:23 pm it's Claydol.
en: Right now as of uh... January 23rd 2022 at 10:23 pm it's Claydol.
ja: 今、えっと……2022年1月23日午後10時23分の時点では、ネンドールかな。

key: JAN: Have you been to Aegir Cave? You've definitely been to Iolia...
en: JAN: Have you been to Aegir Cave? You've definitely been to Iolia...
ja: ジャン: エイギルどうくつには行った? イオリアには絶対行ってるよね……

key: Well, those two areas are what pop into my mind right now.
en: Well, those two areas are what pop into my mind right now.
ja: まあ、その二つが今すぐ思いつくところかな。

key: I really hope I'm not forgetting anything...
en: I really hope I'm not forgetting anything...
ja: 何か忘れてなきゃいいけど……

key: JAN: Cya.
en: JAN: Cya.
ja: ジャン: またね。

key: IKARU: Oh, uh, sorry.
en: IKARU: Oh, uh, sorry.
ja: イカル: あ、うーん、ごめん。

key: I sometimes find myself looking back on everything that brought me here, and I space out a little.
en: I sometimes find myself looking back on everything that brought me here, and I space out a little.
ja: たまに、自分をここに導いてくれたもの全部を振り返ってしまって、ちょっとぼーっとしちゃうんだ。

key: It's just a lot to think about, you know?
en: It's just a lot to think about, you know?
ja: 考えることが多すぎてさ、分かるでしょ?

key: Every choice I've made, however small, nudging me a little in one direction or another.
en: Every choice I've made, however small, nudging me a little in one direction or another.
ja: どんなに小さな選択でも、それが自分をあっちこっちに少しずつ押しやってきたんだ。

key: Like a visual novel, but, you know, for real, and without the relationship points.
en: Like a visual novel, but, you know, for real, and without the relationship points.
ja: ビジュアルノベルみたいだけど、ほら、これはリアルな話で、好感度みたいなのはないけど。

key: ... Or maybe with them! Just don't try Blue Moon Ice Cream on real people as a shortcut. It takes more than that.
en: ... Or maybe with them! Just don't try Blue Moon Ice Cream on real people as a shortcut. It takes more than that.
ja: ……もしかしたらあるのかも! でもブルームーンアイスクリームを近道として現実の人に試すのはやめてね。それだけじゃ足りないから。

key: Anyway, I'm Ikaru. I do the little stuff that people COULD do themselves, when their time is better spent on things I can't do.
en: Anyway, I'm Ikaru. I do the little stuff that people COULD do themselves, when their time is better spent on things I can't do.
ja: とにかく、イカルです。みんなが自分でもできるけど、その時間をボクにしかできないことに使った方がいい、っていう細々した作業を担当してるんだ。

key: I also play new versions of the game before most people, when they're the most broken, so that's fun.
en: I also play new versions of the game before most people, when they're the most broken, so that's fun.
ja: それに、ゲームの新しいバージョンが一番不安定な時期に、大抵の人より先にプレイするんだ、それが結構楽しいんだよね。

key: There's a chance you're not here to listen to my musing though, so I'll leave that up to you.
en: There's a chance you're not here to listen to my musing though, so I'll leave that up to you.
ja: ボクの独り言なんて聞きたくないかもしれないから、そこはあなた次第だけど。

key: IKARU: Hi again. Want to talk for a bit? Or maybe you're just here to battle?
en: IKARU: Hi again. Want to talk for a bit? Or maybe you're just here to battle?
ja: イカル: また来てくれたんだ。少し話す? それともバトルしに来た?

key: IKARU: Sure thing. I told Ame that I would try not to write too much, but, once I get into it...
en: IKARU: Sure thing. I told Ame that I would try not to write too much, but, once I get into it...
ja: イカル: もちろん。アメには長々書きすぎないようにするって言ったんだけど、いざ始めると……

key: Well, Ikaru from the future that has finished writing these is here to warn you, there's... a lot.
en: Well, Ikaru from the future that has finished writing these is here to warn you, there's... a lot.
ja: まあ、これを書き終えた未来のイカルから警告しておくと……結構長いから。

key: What sounds most interesting? \ch[62,-1,Pre- Reborn,Early Reborn and League,Game Involvement,Reflection]
en: What sounds most interesting? \ch[62,-1,Pre- Reborn,Early Reborn and League,Game Involvement,Reflection]
ja: 一番興味あるのはどれ? \ch[62,-1,リボーン以前,初期のリボーンとリーグ,ゲームでの活動,振り返り]

key: The olden times, huh. Sure. So, full disclosure:
en: The olden times, huh. Sure. So, full disclosure:
ja: 昔の話か。いいよ。まず正直に言っておくと:

key: I'm just going to pretend that I don't know that Autumn over there will have said the exact same things that I'm going to say here at one point or another.
en: I'm just going to pretend that I don't know that Autumn over there will have said the exact same things that I'm going to say here at one point or another.
ja: あそこにいるオータムがどこかのタイミングでボクとまったく同じことを言うのは分かってるけど、それは知らないふりをするね。

key: Fun fact for the class first:
en: Fun fact for the class first:
ja: まずは豆知識から:

key: Before I started going by Ikaru, I had a different alias, well over like, 13 years ago now. And I know, that's not a very fun fact by itself, but...
en: Before I started going by Ikaru, I had a different alias, well over like, 13 years ago now. And I know, that's not a very fun fact by itself, but...
ja: イカルって名乗り始める前は、別のハンドルネームを使ってたんだ、もう13年以上前の話だけど。分かってる、これ単体だとそんなに面白い豆知識じゃないけど……

key: Say, have you ever fought the Grand Hall trainers on a Wednesday?
en: Say, have you ever fought the Grand Hall trainers on a Wednesday?
ja: ねえ、水曜日にグランドホールのトレーナーと戦ったことある?

key: Specifically, the one with the Xatu and (Mega-)Mawile from hell?
en: Specifically, the one with the Xatu and (Mega-)Mawile from hell?
ja: 特に、地獄のネイティオとメガクチートを連れてるあの人?

key: The one who says some cryptic "you don't know who I am" stuff? Psychic Silva? Yeah, that's me. Or, well, it WAS me.
en: The one who says some cryptic "you don't know who I am" stuff? Psychic Silva? Yeah, that's me. Or, well, it WAS me.
ja: 「お前はボクが何者か知らない」とか意味深なこと言ってくる人。サイキック・シルヴァ? そう、それがボク。まあ、正確には「だった」だけど。

key: But hold on, before you start accusing me of stealing your childhood crush's first kiss or something out of some war-flashback-esque anger,
en: But hold on, before you start accusing me of stealing your childhood crush's first kiss or something out of some war-flashback-esque anger,
ja: でも待って、まるで戦争のフラッシュバックみたいな怒りで、あなたの初恋の相手の初キスを奪ったとか、そういう非難を始める前に言っておくと、

key: I didn't make those teams, it was just stuff I liked that needed to be seen in-game... somewhere. Sorry, not sorry!
en: I didn't make those teams, it was just stuff I liked that needed to be seen in-game... somewhere. Sorry, not sorry!
ja: あのチームはボクが作ったわけじゃなくて、ただゲーム内のどこかに存在してほしかった好きなものを詰め込んだだけ。ごめん、でも悪びれてはないよ!

key: That aside: my earliest internet days in middle school were spent on the Serebii forums, writing a really bad Pokemon fanfiction, which,
en: That aside: my earliest internet days in middle school were spent on the Serebii forums, writing a really bad Pokemon fanfiction, which,
ja: それはさておき: 中学時代の一番古いインターネット体験は、Serebiiのフォーラムで、本当にひどいポケモンのファンフィクションを書いてたことなんだ。

key: Hopefully,
en: Hopefully,
ja: 願わくば、

key: Will never see the light of day again. If you know, you know, and if you don't, well, it's better that way.
en: Will never see the light of day again. If you know, you know, and if you don't, well, it's better that way.
ja: もう二度と日の目を見ないでほしい。分かる人には分かるし、分からない人には、分からない方が幸せだよ。

key: So like I said, this was in middle school. I had a few friends on the forums, kind of, but not many of them stuck around long term because of course not.
en: So like I said, this was in middle school. I had a few friends on the forums, kind of, but not many of them stuck around long term because of course not.
ja: で、さっき言った通り、これは中学時代の話。フォーラムには何人か友達がいたけど、大抵は長く続かなかった、まあそりゃそうだよね。

key: There was one, though, that I knew irl too, and- well, actually, "stuck around" isn't a good phrase for him either, more like he...
en: There was one, though, that I knew irl too, and- well, actually, "stuck around" isn't a good phrase for him either, more like he...
ja: でも一人だけ、実際に会ったこともある子がいて――正直「長く続いた」って表現も彼には合わないな、むしろ……

key: ... suddenly reappeared in Reborn, out of thin air in the left field like 10 years later?
en: ... suddenly reappeared in Reborn, out of thin air in the left field like 10 years later?
ja: ……10年くらい経ってから、突然リボーンに、まさかの場所からひょっこり現れたって感じ?

key: And that by itself is wild to me, like, I live by the phrase "timing is everything" and all our choices yada yada I said that already,
en: And that by itself is wild to me, like, I live by the phrase "timing is everything" and all our choices yada yada I said that already,
ja: それだけでもすごく不思議な感じがする、ボクは「タイミングが全て」っていう言葉を信条にしてて、選択がどうこうとかもうさっき言ったけど、

key: But the degree to which we were completely different people than we were back then is staggering. We weren't even THAT close, but,
en: But the degree to which we were completely different people than we were back then is staggering. We weren't even THAT close, but,
ja: 当時とはまったく違う人間になってるっていう、その変わりようがすごいんだ。それほど親しかったわけでもないのに、

key: If you happen to be reading this, shoutout to you, friend. I'm glad we both made it this far.
en: If you happen to be reading this, shoutout to you, friend. I'm glad we both made it this far.
ja: もしこれを読んでたら、あなたのことだよ、友よ。二人ともここまで来られて良かった。

key: So, next came the Marriland forums. I put myself out there a bit more, and wrote less (read: wrote no) fanfiction. I dabbled a little in competitive Pokemon.
en: So, next came the Marriland forums. I put myself out there a bit more, and wrote less (read: wrote no) fanfiction. I dabbled a little in competitive Pokemon.
ja: それで、次はMarrilandのフォーラム。もうちょっと自分を出すようになって、ファンフィクションはあまり(っていうか全然)書かなくなった。対戦ポケモンにも少し手を出した。

key: This was 4th gen, and I was just starting to be less uptight about "super broken" overused Pokemon.
en: This was 4th gen, and I was just starting to be less uptight about "super broken" overused Pokemon.
ja: これは第4世代の頃で、「めちゃくちゃ強い」使いすぎポケモンにあまり神経質じゃなくなり始めた頃だった。

key: (And, like, good for me because I was missing out on so many cool things in favor of... *checks notes* ... Swords Dance Quick Attack Zangoose.)
en: (And, like, good for me because I was missing out on so many cool things in favor of... *checks notes* ...  Swords Dance Quick Attack Zangoose.)
ja: (それで結構良かったよ、だって……*メモ確認*……つるぎのまいでんこうせっかザングースなんかにこだわって、他の面白いものをたくさん見逃してたんだから。)

key: On a fateful July afternoon in 2007, I was scrolling the "wi-fi battles" subforum and the thread I chose to respond to was the start of everything.
en: On a fateful July afternoon in 2007, I was scrolling the "wi-fi battles" subforum and the thread I chose to respond to was the start of everything.
ja: 2007年7月のとある運命の午後、「wi-fiバトル」のサブフォーラムをスクロールしてて、返信を選んだそのスレッドが、すべての始まりだった。

key: The thread starter was someone who... Ah, what were her words...
en: The thread starter was someone who... Ah, what were her words...
ja: スレ主は……ええと、彼女の言葉をどう言えばいいかな……

key: "A few genders and plenty of life lived" later, is now known as Autumn.
en: "A few genders and plenty of life lived" later, is now known as Autumn.
ja: 「いくつかの性別と、たくさんの人生経験」を経て、今はオータムって呼ばれてる人。

key: The green one a single tile away from here, yeah. That placement is very intentional.
en: The green one a single tile away from here, yeah.  That placement is very intentional.
ja: そう、ここから一マス離れた、あの緑色の人だよ。あの位置取りはすごく意図的なの。

key: We became real good friends using our Nintendo DS wi-fi, even when she had to hide the fact that she was friends with strangers online from her mom.
en: We became real good friends using our Nintendo DS wi-fi, even when she had to hide the fact that she was friends with strangers online from her mom.
ja: ニンテンドーDSのwi-fiを使って本当に仲良くなったんだ、彼女はネットの見知らぬ人と友達になってることをお母さんに隠さなきゃいけなかったのに。

key: And, like, fair.
en: And, like, fair.
ja: まあ、それも当然だよね。

key: Eventually she invited me to her own forum for her friends, which, when I joined, had a staggering two (2) active members.
en: Eventually she invited me to her own forum for her friends, which, when I joined, had a staggering two (2) active members.
ja: そのうち彼女がボクを、友達用の自分のフォーラムに招待してくれて、参加した時、驚くことにアクティブなメンバーは二(2)人だけだった。

key: We hung out there all the time, doing whatever we wanted with whatever nonsense topics and stuff because it was pretty much just the two of us.
en: We hung out there all the time, doing whatever we wanted with whatever nonsense topics and stuff because it was pretty much just the two of us.
ja: そこでいつも一緒にいて、色々くだらない話題で好きなことをやってた、ほぼ二人だけの場所だったから。

key: She invited more and more people and we had a fun little group that did battling, roleplaying, art, children's card games, you name it.
en: She invited more and more people and we had a fun little group that did battling, roleplaying, art, children's card games, you name it.
ja: 彼女はどんどん人を招待していって、バトルしたりロールプレイしたり絵を描いたり、カードゲームで遊んだり、色んなことをする楽しい小さなグループになった。

key: One of the people she invited was her friend Wolfie, and if you know me well enough, you already know the significance there.
en: One of the people she invited was her friend Wolfie, and if you know me well enough, you already know the significance there.
ja: 彼女が招待した人の中に、友達のウルフィーがいてね、ボクをよく知ってる人なら、それがどれだけ重要なことか分かるはず。

key: If you don't, just know that she's a blessing. A past version of me might argue that I don't deserve her, and that past version of me is wrong,
en: If you don't, just know that she's a blessing. A past version of me might argue that I don't deserve her, and that past version of me is wrong,
ja: 知らないなら、彼女が最高の存在だってことだけ知っておいて。過去のボクなら「自分には彼女はもったいない」なんて言いそうだけど、それは間違いだったな、

key: Though I do my best to be worth it all the same.
en: Though I do my best to be worth it all the same.
ja: それでも、その価値がある人間になれるように精一杯頑張ってるつもり。

key: It is no small exaggeration to say that those two are the single (uh, double?) most important people in my life and I would not be where I am now without them.
en: It is no small exaggeration to say that those two are the single (uh, double?) most important people in my life and I would not be where I am now without them.
ja: この二人こそがボクの人生でただ一人(いや、二人?)一番大切な人たちだって言っても大げさじゃないし、二人がいなかったら今のボクはいない。

key: I love them both dearly and I'm glad that they've stuck around through everything. I couldn't ask for better friends.
en: I love them both dearly and I'm glad that they've stuck around through everything. I couldn't ask for better friends.
ja: 二人とも心から大好きだし、色々あった中でずっとそばにいてくれてうれしい。こんな最高の友達、他に望めないよ。

key: ...Whew. Sorry, I'm sure you weren't expecting all of that.
en: ...Whew. Sorry, I'm sure you weren't expecting all of that.
ja: ……ふう。ごめん、まさかこんなに語られるとは思ってなかったよね。

key: Thanks for listening, though.
en: Thanks for listening, though.
ja: でも聞いてくれてありがとう。

key: Want to talk about anything else?
en: Want to talk about anything else?
ja: 他に何か話したい?

key: My early Reborn experience, huh? Sure.
en: My early Reborn experience, huh? Sure.
ja: リボーン初期の話ね? もちろん。

key: Would you believe me joining this community was entirely an accident?
en: Would you believe me joining this community was entirely an accident?
ja: ボクがこのコミュニティに入ったのが、完全に事故だったって信じられる?

key: Ah, well, maybe a better term is "misunderstanding."
en: Ah, well, maybe a better term is "misunderstanding."
ja: いや、「勘違い」って言った方が正しいかな。

key: You see, Autumn and I are fans of the anime "Katekyo Hitman Reborn!" and when we first made the switch from NetBattle to Pokemon Online,
en: You see, Autumn and I are fans of the anime "Katekyo Hitman Reborn!" and when we first made the switch from NetBattle to Pokemon Online,
ja: 実は、オータムとボクはアニメ「家庭教師ヒットマンREBORN!」のファンで、NetBattleからPokemon Onlineに乗り換えた時、

key: All the way back in 2010,
en: All the way back in 2010,
ja: ずっと昔、2010年に、

key: We saw a server that was named "Reborn Server" and we didn't think too hard about it.
en: We saw a server that was named "Reborn Server" and we didn't think too hard about it.
ja: 「Reborn Server」って名前のサーバーを見つけて、あんまり深く考えなかったんだ。

key: "YOOOOOO it's Reborn" we said, joining instantly.
en: "YOOOOOO it's Reborn" we said, joining instantly.
ja: 「うおおおお、リボーンだ」って言って、即参加。

key: Best mistake we made that year.
en: Best mistake we made that year.
ja: あの年、一番良い間違いだったよ。

key: The League was already a thing when we joined, though the server was still a tiny baby compared to what we have now.
en: The League was already a thing when we joined, though the server was still a tiny baby compared to what we have now.
ja: ボクらが入った頃には既にリーグはあったけど、サーバーは今と比べたらまだほんの赤ちゃんみたいなものだった。

key: I signed up pretty instantly for funsies with a team that was... questionable. I remember my first battle was actually pretty significant.
en: I signed up pretty instantly for funsies with a team that was... questionable. I remember my first battle was actually pretty significant.
ja: すぐに、お遊びで結構怪しいチームで登録したんだ。最初のバトルは実は結構重要な出来事だったのを覚えてる。

key: Not for me though, for Hardy. Titania was newly revealed and he said that if he won his next battle, he would go challenge her next.
en: Not for me though, for Hardy. Titania was newly revealed and he said that if he won his next battle, he would go challenge her next.
ja: ボクにとってじゃなくて、ハーディにとってね。ティタニアが新しく発表されたばかりで、彼は次のバトルに勝ったら、次に彼女に挑むって言ってたんだ。

key: "Yanno," as he does, trying to prove Rock-types can still hold up to the all-powerful Steel-type.
en: "Yanno," as he does, trying to prove Rock-types can still hold up to the all-powerful Steel-type.
ja: 「ほら」って言いながら、いつもの調子で、岩タイプがあの最強の鋼タイプに対しても通用するって証明しようとしてた。

key: And I was the unlucky sucker that thought shit was sweet, with a pretty weak team, and got Rocked.
en: And I was the unlucky sucker that thought shit was sweet, with a pretty weak team, and got Rocked.
ja: そしてボクは、それがうまくいくと思っちゃった不運なやつで、結構弱いチームで、思いっきり岩に潰された。

key: Heh.
en: Heh.
ja: へへ。

key: Then I made a better team and fought Corey, and to say he was a stark contrast to my last opponent is an understatement. Both in character and difficulty.
en: Then I made a better team and fought Corey, and to say he was a stark contrast to my last opponent is an understatement. Both in character and difficulty.
ja: それでもっといいチームを作ってコーリーと戦って、彼が前の相手とは対照的だって言うのは控えめすぎる表現だった。性格も難易度もね。

key: Cal was next, and I got slapped, then I rematched Hardy and won. Rematched Cal and won.
en: Cal was next, and I got slapped, then I rematched Hardy and won. Rematched Cal and won.
ja: 次はキャル、ボコボコにされた、それからハーディにリベンジして勝って、キャルにもリベンジして勝った。

key: Next was Florinia. And boy did she beat me up for a long while. A battle between us was the 666th log, fun fact. Eventually I fought Heather instead,
en: Next was Florinia. And boy did she beat me up for a long while. A battle between us was the 666th log, fun fact. Eventually I fought Heather instead,
ja: 次はフロリニア。彼女には本当に長いこと打ちのめされたよ。彼女とのバトルは666番目のログだったんだ、豆知識ね。最終的にヘザーと戦ったんだけど、

key: Who, by the way, was an entry leader at the time,
en: Who, by the way, was an entry leader at the time,
ja: ちなみに当時は入場口のリーダーで、

key: And won first try. And let me tell you, I was the ONLY one who did. The fact that she's part of the Elite Four in this game is not coincidence.
en: And won first try. And let me tell you, I was the ONLY one who did. The fact that she's part of the Elite Four in this game is not coincidence.
ja: 一発で勝てたんだ。それで、聞いて、それができたのはボクだけだった。彼女がこのゲームで四天王の一員になってるのは偶然じゃないと思う。

key: Her rank shot up real shortly after that, and first of all, my trainer card looked real funny with all the empty space between her badge and the rest.
en: Her rank shot up real shortly after that, and first of all, my trainer card looked real funny with all the empty space between her badge and the rest.
ja: その後すぐ彼女のランクは急上昇して、まずは、トレーナーカードのバッジと他のバッジの間の空白がすごく変な感じになってた。

key: And man, the relief I felt knowing I didn't have to fight her again after she stepped it up, haha.
en: And man, the relief I felt knowing I didn't have to fight her again after she stepped it up, haha.
ja: そして彼女が強くなった後、もう二度と戦わなくていいって分かった時の安心感といったら、ははは。

key: I interacted with the leaders pretty often, and some had more to say than others.
en: I interacted with the leaders pretty often, and some had more to say than others.
ja: リーダーたちとはかなり頻繁にやり取りしたし、人によって話す量も違ったな。

key: By far my favorite group was none other than the OTS gang; Titania, Florinia, Amaria, and Julia.
en: By far my favorite group was none other than the OTS gang; Titania, Florinia, Amaria, and Julia.
ja: ダントツで一番好きだったグループは、他でもないOTSのメンバー、ティタニア、フロリニア、アマリア、ジュリアだった。

key: I built up a bit of a reputation as a knight in not-so- shining armor, no points for guessing why.
en: I built up a bit of a reputation as a knight in not-so- shining armor, no points for guessing why.
ja: 輝いてはいないよろいをまとった騎士みたいな評判をちょっと築いちゃったんだけど、理由は察してほしい。

key: The interactions I had with Titania and Amaria were like, the talk of the whole league.
en: The interactions I had with Titania and Amaria were like, the talk of the whole league.
ja: ティタニアやアマリアとのやり取りは、リーグ全体のうわさの的だったよ。

key: And then there was El.
en: And then there was El.
ja: それからエルがいた。

key: Let's just say I'm glad I never have to fight him again. My team had Dragon Dance Dragonite as a win condition and it backfired every time.
en: Let's just say I'm glad I never have to fight him again.  My team had Dragon Dance Dragonite as a win condition and it backfired every time.
ja: もう二度と彼と戦わなくていいのがうれしい、とだけ言っておくよ。ボクのチームは「りゅうのまい」を積んだカイリューが勝ち筋だったのに、毎回裏目に出たんだ。

key: Can't stand Ditto anymore hahaha.
en: Can't stand Ditto anymore hahaha.
ja: もうメタモンなんて見たくもない、ははは。

key: I sure gave it to him in the X-League though. Resorted to a Chilan Berry on my Darkrai to survive Arceus and put it to sleep.
en: I sure gave it to him in the X-League though. Resorted to a Chilan Berry on my Darkrai to survive Arceus and put it to sleep.
ja: でもXリーグでは彼にお返ししてやったよ。ダークライにタラプのみを持たせてアルセウスを何とか耐えて、眠らせたんだ。

key: I got really into everything and it was a blast. I was the second one to win the league!
en: I got really into everything and it was a blast. I was the second one to win the league!
ja: すっかりのめり込んで、最高に楽しかった。リーグをクリアした二番目の人間になれたんだ!

key: Have you done the spirit hunting quest in Victory Road? If you did, then you saw my team at some point.
en: Have you done the spirit hunting quest in Victory Road? If you did, then you saw my team at some point.
ja: チャンピオンロードの霊探しクエストはやった? やったなら、どこかでボクのチームを見たはずだよ。

key: If you ask me if I regret it, knowing what I know now... Nah, definitely not. I feel like my own character developed as much as any of the leaders' did.
en: If you ask me if I regret it, knowing what I know now... Nah, definitely not. I feel like my own character developed as much as any of the leaders' did.
ja: 今知ってることを踏まえて後悔してるかって聞かれたら……いや、絶対してない。ボク自身のキャラクターも、どのリーダーにも劣らないくらい成長したと思ってるから。

key: Nowadays I'm a lot more relaxed, I think, but there's always a little bit of Titania chilling under the surface for whenever I need her to come out.
en: Nowadays I'm a lot more relaxed, I think, but there's always a little bit of Titania chilling under the surface for whenever I need her to come out.
ja: 最近はだいぶ落ち着いたと思うけど、必要な時にいつでも出てこられる、心の奥にちょっとしたティタニアが常にくつろいでるんだ。

key: ... Not that it needs to. Much.
en: ... Not that it needs to. Much.
ja: ……そんなに出番はないけどね。

key: Anyway, I'd say the League was definitely one of the highlights of my experience. Hopefully you enjoyed the little trip down memory lane.
en: Anyway, I'd say the League was definitely one of the highlights of my experience. Hopefully you enjoyed the little trip down memory lane.
ja: とにかく、リーグは間違いなくボクの体験の中でも一番の見どころだったと思う。この思い出巡りの小旅行、楽しんでもらえてたらいいな。

key: My involvement with the game, huh? Sure.
en: My involvement with the game, huh? Sure.
ja: このゲームへの関わりね? もちろん。

key: Well, like I said when I introduced myself, I mostly do a lot of small, boring stuff that other people can definitely do themselves.
en: Well, like I said when I introduced myself, I mostly do a lot of small, boring stuff that other people can definitely do themselves.
ja: まあ、自己紹介の時に言った通り、他の人でも絶対できるような、小さくて地味な作業を大体担当してる。

key: Difference between them and me is I don't know how to do all that much, so the really cool stuff is best left to them.
en: Difference between them and me is I don't know how to do all that much, so the really cool stuff is best left to them.
ja: 彼らとボクの違いは、ボクはそこまで多くのことができないから、本当にすごいことは彼らに任せた方がいいってこと。

key: Full transparency, this event is like the only eventing I've done in the entire game.
en: Full transparency, this event is like the only eventing I've done in the entire game.
ja: 正直に言うと、このイベントは、ゲーム全体でボクがやった唯一のイベント制作なんだ。

key: Uh, well, unless you count scattering hidden items in the new city and the Chrysolia Spring. But that was just copying and pasting events, really.
en: Uh, well, unless you count scattering hidden items in the new city and the Chrysolia Spring. But that was just copying and pasting events, really.
ja: まあ、新しい街とクリソリア泉に隠しアイテムをまくのを数えるなら別だけど。あれはただイベントをコピペしただけだけどね。

key: Speaking of the spring, though, I filled in all the walls there once Ame laid down the outline. I did that for a few maps, actually.
en: Speaking of the spring, though, I filled in all the walls there once Ame laid down the outline. I did that for a few maps, actually.
ja: 泉と言えば、アメが枠組みを敷いた後、そこの壁を全部埋めたのはボクなんだ。実際、いくつかのマップで同じ作業をやったよ。

key: A couple of the mountains in the desert were my doing too.
en: A couple of the mountains in the desert were my doing too.
ja: 砂漠にある山のいくつかもボクの担当だった。

key: And let's see... There's also the Tanzan Depths, the maps in the cave in Tanzan Cove.
en: And let's see... There's also the Tanzan Depths, the maps in the cave in Tanzan Cove.
ja: それと、ええと……タンザン深部もあった、タンザン入り江の洞窟のマップだね。

key: That was also the one time I had a little fun and left something funny that no one will see unless they open up the map in RMXP or something.
en: That was also the one time I had a little fun and left something funny that no one will see unless they open up the map in RMXP or something.
ja: あれは一度だけちょっと遊んで、RMXPか何かでマップを開かないと絶対誰にも見えない面白いものを一つ残したんだ。

key: I think my favorite niche talent is the power to find double spaces in text. When I first joined the dev server, I made my name "melee marth player,"
en: I think my favorite niche talent is the power to find double spaces in text. When I first joined the dev server, I made my name "melee marth player,"
ja: ボクの一番のニッチな才能は、たぶんテキスト中の二重スペースを見つける能力だと思う。開発サーバーに最初に入った時、名前を「melee marth player」にしたんだけど、

key: Because my attention to spacing is IMMACULATE.
en: Because my attention to spacing is IMMACULATE.
ja: それはボクのスペースへのこだわりが「完璧」だから。

key: To be clear, when I say "double space" I mean the difference between "this phrase" and "this phrase."
en: To be clear, when I say "double space" I mean the difference between "this phrase" and "this phrase."
ja: 念のため言っておくと、「二重スペース」っていうのは、「this phrase」と「this  phrase」の違いのことね。

key: I can also tell when Pokemon names have a space before them, when the nicknaming window puts one there automatically for... some reason.
en: I can also tell when Pokemon names have a space before them, when the nicknaming window puts one there automatically for... some reason.
ja: それに、ポケモンの名前の前にスペースがある時も見分けられる、ニックネームウィンドウがなぜか自動でスペースを入れちゃうことがあるんだよね。

key: Outside of actual work on the game, I also play the game! The wild west versions where maybe everything works and maybe it doesn't!
en: Outside of actual work on the game, I also play the game! The wild west versions where maybe everything works and maybe it doesn't!
ja: ゲームの実作業以外だと、ボクもこのゲームをプレイするよ! 何でも動くかもしれないし動かないかもしれない、荒野の最新版でね!

key: During my testing of E19, my Palkia was named "no." and my Dialga was named "yes!" because I had a 2 hour struggle with Palkia and then Dialga was like,
en: During my testing of E19, my Palkia was named "no." and my Dialga was named "yes!" because I had a 2 hour struggle with Palkia and then Dialga was like,
ja: エピソード19のテスト中は、パルキアを「no.」って名付けて、ディアルガを「yes!」って名付けたんだ、パルキアには2時間も苦戦したのに、ディアルガは

key: "Okay, I'll get in the frame 1 Quick Ball I guess," and Dialga was the one I wanted more anyway!
en: "Okay, I'll get in the frame 1 Quick Ball I guess," and Dialga was the one I wanted more anyway!
ja: 「まあ、最初のクイックボールで入ってやるよ」みたいな感じで、しかもディアルガの方が本当は欲しかったポケモンだったのに!

key: Hopefully it's easier for you guys.
en: Hopefully it's easier for you guys.
ja: みんなにとってはもっと楽だといいな。

key: Aside from that, I try to keep reported bugs listed in our Official(tm) Cat(tm) Reporting Spreadsheet so that it's at least organized.
en: Aside from that, I try to keep reported bugs listed in our Official(tm) Cat(tm) Reporting Spreadsheet so that it's at least organized.
ja: それ以外だと、報告されたバグは公式(商標)猫(商標)報告スプレッドシートにまとめるようにしてる、少なくとも整理はできるように。

key: Honestly, huge shoutout to everyone else here.
en: Honestly, huge shoutout to everyone else here.
ja: 正直、ここにいる他のみんなに本当に感謝してる。

key: The difference in that spreadsheet when everything that's "Done" is hidden compared to how much has been on it...
en: The difference in that spreadsheet when everything that's "Done" is hidden compared to how much has been on it...
ja: そのスプレッドシートで「完了」になったものを全部隠した時と、それまでの量を比べると……

key: It's like night and day. The bugs- ah, cats, never stop, but looking back on everything that didn't work before that does now is insane.
en: It's like night and day. The bugs- ah, cats, never stop, but looking back on everything that didn't work before that does now is insane.
ja: まさに天と地の差だよ。バグは……いや、猫は、絶対終わらないけど、以前動かなかったものが今は動いてるのを振り返ると、本当にすごいことだと思う。

key: Remember to show your appreciation for everyone, okay?
en: Remember to show your appreciation for everyone, okay?
ja: みんなへの感謝を忘れないでね、いい?

key: Reflection... Well, I'm no Serra, but I sure do think about this kind of thing a lot.
en: Reflection... Well, I'm no Serra, but I sure do think about this kind of thing a lot.
ja: 振り返り……まあ、ボクはセラほどじゃないけど、こういうことについては結構考える方だよ。

key: I like music a lot, which isn't particularly unique or anything, but it plays into a lot of my character.
en: I like music a lot, which isn't particularly unique or anything, but it plays into a lot of my character.
ja: 音楽がすごく好きなんだ、別に特別珍しいことじゃないけど、ボクの人格の色んなところに影響してる。

key: In places like your generic "About Me"s and, like, status messages and all that, I quote songs all the time.
en: In places like your generic "About Me"s and, like, status messages and all that, I quote songs all the time.
ja: よくある「自己紹介」欄とか、ステータスメッセージとか、そういう場所では、いつも歌詞を引用してる。

key: If we're friends on Final Fantasy XIV, my search info is always a song quote.
en: If we're friends on Final Fantasy XIV, my search info is always a song quote.
ja: ファイナルファンタジーXIVで友達になったら、ボクの検索情報はいつも歌詞の引用だよ。

key: There's a few lyrical quotes here and there even in this event.
en: There's a few lyrical quotes here and there even in this event.
ja: このイベントの中にも、あちこちに歌詞の引用があるんだ。

key: The placeholder dialogue Ame left here for my pre- battle message was a joke about that, since it's so ingrained into my personality haha.
en: The placeholder dialogue Ame left here for my pre- battle message was a joke about that, since it's so ingrained into my personality haha.
ja: アメがボクの戦闘前メッセージ用に残しておいたプレースホルダーの台詞、あれはそのことについてのジョークだったんだよ、ボクの性格にそれくらい染み付いてるから、ははは。

key: My biggest inspiration is the Japanese musician Aimer. I really love the celestial themes and late night vibes in her earlier music.
en: My biggest inspiration is the Japanese musician Aimer. I really love the celestial themes and late night vibes in her earlier music.
ja: ボクの一番のインスピレーション源は、日本のミュージシャン、Aimerさん。彼女の初期の楽曲にある天体をテーマにした雰囲気や、深夜っぽい雰囲気が本当に大好きなんだ。

key: It was a tweet from her in 2018 that really motivated me to get up and finish my college registration.
en: It was a tweet from her in 2018 that really motivated me to get up and finish my college registration.
ja: 2018年の彼女のツイートが、大学の履修登録を終わらせるきっかけになったんだ。

key: She said "I wonder if some of you started a new life today" among other things, and I read that and thought "yeah, okay." So I did!
en: She said "I wonder if some of you started a new life today" among other things, and I read that and thought "yeah, okay." So I did!
ja: 「今日、新しい人生を始めた人もいるのかな」みたいなことを彼女が言ってて、それを読んで「よし、やろう」って思ったんだ。それで実行した!

key: My college major was always astronomy, but discovering someone like her really solidified my interest.
en: My college major was always astronomy, but discovering someone like her really solidified my interest.
ja: 大学の専攻はずっと天文学だったけど、彼女みたいな人を知ったことで、その興味が確固たるものになった。

key: My favorite song is, perhaps unsurprisingly, Polaris.
en: My favorite song is, perhaps unsurprisingly, Polaris.
ja: 一番好きな曲は、たぶん予想通りだと思うけど、「Polaris」。

key: It's sad, but at the same time, motivational. And it's always- ... well, usually, the melancholy stuff that hits me the hardest.
en: It's sad, but at the same time, motivational. And it's always- ... well, usually, the melancholy stuff that hits me the hardest.
ja: 悲しい曲だけど、同時にすごく背中を押してくれる。それに、いつも……まあ、大抵は、切なさが一番強く胸に刺さるんだ。

key: I say "usually," because it's not my FAVORITE song, but LIGHTS's "Timing Is Everything" is, like, my life motto.
en: I say "usually," because it's not my FAVORITE song, but LIGHTS's "Timing Is Everything" is, like, my life motto.
ja: 「大抵」って言ったのは、一番好きな曲ってわけじゃないからで、LIGHTSの「Timing Is Everything」の方が、ボクの人生のモットーみたいなものなんだ。

key: The chorus of the song says "There I was, none the wiser, both of us, different trajectories,"
en: The chorus of the song says "There I was, none the wiser, both of us, different trajectories,"
ja: その曲のサビには「あの時、あたしはまだ何も知らなくて、二人はそれぞれ違う軌道を進んでた」ってあって、

key: Who'd have thought we'd be right here, in this spot, timing is everything."
en: Who'd have thought we'd be right here, in this spot, timing is everything."
ja: 「誰がこの場所で、こうして出会うなんて思っただろう、タイミングがすべてなんだ」って続くんだ。

key: And it just makes me think. Despite everything,
en: And it just makes me think. Despite everything,
ja: それを聞くと、いつも考えてしまう。何もかもの中で、

key: The hundreds of thousands of years that humans have existed,
en: The hundreds of thousands of years that humans have existed,
ja: 人類が存在してきた何十万年もの歴史の中で、

key: You and I are here in the same place, at the same time.
en: You and I are here in the same place, at the same time.
ja: あなたとボクは、同じ場所、同じ時間にここにいる。

key: Uh, well, same "place" and same "time," but don't sweat the details.
en: Uh, well, same "place" and same "time," but don't sweat the details.
ja: いや、まあ、同じ「場所」で同じ「時間」って言っても、細かいことは気にしないで。

key: Everything we are is just a huge combination of wacky coincidences, or, like, such small choices. If I hadn't met Autumn in 2007, I wouldn't be here now.
en: Everything we are is just a huge combination of wacky coincidences, or, like, such small choices. If I hadn't met Autumn in 2007, I wouldn't be here now.
ja: ボクらの存在そのものが、奇妙な偶然の巨大な積み重ねというか、ほんの小さな選択の連続なんだ。もし2007年にオータムと出会ってなかったら、ボクは今ここにいない。

key: If I hadn't signed up for the League, I wouldn't be here now.
en: If I hadn't signed up for the League, I wouldn't be here now.
ja: リーグに登録してなかったら、ボクは今ここにいない。

key: If Ame hadn't succumbed to her whims and made a game, none of us would be here now.
en: If Ame hadn't succumbed to her whims and made a game, none of us would be here now.
ja: アメが自分の気まぐれに負けてこのゲームを作らなかったら、ボクらは誰一人今ここにいない。

key: But we are. Isn't it great?
en: But we are. Isn't it great?
ja: でも、こうしてここにいる。すごいことじゃない?

key: I, for one, am glad you're here and hopefully enjoying yourself. Stick around, won't you?
en: I, for one, am glad you're here and hopefully enjoying yourself. Stick around, won't you?
ja: 少なくともボクは、あなたがここにいて、楽しんでくれてたらうれしいと思ってる。もう少し、そばにいてくれない?

key: IKARU: Ah. To the death it is, then.
en: IKARU: Ah. To the death it is, then.
ja: イカル: ああ。それじゃあ、決着をつけようか。

key: ... Just kidding!
en: ... Just kidding!
ja: ……なんてね!

key: You've been through a lot to get where you are now, haven't you, Champion?
en: You've been through a lot to get where you are now, haven't you, Champion?
ja: ここまでたどり着くのに、色々あったんじゃない、チャンピオン?

key: Did you get what you wanted out of your adventure?
en: Did you get what you wanted out of your adventure?
ja: 冒険の中で、求めていたものは手に入った?

key: I'm glad to hear it. I hope the same is true of your next journey.
en: I'm glad to hear it. I hope the same is true of your next journey.
ja: それを聞けてうれしいよ。次の旅でも同じでありますように。

key: Well, there's not always some deeper meaning, and that's okay.
en: Well, there's not always some deeper meaning, and that's okay.
ja: まあ、いつも深い意味があるとは限らないし、それでいいんだ。

key: Here you stand, at the end of a journey 10 years in the making. You've done well.
en: Here you stand, at the end of a journey 10 years in the making. You've done well.
ja: 十年がかりの旅の終わりに、今こうして立っている。よくやったね。

key: With your quest said and done, how about a little something with no stakes to wind down?
en: With your quest said and done, how about a little something with no stakes to wind down?
ja: 冒険が一段落したところで、気楽に楽しめる、リスクのない何かをどう?

key: And yet, there's even more out there waiting for you.
en: And yet, there's even more out there waiting for you.
ja: それでもまだ、あなたを待ってるものがある。

key: When we're finished here, make sure you see things all the way through for me, will you?
en: When we're finished here, make sure you see things all the way through for me, will you?
ja: ここが終わったら、ボクのためにも、ちゃんと最後まで見届けてね?

key: And when that's done, tell me your favorite part!
en: And when that's done, tell me your favorite part!
ja: それが終わったら、一番好きだった部分を教えて!

key: (Bonus points if it's this interaction!)
en: (Bonus points if it's this interaction!)
ja: (それがこのやり取りだったら、ボーナスポイントね!)

key: IKARU: Round two, huh?
en: IKARU: Round two, huh?
ja: イカル: 二回戦かい?

key: You'll touch the stars in no time.
en: You'll touch the stars in no time.
ja: あなたならすぐに星に手が届くよ。

key: I did my Adrienn impression already, but the sentiment is still there.
en: I did my Adrienn impression already, but the sentiment is still there.
ja: アドリエンヌの真似はもうしちゃったけど、気持ちは変わらない。

key: Just a little higher...
en: Just a little higher...
ja: もう少し上へ……

key: Morning waits on the edge of a dream.
en: Morning waits on the edge of a dream.
ja: 朝は、夢の縁で待っている。

key: IKARU: I expect no less from someone who's come as far as you have.
en: IKARU: I expect no less from someone who's come as far as you have.
ja: イカル: ここまで来た人なら、これくらい当然だよね。

key: Here's some Battle Points for your troubles.
en: Here's some Battle Points for your troubles.
ja: 苦労のお礼に、バトルポイントをどうぞ。

key: And hey, you know what, there's only two people here that I don't outrank, and they can't tell me what to do.
en: And hey, you know what, there's only two people here that I don't outrank, and they can't tell me what to do.
ja: それと、ねえ、実はここにいる人の中で、ボクより階級が下じゃない人は二人しかいなくて、その二人にはボクに命令できないんだ。

key: Here's one (1) more, just this once. You've come so far, and frankly, these battles are a little stacked against you, haha.
en: Here's one (1) more, just this once. You've come so far, and frankly, these battles are a little stacked against you, haha.
ja: 今回だけ、もう一(1)個あげる。ここまで頑張ったし、正直これらのバトルはちょっとあなたに不利にできてるからね、ははは。

key: That brings you to... \v[593] points, is it?
en: That brings you to... \v[593] points, is it?
ja: これで所持ポイントは……\v[593]、だよね?

key: IKARU: Well, teams of just our favorites weren't really going to stand up to endgame players without some... help.
en: IKARU: Well, teams of just our favorites weren't really going to stand up to endgame players without some... help.
ja: イカル: まあ、お気に入りだけのチームじゃ、ちょっとした……力添えなしにはエンドゲームのプレイヤーに太刀打ちできないよね。

key: I'll get your squad all fixed up, and if you have any complaints, I'm innocent; Cass did it!
en: I'll get your squad all fixed up, and if you have any complaints, I'm innocent; Cass did it!
ja: パーティーは全部直しておくよ、もし文句があったら、ボクは無実だから、やったのはキャスだよ!

key: IKARU: Alright.
en: IKARU: Alright.
ja: イカル: よし。

key: Hey, if you ever get lost, just look up at the sky.
en: Hey, if you ever get lost, just look up at the sky.
ja: ねえ、もし道に迷ったら、空を見上げてみて。

key: If you can see the stars, they'll show you the way.
en: If you can see the stars, they'll show you the way.
ja: 星が見えるなら、それが道を示してくれるから。

key: Your next meeting is just around the corner.
en: Your next meeting is just around the corner.
ja: 次の出会いは、もうすぐそこだよ。

key: MARCELLO: Hi there, I'm Marcello, I work on this game.
en: MARCELLO: Hi there, I'm Marcello, I work on this game.
ja: マルチェロ: どうも、ボクはマルチェロ、このゲームに携わってるよ。

key: Do not believe the sprite I have been given for the purposes of bullying me,
en: Do not believe the sprite I have been given for the purposes of bullying me,
ja: からかい用に与えられたこのスプライトを信じないでほしいんだけど、

key: I am not, in fact, a child with green hair.
en: I am not, in fact, a child with green hair.
ja: 実際は緑色の髪の子供じゃないから。

key: So, what's up?
en: So, what's up?
ja: それで、どうしたの?

key: MARCELLO: I'm pretty terrible at Pokémon, myself.
en: MARCELLO: I'm pretty terrible at Pokémon, myself.
ja: マルチェロ: ボク自身、ポケモンはかなり下手なんだ。

key: But turns out, when you can just cheat and make your team utter unfair bullshit?
en: But turns out, when you can just cheat and make your team utter unfair bullshit?
ja: でも、実はチートしてチームをとんでもなくアンフェアにできるとなると?

key: Even I can come up with something pretty good.
en: Even I can come up with something pretty good.
ja: ボクでもそこそこいい感じのものが組めるんだよね。

key: Bring it on!
en: Bring it on!
ja: さあ、来い!

key: MARCELLO: Good job, have a BP!
en: MARCELLO: Good job, have a BP!
ja: マルチェロ: よくやった、BPをどうぞ!

key: ...I feel like these dev fights are probably way too difficult to reward just 3 BP, but that's just how things are.
en: ...I feel like these dev fights are probably way too difficult to reward just 3 BP, but that's just how things are.
ja: ……この開発陣とのバトルって、たった3BPの報酬にしては難しすぎる気がするけど、まあそういうものだから。

key: You've got \v[593] BP now.
en: You've got \v[593] BP now.

ja: (アメは、ボクより「背が低い」くせに、昔よくボクの身長をからかってきた。)

key: (I have no idea about the exact joke origins, it was forever ago but hey I ended up with a child's sprite, we all have to live with this now.)
en: (I have no idea about the exact joke origins, it was forever ago but hey I ended up with a child's sprite, we all have to live with this now.)

key: Anyway, tangent aside.
en: Anyway, tangent aside.

key: That time I was the 'new kid' on the team?

key: Was seven years ago.
en: Was seven years ago.
ja: もう7年前の話だよ。

key: I have worked on this game my entire adult life, which is crazy to me.
en: I have worked on this game my entire adult life, which is crazy to me.
ja: 大人になってからの人生、まるまるこのゲームに費やしてきたんだ、自分でも信じられないくらい。

key: And with any luck, I can continue working to make games with Ame and the team,
en: And with any luck, I can continue working to make games with Ame and the team,
ja: 運が良ければ、これからもアメやチームのみんなと一緒にゲームを作り続けられると思う、

key: For the rest of my adult life, too.
en: For the rest of my adult life, too.
ja: これから先の大人の人生も、ずっとね。

key: Did you want to ask me more?
en: Did you want to ask me more?
ja: もっと何か聞きたい?

key: All right, see you around.
en: All right, see you around.
ja: じゃあ、またね。

key: MARCELLO: Oh, well I'm a mathematician.
en: MARCELLO: Oh, well I'm a mathematician.
ja: マルチェロ: ああ、そう言えば、ボクは数学者なんだ。

key: ...But I assume you mean with regards to this game, right?
en: ...But I assume you mean with regards to this game, right?
ja: ……でも、このゲームについての話だよね?

key: Well, when I first started it was as a programmer!
en: Well, when I first started it was as a programmer!
ja: 最初に始めた時は、プログラマーとしてだったんだ!

key: I knew nothing about that kind of thing though, but I learnt on the job and fixed a bunch of bugs.
en: I knew nothing about that kind of thing though, but I learnt on the job and fixed a bunch of bugs.
ja: その手のことは何も知らなかったけど、仕事しながら学んで、バグをたくさん直した。

key: And all in all wrote lots and lots of code that Cass or Perry or myself would eventually have to rewrite.
en: And all in all wrote lots and lots of code that Cass or Perry or myself would eventually have to rewrite.
ja: 結局は、キャスかペリー、あるいはボク自身が後で書き直す羽目になるコードを、山ほど書いたよ。

key: Because it sucked real bad.
en: Because it sucked real bad.
ja: だってマジでひどい出来だったから。

key: But I like to think I got pretty good over the years.
en: But I like to think I got pretty good over the years.
ja: でも長年でだいぶ上達したと思ってる。

key: I got the online stuff working!
en: I got the online stuff working!
ja: オンライン機能を動くようにしたんだ!

key: I fixed numerous persistent bugs!
en: I fixed numerous persistent bugs!
ja: 色んな根深いバグも直したよ!

key: When we completely rewrote the AI, I was the one that programmed that (though Ame designed it).
en: When we completely rewrote the AI, I was the one that programmed that (though Ame designed it).
ja: AIを完全に書き直した時、プログラムしたのはボクだった(デザインしたのはアメだけど)。

key: All these big things I've done have something in common, though.
en: All these big things I've done have something in common, though.
ja: ボクがやってきたこういう大きなことには、実は共通点があるんだ。

key: In the last year or so, Cass or Perry have completely redone my work in these areas and made them much better.
en: In the last year or so, Cass or Perry have completely redone my work in these areas and made them much better.
ja: ここ一年くらいで、キャスかペリーがボクの担当したこれらの部分をすっかり作り直して、ずっと良くしてくれた。

key: And I couldn't be happier!
en: And I couldn't be happier!
ja: それがもううれしくて仕方ないんだ!

key: I like to think I provided a good starting point, and seeing some incredibly talented team members improve on that,
en: I like to think I provided a good starting point, and seeing some incredibly talented team members improve on that,
ja: いい出発点を提供できたと思いたいし、すごく才能あるチームメイトがそれをさらに良くしてくれて、

key: To make stuff that seems to work pretty damn well!
en: To make stuff that seems to work pretty damn well!
ja: めちゃくちゃちゃんと動くものになっていくのを見るのは!

key: I find that very cool, and I can't help but be proud of myself and even more proud of this amazing team I'm a part of.
en: I find that very cool, and I can't help but be proud of myself and even more proud of this amazing team I'm a part of.
ja: 本当にかっこいいと思う、自分にも誇りを感じるし、こんなすごいチームの一員でいられることには、もっと誇りを感じる。

key: But programming isn't all I can do!
en: But programming isn't all I can do!
ja: でもプログラミングだけがボクにできることじゃない!

key: This last year of development, I had to step back for a bit because of illness.
en: This last year of development, I had to step back for a bit because of illness.
ja: 開発最後の一年、体調不良で少し離れなきゃいけなかった時期があったんだ。

key: (Don't worry, reader, all is well now.)
en: (Don't worry, reader, all is well now.)
ja: (読者のみんな、心配しないで、今はもう大丈夫だから。)

key: And when I got back I was out of practice, not to mention that Cass and Perry are so cool,
en: And when I got back I was out of practice, not to mention that Cass and Perry are so cool,

key: There wasn't too much even left to do on the programming side of things.
en: There wasn't too much even left to do on the programming side of things.
ja: プログラミング側でやれることがあまり残ってなかったんだ。

key: But turns out this nerd quite enjoys writing.
en: But turns out this nerd quite enjoys writing.
ja: でも実は、このオタク、文章を書くのが結構好きだって分かってね。

key: And I like to think I'm pretty good at it-- something which Ame agrees with!
en: And I like to think I'm pretty good at it-- something which Ame agrees with!
ja: 自分でもそこそこ上手いと思ってる――アメも同意してくれてるし!

en: So for the last segment of development I was writing dialogue instead!
ja: だから開発最後のパートでは、代わりにセリフを書いてたんだ!

key: My biggest contribution is the Celebi Quest, if you've played that already.
en: My biggest contribution is the Celebi Quest, if you've played that already.
ja: ボクの一番の貢献は、もうプレイしたなら分かると思うけど、セレビィのクエスト。

key: That was designed, evented, and written by me!
en: That was designed, evented, and written by me!
ja: あれは設計もイベント制作も執筆も、全部ボクがやったよ!

key: (Lots of thanks to Crim and Ame for the graphical assets ur both great. <3)
en: (Lots of thanks to Crim and Ame for the graphical assets ur both great. <3)
ja: (グラフィック素材についてはクリムとアメに感謝を、二人とも最高だよ。<3)

key: I even made all the battle teams for it!
en: I even made all the battle teams for it!
ja: バトルチームも全部ボクが作ったんだ!

key: But I've also done other bits throughout postgame, small bits in other quests, among other things.
en: But I've also done other bits throughout postgame, small bits in other quests, among other things.
ja: でもクリア後の他の部分でも色々やってるし、他のクエストの小さな部分とかもね。

key: I'm sure I could tell you more about the other things I worked on specifically, but that would take long enough,
en: I'm sure I could tell you more about the other things I worked on specifically, but that would take long enough,
ja: 他に具体的にやったこともまだまだ話せるけど、それだと長くなりすぎるから、

key: We'll just say that's a story for another time.
en: We'll just say that's a story for another time.
ja: その話はまた今度ってことにしておくね。

key: Regardless, writing for the game and seeing the other developers (and hopefully players like you) enjoy my writing,
en: Regardless, writing for the game and seeing the other developers (and hopefully players like you) enjoy my writing,
ja: とにかく、ゲームのために文章を書いて、他の開発陣が(そしてあなたみたいなプレイヤーも)ボクの文章を楽しんでくれるのを見るのは、

key: Has given me huge amounts of joy!
en: Has given me huge amounts of joy!
ja: すごく大きな喜びをくれるんだ!

key: I'm so excited that everyone can finally play the game and see the work I put into it!
en: I'm so excited that everyone can finally play the game and see the work I put into it!

key: I think that pretty much covers my contributions!
en: I think that pretty much covers my contributions!
ja: これでボクの貢献については大体話せたと思う!

key: MARCELLO: I mean, so much.
en: MARCELLO: I mean, so much.
ja: マルチェロ: いや、本当にたくさんあるよ。

key: Even before I was a developer, I've met so many cool people in this community.
en: Even before I was a developer, I've met so many cool people in this community.
ja: 開発チームに入る前からも、このコミュニティですごくたくさんの素敵な人たちに出会った。

key: Most of my closest friends are either on this dev team, or were met because of this game.
en: Most of my closest friends are either on this dev team, or were met because of this game.
ja: 一番の親友のほとんどは、この開発チームにいるか、このゲームがきっかけで出会った人だよ。

key: Call me a big nerd if you want, but I also got really into Dungeons and Dragons thanks to this game.
en: Call me a big nerd if you want, but I also got really into Dungeons and Dragons thanks to this game.

key: At this point I've been DMing a campaign for two years whose players have almost exclusively been people I know from Reborn.
en: At this point I've been DMing a campaign for two years whose players have almost exclusively been people I know from Reborn.
ja: 今のところ、もう2年間キャンペーンのDMを続けてて、プレイヤーはほぼ全員リボーンで知り合った人たちだよ。

key: Shoutout to Ame and Autumn who are both players in the game and are deeply chaotic in their doing so.
en: Shoutout to Ame and Autumn who are both players in the game and are deeply chaotic in their doing so.
ja: アメとオータムには特に感謝を、二人ともこのゲームのプレイヤーで、めちゃくちゃカオスにプレイしてくれてる。

key: And have taken it upon themselves to ensure none of my plans ever come to fruition.
en: And have taken it upon themselves to ensure none of my plans ever come to fruition.
ja: そして、ボクの計画が絶対うまくいかないようにするのを、自分たちの使命みたいに思ってるみたいだ。

en: But also my other players who aren't on the team, and people who played in the group in the past but don't anymore?
ja: でもチームにいない他のプレイヤーたちや、過去にグループでプレイしてくれて今はもういない人たちにも?

key: Know that I deeply love and appreciate you all, these last two years have been infinitely better because of you all.
en: Know that I deeply love and appreciate you all, these last two years have been infinitely better because of you all.
ja: みんなのことを心から愛して感謝してるって知っておいてほしい、この2年間はみんなのおかげで、比べものにならないくらい良いものになったから。

key: And I owe that to Reborn.
en: And I owe that to Reborn.
ja: それはリボーンのおかげだと思ってる。

key: I like to think I owe so very much to it.
en: I like to think I owe so very much to it.
ja: リボーンには本当にたくさんの借りがあると思ってる。

key: So many of the people in this room are some of my best friends, and they're all just wonderful!
en: So many of the people in this room are some of my best friends, and they're all just wonderful!
ja: この部屋にいる多くの人が、ボクの一番の親友で、みんな本当に素晴らしい人たちなんだ!

key: Plus, being in such a supportive community around such great people for the last seven years,
en: Plus, being in such a supportive community around such great people for the last seven years,
ja: それに、この7年間、こんなに素晴らしい人たちに囲まれた、支え合えるコミュニティにいられたことが、

ja: 今のボクという人間を形作ってくれたと思ってる。

key: And I like that person!
en: And I like that person!
ja: そしてボクはその自分自身が好きだ!

key: So I couldn't be more grateful to have been a part of all this, and treasure the friendships I've made.
en: So I couldn't be more grateful to have been a part of all this, and treasure the friendships I've made.
ja: だから、この全てに関われたことにこれ以上ないくらい感謝してるし、築いてきた友情を宝物にしてる。

en: Here's to the next seven years of my time knowing and working with Ame being just as rewarding as the last.

key: But I'll try my best!
en: But I'll try my best!
ja: でもベストは尽くすよ!

en: If you struggle to do the things you want to, don't beat yourself up.
ja: やりたいことがうまくできなくて苦しんでいるなら、自分を責めすぎないで。

key: I've spent a lot of time on this team going back and forth between incredibly rapid productivity and paralyzing indecision and inaction.
en: I've spent a lot of time on this team going back and forth between incredibly rapid productivity and paralyzing indecision and inaction.
ja: このチームで長い間、ものすごい生産性と、身動きが取れないほどの優柔不断さの間を行ったり来たりしてきた。

en: But I made it, and things got a lot better when I stopped beating myself up every time I felt like I wasn't doing 'good enough'.
ja: でも何とかやってこられたし、「まだ十分じゃない」って感じるたびに自分を責めるのをやめてから、色々ずっと良くなった。

key: I'm sure you'll make it too.
en: I'm sure you'll make it too.
ja: あなたもきっとやり遂げられるよ。

en: But more than anything, my number one piece of advice?
ja: でも何より、ボクの一番のアドバイスは?

key: Just surround yourself with good people.
en: Just surround yourself with good people.
ja: いい人たちに囲まれること。

key: People you like, people you respect, people you admire, and people you wish to be more like.
en: People you like, people you respect, people you admire, and people you wish to be more like.
ja: 好きな人、尊敬する人、憧れる人、もっとそんな風になりたいと思える人たちにね。

key: It was entirely accidental, but that's what I did when I joined the Reborn team.
en: It was entirely accidental, but that's what I did when I joined the Reborn team.
ja: 完全に偶然だったけど、リボーンチームに加わった時、ボクはそれをしたんだ。

key: And I think, more than anything, that is what lead me to all the best parts of my life today.
en: And I think, more than anything, that is what lead me to all the best parts of my life today.
ja: そしてそれが、何よりも今のボクの人生の一番いい部分に導いてくれたんだと思ってる。

key: I've grown into a person I like, I have wonderful friends, and most importantly of all, I'm happy.
en: I've grown into a person I like, I have wonderful friends, and most importantly of all, I'm happy.
ja: 自分の好きな自分に成長できたし、素晴らしい友達もいるし、何より大事なことに、ボクは幸せなんだ。

key: And I feel like I owe all of that to the wonderful friends I have.
en: And I feel like I owe all of that to the wonderful friends I have.
ja: それは全部、素晴らしい友達たちのおかげだと思ってる。

en: But this is what you get from me, and I hope somebody finds it helpful!
ja: でもこれがボクにできる精一杯だから、誰かの役に立てばうれしいな!

en: Read?
ja: 読む?

key: I hope the AI didn't misplay too hard.
en: I hope the AI didn't misplay too hard.
ja: AIがあまりへまをしてないといいけど。

key: PERRY: Oof, did the lvl 101 thing mess you up that badly?
en: PERRY: Oof, did the lvl 101 thing mess you up that badly?
ja: ペリー: うわ、レベル101のあれのせいでそんなにやられちゃった?

key: PERRY: Sure, I'll think up something to talk about.
en: PERRY: Sure, I'll think up something to talk about.
ja: ペリー: いいよ、何か話すことを考えるね。

key: Anything specific you want to talk about? \ch[62,-1,Reborn,Game dev, Me, Ramblings, Nah]
en: Anything specific you want to talk about? \ch[62,-1,Reborn,Game dev, Me, Ramblings, Nah]
ja: 何か特に話したいことある? \ch[62,-1,リボーン,ゲーム開発,自分のこと,雑談,いや、いいや]

key: PERRY: Man, there's so much to talk about.
en: PERRY: Man, there's so much to talk about.
ja: ペリー: うわあ、話すことはたくさんあるな。

key: Starting with my introduction to the game.
en: Starting with my introduction to the game.
ja: このゲームとの出会いから始めようか。

key: It started by watching someone play through the game on Youtube, pkmnRob I think their name was.
en: It started by watching someone play through the game on Youtube, pkmnRob I think their name was.
ja: YouTubeで誰かがこのゲームをプレイしてるのを見たのがきっかけだった、たしかpkmnRobって名前だったかな。

key: Thought it was neat so decided to check it out myself.
en: Thought it was neat so decided to check it out myself.
ja: 面白そうだと思って、自分でも試してみることにした。

key: I played a few hacked ROMs before, but this was my first time playing on the computer.
en: I played a few hacked ROMs before, but this was my first time playing on the computer.
ja: その前にも改造ROMを何本かプレイしたことあったけど、パソコンでプレイするのはこれが初めてだった。

key: And then I got my ass handed to me in true Reborn fashion. The one Pokémon strat didn't work anymore.
en: And then I got my ass handed to me in true Reborn fashion. The one Pokémon strat didn't work anymore.
ja: そして、まさにリボーン流に、こてんぱんにやられたよ。一匹だけの戦術は通用しなかった。

key: After that I just kept on playing, basically no-living the game.
en: After that I just kept on playing, basically no-living the game.
ja: それからずっとプレイし続けて、基本的にこのゲームに人生を溶かしてた。

key: One of the things I love about the game is just how multidimensional it is.
en: One of the things I love about the game is just how multidimensional it is.
ja: このゲームの好きなところの一つは、とにかく多面的なところなんだ。

key: It's not only about the story, or the battling. It has puzzles, beautiful maps, many sidequests and more.
en: It's not only about the story, or the battling. It has puzzles, beautiful maps, many sidequests and more.
ja: 物語やバトルだけじゃない。パズルもあるし、美しいマップも、たくさんのサイドクエストも、それ以上のものもある。

key: And I think the game has made me a bit of a better person. Not that I was bad before.
en: And I think the game has made me a bit of a better person. Not that I was bad before.
ja: それに、このゲームのおかげで少しはいい人間になれたと思う。別に前がひどかったわけじゃないけど。

key: But I think I came out of it a bit more compassionate and understanding.
en: But I think I came out of it a bit more compassionate and understanding.
ja: でも、少しは思いやりと理解のある人間になれたと思ってる。

key: I ended up hanging around and checking up on the game every once in a while, playing the updates that came out.
en: I ended up hanging around and checking up on the game every once in a while, playing the updates that came out.
ja: その後もときどきこのゲームをチェックしながらぶらぶらして、出るアップデートをプレイし続けてたんだ。

key: And then Cass made a post about the battle tower.
en: And then Cass made a post about the battle tower.
ja: そしたらキャスがバトルタワーについての投稿をして。

key: A person in the comments asked if there would also be a battle factory, a gamemode I enjoy myself too.
en: A person in the comments asked if there would also be a battle factory, a gamemode I enjoy myself too.
ja: コメント欄で誰かが、バトルファクトリーもあるのかって聞いてたんだ、ボク自身も好きなゲームモードでね。

key: Cass responded that she'd think it cool, but it would be too much effort to make it worthwhile.
en: Cass responded that she'd think it cool, but it would be too much effort to make it worthwhile.
ja: キャスは、面白いと思うけどそれだけの価値を出すには手間がかかりすぎるって返信してた。

key: My ego showed up, and went like: "Bet"
en: My ego showed up, and went like: "Bet"
ja: ボクのプライドが顔を出して、「賭けようか」って感じになった。

key: It's a miracle, but somehow I actually managed to get it to work.Part of it is the coding language, Ruby. It's pretty easy to pick up, not a lot of foreknowledge required.
en: It's a miracle, but somehow I actually managed to get it to work.Part of it is the coding language, Ruby. It's pretty easy to pick up, not a lot of foreknowledge required.
ja: 奇跡的だけど、なぜかちゃんと動くようにできたんだ。プログラミング言語がRubyだったのも大きい。習得しやすくて、前提知識もそんなにいらないから。

key: So when I almost finished the battle factory I showed it off in the patreon server. Was planning to release it as a mod.
en: So when I almost finished the battle factory I showed it off in the patreon server. Was planning to release it as a mod.
ja: それでバトルファクトリーがほぼ完成した頃、パトレオンのサーバーで見せびらかしたんだ。MODとして公開するつもりだった。

key: Cass said she wanted it in the main game, so I polished it up a bit and sent everything needed for it.
en: Cass said she wanted it in the main game, so I polished it up a bit and sent everything needed for it.
ja: キャスがそれを本編に入れたいって言ってくれたから、少し磨きをかけて、必要な物全部を送った。

key: Helped with a few other things, and a while later she asked me if I actually wanted to help out as a dev.
en: Helped with a few other things, and a while later she asked me if I actually wanted to help out as a dev.
ja: 他にも色々手伝って、しばらくして彼女が、実際に開発陣として手伝ってくれる気はあるかって聞いてきたんだ。

key: I really have a lot to thank her for.
en: I really have a lot to thank her for.
ja: 本当に彼女には感謝してもしきれないよ。

key: After entering the team I met a lot of awesome people, which are here in this room.
en: After entering the team I met a lot of awesome people, which are here in this room.
ja: チームに入ってから、すごくたくさんの素晴らしい人たちに出会えた、今この部屋にいる人たちだよ。

key: And it has been an awesome journey.
en: And it has been an awesome journey.
ja: 本当に素晴らしい旅だった。

key: PERRY: But what is it I did in the game?
en: PERRY: But what is it I did in the game?
ja: ペリー: でも、実際ゲームで何をやったかって?

key: If you're reading in order you know that Cass asked me on the dev team.
en: If you're reading in order you know that Cass asked me on the dev team.
ja: 順番に読んでるなら、キャスがボクを開発チームに誘ったこと知ってるよね。

key: That's because all the bugs that had been found after e18 was released had been compiled.
en: That's because all the bugs that had been found after e18 was released had been compiled.
ja: それは、エピソード18リリース後に見つかったバグが全部まとめられてたからなんだ。

key: And it was a long list. So to help Marchello, and Azery at the time, out I was brought on.
en: And it was a long list. So to help Marchello, and Azery at the time, out I was brought on.
ja: それが長いリストでね。だから、当時のマルチェロとアゼリーを手伝うために連れてこられたんだ。

key: Like 10 days later I found a way to test where the code takes longest to run. 2 days after that e18.4 was released and optimization galore was a fact.
en: Like 10 days later I found a way to test where the code takes longest to run. 2 days after that e18.4 was released and optimization galore was a fact.
ja: その10日後くらいには、コードのどこが一番実行時間がかかるかテストする方法を見つけてた。その2日後にエピソード18.4がリリースされて、あらゆる最適化が実現したんだ。

key: Cass ran with it way further than I could take it, but I've been making sure things don't crash after she had sledgehammered them.
en: Cass ran with it way further than I could take it, but I've been making sure things don't crash after she had sledgehammered them.
ja: キャスはボクよりずっと遠くまでそれを推し進めたけど、彼女が大なたを振るった後、壊れないように確認するのはボクの仕事だった。

key: So most of the work I've done has just been bugfixing and fixin up after Cass.
en: So most of the work I've done has just been bugfixing and fixin up after Cass.
ja: だから、ボクがやった仕事の大半は、キャスの後始末のバグ修正なんだ。

key: But of course, there are also new things I've added!
en: But of course, there are also new things I've added!
ja: でももちろん、新しく追加したものもあるよ!

key: The battle factory, a lot of AI rewrite, online doubles, new field notes, are just a few of them.
en: The battle factory, a lot of AI rewrite, online doubles, new field notes, are just a few of them.
ja: バトルファクトリー、AIの大幅な書き直し、オンラインダブル、新しいフィールドノートなんかは、そのほんの一部。

key: It's hard to remember them all, since about 90% of them are just small QoL things. Like the game staying in the same place and speedup persisting when resetting.
en: It's hard to remember them all, since about 90% of them are just small QoL things. Like the game staying in the same place and speedup persisting when resetting.
ja: 全部は覚えてないな、だってその9割くらいは小さなQOL改善だから。ゲームの位置がリセット時も同じままだったり、倍速設定が持続したりとかね。

key: That's about it, really. Most of the work i do isn't visible, since it's not a new thing but fixing the old thing.
en: That's about it, really. Most of the work i do isn't visible, since it's not a new thing but fixing the old thing.
ja: そんなところかな。ボクがやった仕事の大半は目に見えないんだ、新しいものじゃなくて、古いものを直してるだけだから。

key: PERRY: Hi, I'm Perry or toothpastefairy which isn't really a name I use anymore.
en: PERRY: Hi, I'm Perry or toothpastefairy which isn't really a name I use anymore.
ja: ペリー: どうも、ボクはペリー、もしくはtoothpastefairy、まあもうその名前はあんまり使ってないけど。

key: Living that good life at the ripe age of 23.
en: Living that good life at the ripe age of 23.
ja: 23歳っていう若さで、いい人生を送ってるよ。

key: And a masters student studying Applied Physics living in the Netherlands.
en: And a masters student studying Applied Physics living in the Netherlands.
ja: オランダに住みながら応用物理学の修士課程にいるんだ。

key: Probably addicted to playing chess, since the amount of times I stopped writing all this dialogue and played a quick game online has hit the double digits.
en: Probably addicted to playing chess, since the amount of times I stopped writing all this dialogue and played a quick game online has hit the double digits.
ja: チェス中毒かもしれない、このセリフを書くのを中断してオンラインでちょっと対局した回数が、もう二桁に達してるからね。

key: There's a good chance this is the first time you hear of me, I'm not involved in the community a lot.
en: There's a good chance this is the first time you hear of me, I'm not involved in the community a lot.
ja: これが初めてボクの名前を聞くってこと、結構高い確率であると思う、コミュニティにはあんまり関わってないから。

key: Sometimes I wish I was, but it's just not something that comes naturally to me.
en: Sometimes I wish I was, but it's just not something that comes naturally to me.
ja: 関わりたいと思うこともあるけど、そういうのが自然にできるタイプじゃないんだ。

key: Meeting new communities and friend groups is always scary, and if the circumstances are not up for it you won't get many words out of me.
en: Meeting new communities and friend groups is always scary, and if the circumstances are not up for it you won't get many words out of me.
ja: 新しいコミュニティや友達グループに出会うのはいつも怖いことだし、状況が整ってないと、ボクからは大した言葉は出てこないよ。

key: I'm sure you have felt like that too a few times, like when going to a new school or maybe a party.
en: I'm sure you have felt like that too a few times, like when going to a new school or maybe a party.
ja: 新しい学校とかパーティーに行く時とか、あなたもきっと何度かそういう感覚を味わったことあると思う。

key: Especially starting a conversation. You'll catch me dead before I talk about myself unprovoked. Unless you're counting this.
en: Especially starting a conversation. You'll catch me dead before I talk about myself unprovoked. Unless you're counting this.
ja: 特に会話を始める時ね。誰かに聞かれない限り、自分のことなんて絶対に話さない。まあ、これを数えなければの話だけど。

key: But mostly i don't sweat that stuff too much, it's not who I am to do that and in the end I can accept that.
en: But mostly i don't sweat that stuff too much, it's not who I am to do that and in the end I can accept that.
ja: でも大抵はあんまり気にしすぎないようにしてる、そういうのを気にするのはボクらしくないし、最終的にはそれを受け入れられるから。

key: Anyhow, another thing about me is that I love music!
en: Anyhow, another thing about me is that I love music!
ja: とにかく、ボクについてのもう一つのことは、音楽が大好きだってこと!

key: High chance that if I'm alone at home, I'm with my headphones on. Not that I have a particularly refined taste in music.
en: High chance that if I'm alone at home, I'm with my headphones on. Not that I have a particularly refined taste in music.
ja: 家に一人でいる時は、大抵ヘッドホンをつけてる。別に音楽の趣味が特別洗練されてるわけじゃないけど。

key: I'm pretty sure that it is as close to basic as you can get, but I enjoy it nontheless.
en: I'm pretty sure that it is as close to basic as you can get, but I enjoy it nontheless.
ja: たぶんこれ以上ないくらいベーシックな趣味だと思うけど、それでも十分楽しんでる。

key: Like the e4 and champion battle tracks. Absolute bangers, those two. Deffo give them a listen if you haven't already.
en: Like the e4 and champion battle tracks. Absolute bangers, those two. Deffo give them a listen if you haven't already.
ja: 四天王とチャンピオン戦の曲とかね。あの二曲は絶対的な名曲。まだ聞いたことなければ、絶対聞いてみて。

key: Other than that my view of myself seems to oscillate between thinking I'm great and being disappointed in myself.
en: Other than that my view of myself seems to oscillate between thinking I'm great and being disappointed in myself.
ja: それ以外だと、自分のことをすごいと思う日と、自分にがっかりする日の間を、いつも行ったり来たりしてる感じ。

key: Where on some days I hype myself up and feel great about who I am.
en: Where on some days I hype myself up and feel great about who I am.
ja: ある日はテンションが上がって、自分のことをすごく良く思える。

key: And other days I feel helpless in trying to live my life in a healthy way and be a person I'm proud of being.
en: And other days I feel helpless in trying to live my life in a healthy way and be a person I'm proud of being.
ja: 別の日は、健康的な生き方をして、誇りに思える自分でいようとするのに、無力感を覚える。

key: Checking in on my friends, not wasting away a day doing things I won't remember two days later.
en: Checking in on my friends, not wasting away a day doing things I won't remember two days later.
ja: 友達の様子を確認したり、2日後には覚えてすらいないようなことに一日を溶かしたりしないようにね。

key: And I've been getting better at it too!
en: And I've been getting better at it too!
ja: それでも、だんだん上手くなってきてるんだ!

key: So there, life. I'm getting the hang of it.
en: So there, life. I'm getting the hang of it.
ja: だから、まあ人生ってそういうものだよね。コツをつかみつつあるところ。

key: PERRY: And what a mistake to select this option. So this is just gonna be my random thoughts, a stream of conciousness if you're familiar with the term.
en: PERRY: And what a mistake to select this option. So this is just gonna be my random thoughts, a stream of conciousness if you're familiar with the term.
ja: ペリー: この選択肢を選んだのは失敗だったかな。だからこれはボクのただの取り留めのない考え、意識の流れってやつになるよ、その言葉になじみがあれば。

key: I do love this game dearly, having had a huge impact on my life.
en: I do love this game dearly, having had a huge impact on my life.
ja: このゲームは本当に大好きで、ボクの人生に大きな影響を与えてくれた。

key: Helping out on it is an amazing feeling, where for the first time I feel like I'm contributing to something bigger.
en: Helping out on it is an amazing feeling, where for the first time I feel like I'm contributing to something bigger.
ja: 開発を手伝うのはすごくいい気分で、初めて自分がもっと大きな何かに貢献してるって感じられる。

key: And the fact that it feels productive working on this too, amazing.
en: And the fact that it feels productive working on this too, amazing.
ja: それにそれが生産的な感覚にもなるっていうのが、すごいことなんだ。

key: I'm just about the last one writing my dialogue, so I have the advantage of knowing what everybody else has said.
en: I'm just about the last one writing my dialogue, so I have the advantage of knowing what everybody else has said.
ja: ボクはセリフを書くのがほぼ最後の方になったから、みんなが何を言ったか知ってるっていう有利さがある。

key: And Vulpes was really able to nail down how I feel about contributing to Reborn as well.
en: And Vulpes was really able to nail down how I feel about contributing to Reborn as well.
ja: ヴルペスが、リボーンに貢献することについてのボクの気持ちを、本当にうまく言い当ててくれてたよ。

key: I'm not too good a writer, so I'll gladly point to others when they better express how I feel.
en: I'm not too good a writer, so I'll gladly point to others when they better express how I feel.
ja: ボクはそんなに文章が得意じゃないから、自分の気持ちをもっとうまく言い表してる人がいたら、喜んでそっちを指し示すよ。

key: And we do have a lot of talented writers in this room here. That should be no surprise to you, most of them contributed to the story of Reborn which we love so much.
en: And we do have a lot of talented writers in this room here. That should be no surprise to you, most of them contributed to the story of Reborn which we love so much.
ja: この部屋には才能ある書き手がたくさんいるからね。それも当然で、みんなボクらが大好きなリボーンの物語に、それぞれ貢献してるんだから。

key: One of my favorite parts was walking around in the desert with Taka.
en: One of my favorite parts was walking around in the desert with Taka.
ja: 一番好きなシーンの一つは、タカと一緒に砂漠を歩いたことだった。

key: Did you know that Taka has the most dialogue in the game? Or at least, the text "TAKA:" appears 1.5x more than any other "CHARACTER:" in the game.
en: Did you know that Taka has the most dialogue in the game? Or at least, the text "TAKA:" appears 1.5x more than any other "CHARACTER:" in the game.
ja: タカがこのゲームで一番セリフが多いキャラだって知ってた? 少なくとも、「タカ:」っていうテキストは、他のどの「キャラ名:」よりも1.5倍多く出てくるんだ。

key: Azzie wrote a really sweet fic about it as well, go read it!
en: Azzie wrote a really sweet fic about it as well, go read it!
ja: アジーがそれについて本当に素敵な小説を書いてたよ、ぜひ読んでみて!

key: Yeah I'm still in love with the game. But now I appreciate the work the others put in it all the more.
en: Yeah I'm still in love with the game. But now I appreciate the work the others put in it all the more.
ja: うん、今でもこのゲームに夢中だよ。でも今は、他のみんなが注いだ労力を、以前よりずっと大事に思えるようになった。

key: It's funny, since I don't even game that much anymore. I think that in the last 5 years I've played a total of 3 games.
en: It's funny, since I don't even game that much anymore. I think that in the last 5 years I've played a total of 3 games.
ja: 不思議なもので、実はもうそんなにゲームをやらなくなったんだ。この5年で合計3本くらいしかプレイしてないと思う。

key: Got sucked in the world of fanfiction instead I guess. If only at school those counted as books you've read.
en: Got sucked in the world of fanfiction instead I guess. If only at school those counted as books you've read.
ja: 代わりにファンフィクションの世界にどっぷりハマっちゃったからかな。学校でそれが「読んだ本」に数えてくれたらいいのに。

key: But anyway, you're probably holding the X button down to skip this dialogue so I'll end your suffering.
en: But anyway, you're probably holding the X button down to skip this dialogue so I'll end your suffering.
ja: まあとにかく、たぶんもうXボタンを押しっぱなしにしてこのセリフを飛ばそうとしてると思うから、この苦しみを終わらせるね。

key: Have fun out there!
en: Have fun out there!
ja: 楽しんできてね!

key: PERRY: Cool, see ya.
en: PERRY: Cool, see ya.
ja: ペリー: よし、またね。

key: Talk to the others too, they're very sweet!
en: Talk to the others too, they're very sweet!
ja: 他のみんなとも話してみて、すごくいい人たちだから!

key: AZZIE: Hi there!
en: AZZIE: Hi there!
ja: アジー: どうも!

key: Thanks for stopping by!
en: Thanks for stopping by!
ja: 立ち寄ってくれてありがとう!

key: I hope you've been enjoying Reborn!
en: I hope you've been enjoying Reborn!
ja: リボーンを楽しんでもらえてたらいいな!

key: This game means so much to so many people, I'm really glad you stuck it out to the end.
en: This game means so much to so many people, I'm really glad you stuck it out to the end.
ja: このゲームは本当にたくさんの人にとって大きな意味を持ってるから、最後までやり抜いてくれて本当にうれしい。

key: There's some pretty great stuff still ahead of you, I'll tell you that much.
en: There's some pretty great stuff still ahead of you, I'll tell you that much.
ja: この先にもまだまだ素敵なものが待ってるよ、それだけは言っておく。

key: Was there something in particular you'd like to talk about?
en: Was there something in particular you'd like to talk about?
ja: 何か特に話したいことある?

key: AZZIE: I do like talking about Reborn!
en: AZZIE: I do like talking about Reborn!
ja: アジー: リボーンについて話すの、好きなんだ!

key: So compared to most people in this room, my history with Reborn is pretty short.
en: So compared to most people in this room, my history with Reborn is pretty short.
ja: この部屋にいる大半の人と比べたら、ボクとリボーンの付き合いはかなり短いんだ。

key: In 2017-ish, I found out about the game through a friend of mine tweeting about it.
en: In 2017-ish, I found out about the game through a friend of mine tweeting about it.
ja: 2017年くらいに、友達がこのゲームについてツイートしてるのを見て知ったの。

key: He posted a picture of the inside of Sweet Kiss Candy shop, I mistook it for a Pokecentre, and immediately decided I had to play this game.
en: He posted a picture of the inside of Sweet Kiss Candy shop, I mistook it for a Pokecentre, and immediately decided I had to play this game.
ja: 彼がスイートキスキャンディーショップの店内の写真を投稿してて、それをポケモンセンターだと勘違いして、絶対このゲームをプレイしなきゃって即決めちゃった。

key: Of course, then I actually started playing, and... Well, let's just say Julia kicked my butt so badly I put the game down and forgot about it.
en: Of course, then I actually started playing, and... Well, let's just say Julia kicked my butt so badly I put the game down and forgot about it.
ja: もちろん、実際にプレイし始めてみたら……まあ、ジュリアにボコボコにされすぎて、ゲームを置いて存在すら忘れちゃった、とだけ言っておくね。

key: For a couple years.
en: For a couple years.
ja: 数年間ね。

key: In February of 2019, I decided to try it again, and-- while I wasn't much better-- I at least had more patience.
en: In February of 2019, I decided to try it again, and-- while I wasn't much better-- I at least had more patience.
ja: 2019年2月に、もう一度挑戦してみようと決めて――そんなに上達したわけじゃなかったけど――少なくとも前より辛抱強くなってた。

key: I ended up falling completely in love with the game. The characters, the music, the world...
en: I ended up falling completely in love with the game.  The characters, the music, the world...
ja: 結局、このゲームに完全に恋しちゃったんだ。キャラクターも、音楽も、この世界も……

key: It made me, and continues to make me, so happy.
en: It made me, and continues to make me, so happy.
ja: それがボクをすごく幸せにしてくれたし、今もそうし続けてくれてる。

key: Reborn actually ended up reigniting my passion for writing.
en: Reborn actually ended up reigniting my passion for writing.
ja: 実は、リボーンのおかげで、文章を書く情熱が再燃したの。

key: More than that, I fell in love with the community!
en: More than that, I fell in love with the community!
ja: それ以上に、このコミュニティに恋しちゃった!

key: I made some incredible friends, some of whom are in this room with me, and I wouldn't trade them for the world.
en: I made some incredible friends, some of whom are in this room with me, and I wouldn't trade them for the world.
ja: 何人かのすごい友達もできて、その一部は今この部屋に一緒にいるし、彼らを何にも代えられないと思ってる。

key: In late 2020, I messaged Ame, asking if she needed any help with last-minute things.
en: In late 2020, I messaged Ame, asking if she needed any help with last-minute things.
ja: 2020年の終わり頃、アメにメッセージを送って、最後の細々した作業で何か手伝えることはないか聞いたの。

key: A while later, she decided she could use some help with the Nightclub, and so here I am!
en: A while later, she decided she could use some help with the Nightclub, and so here I am!
ja: しばらくして、ナイトクラブ関連で手伝いが欲しいってことになって、それで今ここにいるってわけ!

key: All the Trainers you can battle in the Battle Pavilion, their little dialogues, were my department!
en: All the Trainers you can battle in the Battle Pavilion, their little dialogues, were my department!
ja: バトルパビリオンで戦えるトレーナーたち、あの小さなセリフは全部ボクの担当だったよ!

key: I also worked on some of the characters' chatter while hanging out in the club itself-- so go say hi to folks, if you haven't already!
en: I also worked on some of the characters' chatter while hanging out in the club itself-- so go say hi to folks, if you haven't already!
ja: クラブの中でくつろいでる時のキャラクターたちの雑談も少し書いたの――まだ挨拶してないなら、みんなに声かけてみて!

key: This game and community mean so much to me, and I'll always be grateful for how kind and wonderful everyone's been.
en: This game and community mean so much to me, and I'll always be grateful for how kind and wonderful everyone's been.
ja: このゲームとこのコミュニティはボクにとってすごく大きな意味があって、みんなの優しさと素晴らしさにはずっと感謝し続けると思う。

key: AZZIE: Oh! Okay, uh, hi!
en: AZZIE: Oh! Okay, uh, hi!
ja: アジー: あ! オーケー、えっと、どうも!

key: I'm Azzie.
en: I'm Azzie.
ja: アジーです。

key: I'm a Canadian gal, and at the time this is being published, I'm in my late twenties.
en: I'm a Canadian gal, and at the time this is being published, I'm in my late twenties.
ja: カナダ人の女の子で、これが公開される頃には、20代後半になってるかな。

key: Apart from Reborn (and sundry other fangames, and Pokemon in general) I'm also a musician, animal lover, and storyteller.
en: Apart from Reborn (and sundry other fangames, and Pokemon in general) I'm also a musician, animal lover, and storyteller.
ja: リボーン(と他の色んなファンゲーム、ポケモン全般)以外だと、音楽もやってて、動物好きで、物語を語るのも好き。

key: I'm so passionate about stories, in all their forms. How they can bring people together, heal people, bring joy and catharsis...
en: I'm so passionate about stories, in all their forms.  How they can bring people together, heal people, bring joy and catharsis...
ja: 物語ってものにすごく情熱を持ってるの、その形はどんなものであれ。物語がどうやって人々を結びつけたり、癒やしたり、喜びやカタルシスをもたらしたりするか……

key: Definitely one of my favourite things to think about.
en: Definitely one of my favourite things to think about.
ja: 間違いなく、一番よく考えるテーマの一つだね。
